FROM fct_events
WHERE "timestamp" >= DATE '2026-03-01'
  AND "timestamp" < DATE '2026-04-01';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS active_users
FROM fct_events
WHERE "timestamp" >= DATE '2026-02-01'
  AND "timestamp" < DATE '2026-03-01';

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS active_users

WITH monthly_active AS (
    SELECT
        date_trunc('month', "timestamp") AS month,
        COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS active_users
    FROM fct_events
    WHERE "timestamp" >= DATE '2026-02-01'
      AND "timestamp" <  DATE '2026-04-01'
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
    MAX(CASE WHEN month = DATE '2026-02-01' THEN active_users END) AS feb_2026_active_users,
    MAX(CASE WHEN month = DATE '2026-03-01' THEN active_users END) AS mar_2026_active_users,
    MAX(CASE WHEN month = DATE '2026-03-01' THEN active_users END)
        - MAX(CASE WHEN month = DATE '2026-02-01' THEN active_users END) AS mom_change
FROM monthly_active;

WITH monthly_active AS (

  AND status = 'active';

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(mrr), 0) * 12 AS arr

WHERE started_at <= TIMESTAMP '2026-03-31 23:59:59'
  AND (ended_at IS NULL OR ended_at > TIMESTAMP '2026-03-31 23:59:59')
  AND status = 'active';

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(mrr), 0) * 12 AS arr_eoy_fy2025

  AND started_at <= TIMESTAMP '2025-12-31 23:59:59'

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(s.mrr) * 12, 0) AS enterprise_arr
FROM fct_subscriptions s
JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
WHERE LOWER(c.plan_tier) = 'enterprise'
  AND COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
  AND s.started_at <= TIMESTAMP '2026-03-31 23:59:59'
  AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at > TIMESTAMP '2026-03-31 23:59:59')
  AND (c.churned_at IS NULL OR c.churned_at > TIMESTAMP '2026-03-31 23:59:59');

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(s.mrr) * 12, 0) AS enterprise_arr
FROM fct_subscriptions s
JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
WHERE LOWER(c.plan_tier) = 'enterprise'
  AND s.started_at <= TIMESTAMP '2026-03-31 23:59:59'
  AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at > TIMESTAMP '2026-03-31 23:59:59')
  AND COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
  AND (c.churned_at IS NULL OR c.churned_at > TIMESTAMP '2026-03-31 23:59:59');

WITH monthly_arr AS (
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('month', m.month) AS month,
        COALESCE(SUM(s.mrr) * 12, 0) AS arr
    FROM (
        SELECT DATE '2026-02-01' AS month
        UNION ALL
        SELECT DATE '2026-03-01'
    ) m
    LEFT JOIN fct_subscriptions s
        ON s.started_at <= (DATE_TRUNC('month', m.month) + INTERVAL 1 MONTH - INTERVAL 1 DAY)
        AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= DATE_TRUNC('month', m.month))
        AND s.status = 'active'
    LEFT JOIN dim_customers c
        ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
        AND COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', m.month)
)
SELECT
    MAX(CASE WHEN month = DATE '2026-02-01' THEN arr END) AS arr_feb_2026,
    MAX(CASE WHEN month = DATE '2026-03-01' THEN arr END) AS arr_mar_2026,
    MAX(CASE WHEN month = DATE '2026-03-01' THEN arr END)
        - MAX(CASE WHEN month = DATE '2026-02-01' THEN arr END) AS mom_change
FROM monthly_arr;

WITH monthly_arr AS (
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('month', started_at) AS month,
        SUM(mrr) * 12 AS arr
    FROM fct_subscriptions
    WHERE status = 'active'
      AND started_at <= DATE '2026-03-31'
      AND (ended_at IS NULL OR ended_at > DATE '2026-03-31')
    GROUP BY 1
),
arr_snapshots AS (
    SELECT
        'feb_2026' AS period,
        SUM(mrr) * 12 AS arr
    FROM fct_subscriptions
    WHERE started_at <= DATE '2026-02-28'
      AND (ended_at IS NULL OR ended_at > DATE '2026-02-28')
    UNION ALL
    SELECT
        'mar_2026' AS period,
        SUM(mrr) * 12 AS arr
    FROM fct_subscriptions
    WHERE started_at <= DATE '2026-03-31'
      AND (ended_at IS NULL OR ended_at > DATE '2026-03-31')
)
SELECT
    MAX(CASE WHEN period = 'feb_2026' THEN arr END) AS feb_2026_arr,
    MAX(CASE WHEN period = 'mar_2026' THEN arr END) AS mar_2026_arr,
    MAX(CASE WHEN period = 'mar_2026' THEN arr END)
        - MAX(CASE WHEN period = 'feb_2026' THEN arr END) AS mom_change
FROM arr_snapshots;

WITH active_at AS (
    SELECT
        SUM(CASE 
                WHEN started_at <= DATE '2025-12-31'
                 AND (ended_at IS NULL OR ended_at > DATE '2025-12-31')
                 AND status = 'active'
                THEN mrr ELSE 0 
            END) * 12 AS arr_start,
        SUM(CASE 
                WHEN started_at <= CURRENT_DATE
                 AND (ended_at IS NULL OR ended_at > CURRENT_DATE)
                 AND status = 'active'
                THEN mrr ELSE 0 
            END) * 12 AS arr_current
    FROM fct_subscriptions
)
SELECT
    arr_start,
    arr_current,
    arr_current - arr_start AS arr_growth_ytd_2026
FROM active_at;

WITH active_at AS (
    SELECT
        (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(mrr), 0) * 12
         FROM fct_subscriptions
         WHERE started_at <= DATE '2025-12-31'
           AND (ended_at IS NULL OR ended_at > DATE '2025-12-31')
           AND status = 'active'
        ) AS arr_start,
        (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(mrr), 0) * 12
         FROM fct_subscriptions
         WHERE started_at <= CURRENT_DATE
           AND (ended_at IS NULL OR ended_at > CURRENT_DATE)
           AND status = 'active'
        ) AS arr_current
)
SELECT
    arr_start,
    arr_current,
    arr_current - arr_start AS arr_ytd_growth
FROM active_at;

WITH q1_start AS (SELECT DATE '2026-01-01' AS d),
     q1_end AS (SELECT DATE '2026-04-01' AS d),
     -- MRR per customer at start of Q1 2026 (active subs as of 2026-01-01)
     mrr_start AS (
         SELECT s.customer_id, SUM(s.mrr) AS mrr_start
         FROM fct_subscriptions s
         WHERE s.started_at < DATE '2026-01-01'
           AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= DATE '2026-01-01')
         GROUP BY s.customer_id
     ),
     -- MRR per customer at end of Q1 2026 (active subs as of 2026-03-31)
     mrr_end AS (
         SELECT s.customer_id, SUM(s.mrr) AS mrr_end
         FROM fct_subscriptions s
         WHERE s.started_at < DATE '2026-04-01'
           AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= DATE '2026-04-01')
         GROUP BY s.customer_id
     ),
     existing AS (
         SELECT
             ms.customer_id,
             ms.mrr_start,
             COALESCE(me.mrr_end, 0) AS mrr_end
         FROM mrr_start ms
         LEFT JOIN mrr_end me ON ms.customer_id = me.customer_id
         JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = ms.customer_id
         WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
     )
SELECT
    SUM(GREATEST(mrr_start - mrr_end, 0)) * 12 AS arr_contraction
FROM existing
WHERE mrr_end < mrr_start
  AND mrr_end > 0;  -- exclude full churn, only contraction among still-existing customers

WITH q1_start AS (SELECT DATE '2026-01-01' AS d),
     q1_end   AS (SELECT DATE '2026-04-01' AS d),
     -- ARR per customer at start of Q1 2026 (active subs as of Q1 start)
     arr_start AS (
        SELECT s.customer_id,
               SUM(s.mrr) * 12 AS arr
        FROM fct_subscriptions s
        WHERE s.started_at < (SELECT d FROM q1_start)
          AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= (SELECT d FROM q1_start))
        GROUP BY s.customer_id
     ),
     -- ARR per customer at end of Q1 2026 (active subs as of Q1 end)
     arr_end AS (
        SELECT s.customer_id,
               SUM(s.mrr) * 12 AS arr
        FROM fct_subscriptions s
        WHERE s.started_at < (SELECT d FROM q1_end)
          AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= (SELECT d FROM q1_end))
        GROUP BY s.customer_id
     )
SELECT
    SUM(
        GREATEST(
            COALESCE(arr_start.arr, 0) - COALESCE(arr_end.arr, 0),
            0
        )
    ) AS arr_contraction_q1_2026
FROM arr_start
LEFT JOIN arr_end USING (customer_id)
JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = arr_start.customer_id
WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
  AND COALESCE(arr_end.arr, 0) > 0  -- still a customer (not full churn), only contraction
  AND COALESCE(arr_end.arr, 0) < arr_start.arr;

WITH fy2025 AS (
    SELECT
        DATE '2024-10-01' AS fy_start,
        DATE '2025-09-30' AS fy_end
),
-- ARR snapshot at a given date: sum of MRR * 12 for active subs
arr_at_start AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(s.mrr), 0) * 12 AS arr
    FROM fct_subscriptions s, fy2025 f
    WHERE s.started_at <= f.fy_start
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at > f.fy_start)
),
arr_at_end AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(s.mrr), 0) * 12 AS arr
    FROM fct_subscriptions s, fy2025 f
    WHERE s.started_at <= f.fy_end
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at > f.fy_end)
)
SELECT
    (SELECT arr FROM arr_at_start) AS arr_start_fy2025,
    (SELECT arr FROM arr_at_end)   AS arr_end_fy2025,
    GREATEST((SELECT arr FROM arr_at_start) - (SELECT arr FROM arr_at_end), 0) AS arr_contraction_fy2025;

WITH fy2025 AS (
    SELECT
        DATE '2024-10-01' AS fy_start,
        DATE '2025-09-30' AS fy_end
),
active_start AS (
    -- Subscriptions active at the start of FY2025
    SELECT
        s.customer_id,
        SUM(s.mrr) * 12 AS arr_start
    FROM fct_subscriptions s, fy2025 f
    WHERE s.started_at <= f.fy_start
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at > f.fy_start)
      AND LOWER(COALESCE(s.status, '')) <> 'inactive'
    GROUP BY s.customer_id
),
active_end AS (
    -- Subscriptions active at the end of FY2025
    SELECT
        s.customer_id,
        SUM(s.mrr) * 12 AS arr_end
    FROM fct_subscriptions s, fy2025 f
    WHERE s.started_at <= f.fy_end
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at > f.fy_end)
      AND LOWER(COALESCE(s.status, '')) <> 'inactive'
    GROUP BY s.customer_id
),
combined AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(a.customer_id, b.customer_id) AS customer_id,
        COALESCE(a.arr_start, 0) AS arr_start,
        COALESCE(b.arr_end, 0)   AS arr_end
    FROM active_start a
    FULL OUTER JOIN active_end b
        ON a.customer_id = b.customer_id
)
SELECT
    SUM(GREATEST(arr_start - arr_end, 0)) AS arr_contraction_fy2025
FROM combined c
JOIN dim_customers d ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE COALESCE(d.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE;

WITH q4_start AS (SELECT DATE '2025-10-01' AS d),
     q4_end   AS (SELECT DATE '2026-01-01' AS d),
     existing_customers AS (
         SELECT customer_id
         FROM dim_customers
         WHERE COALESCE(is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
           AND COALESCE(signup_date, joined_dt) < (SELECT d FROM q4_start)
     ),
     -- MRR active just before Q4 start
     mrr_before AS (
         SELECT s.customer_id, SUM(s.mrr) AS mrr_pre
         FROM fct_subscriptions s
         JOIN existing_customers e ON e.customer_id = s.customer_id
         WHERE s.started_at < (SELECT d FROM q4_start)
           AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= (SELECT d FROM q4_start))
         GROUP BY s.customer_id
     ),
     -- MRR active at end of Q4 (last day in quarter)
     mrr_after AS (
         SELECT s.customer_id, SUM(s.mrr) AS mrr_post
         FROM fct_subscriptions s
         JOIN existing_customers e ON e.customer_id = s.customer_id
         WHERE s.started_at < (SELECT d FROM q4_end)
           AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= (SELECT d FROM q4_end))
         GROUP BY s.customer_id
     ),
     per_customer AS (
         SELECT
             COALESCE(b.customer_id, a.customer_id) AS customer_id,
             COALESCE(b.mrr_pre, 0)  AS mrr_pre,
             COALESCE(a.mrr_post, 0) AS mrr_post,
             COALESCE(a.mrr_post, 0) - COALESCE(b.mrr_pre, 0) AS delta_mrr
         FROM mrr_before b
         FULL OUTER JOIN mrr_after a ON a.customer_id = b.customer_id
     )
SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN delta_mrr < 0 THEN delta_mrr * 12 ELSE 0 END) AS arr_contraction
FROM per_customer
WHERE mrr_pre > 0;

WITH q4_start AS (SELECT DATE '2025-10-01' AS d),
     q4_end AS (SELECT DATE '2026-01-01' AS d),
     -- Existing customers: signed up before Q4 started
     existing AS (
         SELECT customer_id
         FROM dim_customers
         WHERE COALESCE(is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
           AND COALESCE(signup_date, joined_dt) < (SELECT d FROM q4_start)
     ),
     -- MRR active at start of Q4 per customer
     mrr_start AS (
         SELECT s.customer_id, SUM(s.mrr) AS mrr_begin
         FROM fct_subscriptions s
         WHERE s.started_at < (SELECT d FROM q4_start)
           AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= (SELECT d FROM q4_start))
         GROUP BY s.customer_id
     ),
     -- MRR active at end of Q4 per customer
     mrr_end AS (
         SELECT s.customer_id, SUM(s.mrr) AS mrr_finish
         FROM fct_subscriptions s
         WHERE s.started_at < (SELECT d FROM q4_end)
           AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= (SELECT d FROM q4_end))
         GROUP BY s.customer_id
     )
SELECT
    SUM(
        GREATEST(
            COALESCE(mrr_begin, 0) - COALESCE(mrr_finish, 0),
            0
        )
    ) * 12 AS arr_contraction_q4_fy2025
FROM existing e
LEFT JOIN mrr_start ms ON ms.customer_id = e.customer_id
LEFT JOIN mrr_end me ON me.customer_id = e.customer_id
WHERE COALESCE(mrr_begin, 0) > 0;

WITH q1_start AS (SELECT DATE '2026-01-01' AS d),
q1_end AS (SELECT DATE '2026-03-31' AS d),
prior_end AS (SELECT DATE '2025-12-31' AS d),
-- MRR per customer at end of Q4 2025 (prior period)
mrr_prior AS (
    SELECT
        s.customer_id,
        SUM(s.mrr) AS mrr_prior
    FROM fct_subscriptions s, prior_end pe
    WHERE s.started_at <= pe.d
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at > pe.d)
      AND s.status IN ('active','Active','ACTIVE')
    GROUP BY s.customer_id
),
-- MRR per customer at end of Q1 2026
mrr_current AS (
    SELECT
        s.customer_id,
        SUM(s.mrr) AS mrr_current
    FROM fct_subscriptions s, q1_end qe
    WHERE s.started_at <= qe.d
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at > qe.d)
      AND s.status IN ('active','Active','ACTIVE')
    GROUP BY s.customer_id
),
existing AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(p.customer_id, c.customer_id) AS customer_id,
        COALESCE(p.mrr_prior, 0) AS mrr_prior,
        COALESCE(c.mrr_current, 0) AS mrr_current
    FROM mrr_prior p
    FULL OUTER JOIN mrr_current c ON p.customer_id = c.customer_id
    WHERE COALESCE(p.mrr_prior, 0) > 0  -- existing customers only
),
movements AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        mrr_prior,
        mrr_current,
        CASE
            WHEN mrr_current < mrr_prior AND mrr_current > 0 THEN (mrr_prior - mrr_current)
            ELSE 0
        END AS contraction_mrr,
        CASE
            WHEN mrr_current > mrr_prior THEN (mrr_current - mrr_prior)
            ELSE 0
        END AS expansion_mrr
    FROM existing
)
SELECT
    ROUND(SUM(contraction_mrr) * 12, 2) AS arr_contraction,
    ROUND(SUM(expansion_mrr) * 12, 2)   AS arr_expansion,
    ROUND((SUM(expansion_mrr) - SUM(contraction_mrr)) * 12, 2) AS net_arr_change,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE contraction_mrr > 0) AS contracted_customers,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE expansion_mrr > 0)   AS expanded_customers
FROM movements;

WITH q1_start AS (SELECT DATE '2026-01-01' AS d),
q1_end AS (SELECT DATE '2026-04-01' AS d),
prev_start AS (SELECT DATE '2025-10-01' AS d),
-- MRR per customer active at end of Q4 2025 (just before Q1 2026)
mrr_before AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        SUM(mrr) AS mrr_prev
    FROM fct_subscriptions
    WHERE started_at < (SELECT d FROM q1_start)
      AND (ended_at IS NULL OR ended_at >= (SELECT d FROM q1_start))
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
-- MRR per customer active at end of Q1 2026
mrr_after AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        SUM(mrr) AS mrr_curr
    FROM fct_subscriptions
    WHERE started_at < (SELECT d FROM q1_end)
      AND (ended_at IS NULL OR ended_at >= (SELECT d FROM q1_end))
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
existing AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(b.customer_id, a.customer_id) AS customer_id,
        COALESCE(b.mrr_prev, 0) AS mrr_prev,
        COALESCE(a.mrr_curr, 0) AS mrr_curr
    FROM mrr_before b
    INNER JOIN mrr_after a ON a.customer_id = b.customer_id
    -- existing customers: had MRR before Q1 2026
    WHERE COALESCE(b.mrr_prev, 0) > 0
),
joined AS (
    SELECT
        e.customer_id,
        e.mrr_prev,
        e.mrr_curr,
        (e.mrr_curr - e.mrr_prev) AS mrr_delta
    FROM existing e
    JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = e.customer_id
    WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
)
SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN mrr_delta < 0 AND mrr_curr > 0 THEN -mrr_delta ELSE 0 END) * 12 AS arr_contraction,
    SUM(CASE WHEN mrr_delta > 0 THEN mrr_delta ELSE 0 END) * 12 AS arr_expansion,
    (SUM(CASE WHEN mrr_delta > 0 THEN mrr_delta ELSE 0 END)
     - SUM(CASE WHEN mrr_delta < 0 AND mrr_curr > 0 THEN -mrr_delta ELSE 0 END)) * 12 AS net_arr_change,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN mrr_delta < 0 AND mrr_curr > 0 THEN customer_id END) AS contracting_customers,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN mrr_delta > 0 THEN customer_id END) AS expanding_customers
FROM joined;

WITH q1_start AS (SELECT DATE '2026-01-01' AS d),
q1_end AS (SELECT DATE '2026-04-01' AS d),
-- Existing customers: signed up before Q1 2026
existing AS (
    SELECT customer_id
    FROM dim_customers
    WHERE COALESCE(is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
      AND signup_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
),
-- ARR at end of Q1 2026 (active subs as of 2026-03-31)
arr_end AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(s.mrr), 0) * 12 AS arr
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    JOIN existing e ON e.customer_id = s.customer_id
    WHERE s.started_at < DATE '2026-04-01'
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= DATE '2026-04-01')
),
-- ARR at start of Q1 2026 (active subs as of 2026-01-01)
arr_start AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(s.mrr), 0) * 12 AS arr
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    JOIN existing e ON e.customer_id = s.customer_id
    WHERE s.started_at < DATE '2026-01-01'
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= DATE '2026-01-01')
)
SELECT
    (SELECT arr FROM arr_start) AS arr_start_q1_2026,
    (SELECT arr FROM arr_end)   AS arr_end_q1_2026,
    (SELECT arr FROM arr_end) - (SELECT arr FROM arr_start) AS arr_expansion_q1_2026;

WITH q1_start AS (SELECT DATE '2026-01-01' AS d),
q1_end AS (SELECT DATE '2026-04-01' AS d),
-- Identify existing customers: signed up before Q1 2026
existing AS (
    SELECT customer_id
    FROM dim_customers
    WHERE COALESCE(is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
      AND COALESCE(signup_date, joined_dt) < DATE '2026-01-01'
),
-- MRR active at start of Q1 2026 per existing customer
mrr_start AS (
    SELECT s.customer_id, SUM(s.mrr) AS mrr_amt
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    JOIN existing e ON e.customer_id = s.customer_id
    WHERE s.started_at < DATE '2026-01-01'
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= DATE '2026-01-01')
    GROUP BY s.customer_id
),
-- MRR active at end of Q1 2026 per existing customer
mrr_end AS (
    SELECT s.customer_id, SUM(s.mrr) AS mrr_amt
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    JOIN existing e ON e.customer_id = s.customer_id
    WHERE s.started_at < DATE '2026-04-01'
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= DATE '2026-04-01')
    GROUP BY s.customer_id
)
SELECT
    SUM(GREATEST(COALESCE(me.mrr_amt, 0) - COALESCE(ms.mrr_amt, 0), 0)) * 12 AS arr_expansion
FROM mrr_start ms
JOIN mrr_end me USING (customer_id);

WITH q4_start AS (SELECT DATE '2025-10-01' AS d),
q4_end AS (SELECT DATE '2026-01-01' AS d),
-- ARR at end of Q4 (active subs as of end) for customers who existed before Q4
arr_end AS (
    SELECT s.customer_id, SUM(s.mrr) * 12 AS arr
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    WHERE s.started_at < (SELECT d FROM q4_end)
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= (SELECT d FROM q4_end))
    GROUP BY s.customer_id
),
arr_start AS (
    SELECT s.customer_id, SUM(s.mrr) * 12 AS arr
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    WHERE s.started_at < (SELECT d FROM q4_start)
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= (SELECT d FROM q4_start))
    GROUP BY s.customer_id
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(GREATEST(COALESCE(e.arr,0) - COALESCE(s.arr,0), 0)), 0) AS arr_expansion_q4_fy2025
FROM arr_start s
JOIN arr_end e ON e.customer_id = s.customer_id;

WITH q4_start AS (SELECT DATE '2025-10-01' AS d),
q4_end AS (SELECT DATE '2026-01-01' AS d),
-- MRR per customer at end of Q4 FY2025 (active subs as of end of Q4)
mrr_end AS (
    SELECT s.customer_id, SUM(s.mrr) AS mrr_end
    FROM fct_subscriptions s, q4_end
    WHERE s.started_at < q4_end.d
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= q4_end.d)
    GROUP BY s.customer_id
),
-- MRR per customer at start of Q4 FY2025
mrr_start AS (
    SELECT s.customer_id, SUM(s.mrr) AS mrr_start
    FROM fct_subscriptions s, q4_start
    WHERE s.started_at < q4_start.d
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= q4_start.d)
    GROUP BY s.customer_id
),
existing AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(ms.customer_id, me.customer_id) AS customer_id,
        COALESCE(ms.mrr_start, 0) AS mrr_start,
        COALESCE(me.mrr_end, 0)   AS mrr_end
    FROM mrr_start ms
    JOIN mrr_end me ON ms.customer_id = me.customer_id
)
SELECT
    SUM(GREATEST(mrr_end - mrr_start, 0)) * 12 AS arr_expansion
FROM existing
WHERE mrr_start > 0 AND mrr_end > mrr_start;

WITH existing_customers AS (
    -- Customers who existed before FY2025 started
    SELECT DISTINCT customer_id
    FROM fct_subscriptions
    WHERE started_at < DATE '2025-01-01'
),
arr_start AS (
    -- ARR at start of FY2025 from existing customers
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(mrr), 0) * 12 AS arr
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    WHERE s.customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM existing_customers)
      AND s.started_at < DATE '2025-01-01'
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= DATE '2025-01-01')
),
arr_end AS (
    -- ARR at end of FY2025 from those same existing customers
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(mrr), 0) * 12 AS arr
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    WHERE s.customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM existing_customers)
      AND s.started_at < DATE '2026-01-01'
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= DATE '2026-01-01')
)
SELECT
    (SELECT arr FROM arr_end) - (SELECT arr FROM arr_start) AS arr_expansion_fy2025;

WITH active_subs AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        mrr,
        started_at,
        COALESCE(ended_at, TIMESTAMP '9999-12-31') AS ended_at
    FROM fct_subscriptions
    WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL
),
fy_bounds AS (
    SELECT
        TIMESTAMP '2024-12-31 23:59:59' AS fy_start_eod,
        TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00' AS fy_start,
        TIMESTAMP '2025-12-31 23:59:59' AS fy_end
),
arr_at_start AS (
    SELECT customer_id, SUM(mrr) * 12 AS arr
    FROM active_subs, fy_bounds
    WHERE started_at <= fy_start
      AND ended_at   >  fy_start
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
arr_at_end AS (
    SELECT customer_id, SUM(mrr) * 12 AS arr
    FROM active_subs, fy_bounds
    WHERE started_at <= fy_end
      AND ended_at   >  fy_end
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
existing AS (
    SELECT
        s.customer_id,
        COALESCE(s.arr, 0) AS arr_start,
        COALESCE(e.arr, 0) AS arr_end
    FROM arr_at_start s
    LEFT JOIN arr_at_end e USING (customer_id)
)
SELECT
    SUM(GREATEST(arr_end - arr_start, 0)) AS arr_expansion_fy2025
FROM existing
WHERE arr_start > 0;

WITH q3_start AS (SELECT DATE '2025-07-01' AS d),
q3_end AS (SELECT DATE '2025-09-30' AS d),
-- ARR per customer at end of Q3 2025 (active subscriptions)
arr_end AS (

    FROM fct_subscriptions

arr_start AS (

    FROM fct_subscriptions
    WHERE started_at < (SELECT d FROM q3_start)
      AND (ended_at IS NULL OR ended_at >= (SELECT d FROM q3_start))
    GROUP BY customer_id
)
SELECT

FROM arr_start s
JOIN arr_end e ON s.customer_id = e.customer_id
WHERE COALESCE(e.arr, 0) > COALESCE(s.arr, 0);

WITH q3_start AS (SELECT DATE '2025-07-01' AS d),
q3_end AS (SELECT DATE '2025-09-30' AS d),
-- Customers existing before Q3 (had an active sub starting before Q3 start)
existing_customers AS (

    FROM fct_subscriptions
    WHERE started_at < (SELECT d FROM q3_start)

-- ARR at end of Q3 for existing customers
arr_end AS (

    FROM fct_subscriptions
    WHERE customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM existing_customers)
      AND started_at <= (SELECT d FROM q3_end)
      AND (ended_at IS NULL OR ended_at > (SELECT d FROM q3_end))
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
-- ARR at start of Q3 for existing customers
arr_start AS (

    FROM fct_subscriptions
    WHERE customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM existing_customers)
      AND started_at < (SELECT d FROM q3_start)

)
SELECT

FROM arr_start s
FULL OUTER JOIN arr_end e USING (customer_id);

WITH revenue AS (

    FROM fct_invoices

    SELECT SUM(amount) AS total_cogs
    FROM fct_cogs
    WHERE period_month >= DATE '2026-01-01'
      AND period_month < DATE '2026-04-01'
)
SELECT
    revenue.total_revenue,
    cogs.total_cogs,
    revenue.total_revenue - cogs.total_cogs AS gross_margin,
    (revenue.total_revenue - cogs.total_cogs) / NULLIF(revenue.total_revenue, 0) AS gross_margin_pct
FROM revenue, cogs;

WITH revenue AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS total_revenue
    FROM fct_invoices
    WHERE status = 'paid'
      AND paid_at >= DATE '2026-01-01'
      AND paid_at < DATE '2026-04-01'
),
cogs AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS total_cogs
    FROM fct_cogs
    WHERE period_month >= DATE '2026-01-01'
      AND period_month < DATE '2026-04-01'
)
SELECT
    revenue.total_revenue,
    cogs.total_cogs,

WITH period AS (
    SELECT DATE '2026-01-01' AS period_start,
           DATE '2026-04-01' AS period_end
),
-- MRR from customers active at the start of the period
starting_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT s.customer_id
    FROM fct_subscriptions s, period p
    WHERE s.started_at < p.period_start
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= p.period_start)
),
starting_mrr AS (
    SELECT s.customer_id, SUM(s.mrr) AS mrr_start
    FROM fct_subscriptions s, period p
    WHERE s.started_at < p.period_start
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= p.period_start)
    GROUP BY s.customer_id
),
-- MRR at end of period for those same customers (no expansion counted)
ending_mrr AS (
    SELECT s.customer_id, SUM(s.mrr) AS mrr_end
    FROM fct_subscriptions s, period p
    WHERE s.customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM starting_customers)
      AND s.started_at < p.period_end
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= p.period_end)
    GROUP BY s.customer_id
),
combined AS (
    SELECT sm.customer_id,
           sm.mrr_start,
           COALESCE(em.mrr_end, 0) AS mrr_end_capped
    FROM starting_mrr sm
    LEFT JOIN ending_mrr em ON sm.customer_id = em.customer_id
)
SELECT
    SUM(mrr_start) AS starting_mrr,
    SUM(LEAST(mrr_end_capped, mrr_start)) AS retained_mrr,
    SUM(LEAST(mrr_end_capped, mrr_start)) / NULLIF(SUM(mrr_start), 0) AS gross_retention
FROM combined;

WITH period AS (
    SELECT DATE '2026-01-01' AS period_start,
           DATE '2026-04-01' AS period_end
),
-- MRR from customers active at the start of Q1 2026 (the cohort base)
starting_mrr AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(s.mrr), 0) AS mrr_start
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    CROSS JOIN period p
    JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
    WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
      AND s.started_at < p.period_start
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= p.period_start)
),
-- MRR retained from those same customers at the end of Q1 2026
-- GRR excludes expansion, so cap each customer's ending MRR at their starting MRR
cohort_start AS (
    SELECT s.customer_id, SUM(s.mrr) AS mrr_start
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    CROSS JOIN period p
    JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
    WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
      AND s.started_at < p.period_start
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= p.period_start)
    GROUP BY s.customer_id
),
cohort_end AS (
    SELECT s.customer_id, SUM(s.mrr) AS mrr_end
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    CROSS JOIN period p
    WHERE s.started_at < p.period_end
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= p.period_end)
    GROUP BY s.customer_id
),
retained AS (
    SELECT SUM(LEAST(cs.mrr_start, COALESCE(ce.mrr_end, 0))) AS mrr_retained
    FROM cohort_start cs
    LEFT JOIN cohort_end ce ON ce.customer_id = cs.customer_id
)
SELECT
    sm.mrr_start                                       AS starting_mrr,
    r.mrr_retained                                     AS retained_mrr,
    CASE WHEN sm.mrr_start > 0
         THEN r.mrr_retained / sm.mrr_start
         ELSE NULL END                                 AS gross_retention
FROM starting_mrr sm CROSS JOIN retained r;

WITH fy_start AS (SELECT DATE '2025-01-01' AS d),
     fy_end AS (SELECT DATE '2025-12-31' AS d),
     -- Customers active at start of FY2025
     starting_customers AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT s.customer_id, s.mrr
         FROM fct_subscriptions s
         JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
         WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
           AND s.started_at < (SELECT d FROM fy_start)
           AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= (SELECT d FROM fy_start))
     ),
     starting_mrr AS (
         SELECT customer_id, SUM(mrr) AS start_mrr
         FROM starting_customers
         GROUP BY customer_id
     ),
     -- Ending MRR for those same customers, capped at starting (GRR ignores expansion)
     ending_mrr AS (
         SELECT sm.customer_id,
                sm.start_mrr,
                COALESCE(SUM(
                    CASE
                        WHEN s.started_at <= (SELECT d FROM fy_end)
                         AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at > (SELECT d FROM fy_end))
                        THEN s.mrr
                        ELSE 0
                    END
                ), 0) AS end_mrr
         FROM starting_mrr sm
         LEFT JOIN fct_subscriptions s
           ON s.customer_id = sm.customer_id
         GROUP BY sm.customer_id, sm.start_mrr
     )
SELECT
    SUM(start_mrr) AS starting_mrr,
    SUM(LEAST(end_mrr, start_mrr)) AS retained_mrr,
    SUM(LEAST(end_mrr, start_mrr)) / NULLIF(SUM(start_mrr), 0) AS gross_revenue_retention
FROM ending_mrr;

WITH fy_start AS (SELECT DATE '2025-01-01' AS d),
     fy_end   AS (SELECT DATE '2025-12-31' AS d),
     base AS (
         SELECT
             s.customer_id,
             s.mrr,
             s.started_at,
             s.ended_at,
             s.status
         FROM fct_subscriptions s
         JOIN dim_customers c
           ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
         WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
     ),
     starting_mrr AS (
         SELECT SUM(mrr) AS mrr_start
         FROM base
         WHERE started_at < (SELECT d FROM fy_start)
           AND (ended_at IS NULL OR ended_at >= (SELECT d FROM fy_start))
     ),
     lost_mrr AS (
         SELECT COALESCE(SUM(mrr), 0) AS mrr_lost
         FROM base
         WHERE started_at < (SELECT d FROM fy_start)
           AND ended_at IS NOT NULL
           AND ended_at >= (SELECT d FROM fy_start)
           AND ended_at <  DATE '2026-01-01'
     )
SELECT
    (starting_mrr.mrr_start - lost_mrr.mrr_lost) / NULLIF(starting_mrr.mrr_start, 0) AS gross_retention_fy2025
FROM starting_mrr, lost_mrr;

WITH period AS (

),

retained AS (

    FROM active_start a
    LEFT JOIN mrr_end e ON e.customer_id = a.customer_id

WITH period AS (
    SELECT
        DATE '2025-10-01' AS period_start,
        DATE '2026-01-01' AS period_end
),
active_start AS (
    SELECT
        s.customer_id,
        SUM(s.mrr) AS mrr_start
    FROM fct_subscriptions s

      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= p.period_start)
      AND COALESCE(s.status, '') <> 'test'
    GROUP BY s.customer_id
),
retained_end AS (
    SELECT
        a.customer_id,
        LEAST(
            a.mrr_start,
            COALESCE(SUM(
                CASE
                    WHEN s.started_at < p.period_end
                     AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= p.period_end)
                    THEN s.mrr
                    ELSE 0
                END
            ), 0)
        ) AS mrr_retained
    FROM active_start a
    CROSS JOIN period p
    LEFT JOIN fct_subscriptions s
        ON s.customer_id = a.customer_id
    GROUP BY a.customer_id, a.mrr_start
)
SELECT
    SUM(r.mrr_retained) / NULLIF(SUM(a.mrr_start), 0) AS gross_retention_q4_fy2025,
    SUM(a.mrr_start) AS starting_mrr,
    SUM(r.mrr_retained) AS retained_mrr
FROM active_start a
LEFT JOIN retained_end r ON r.customer_id = a.customer_id;

WITH period AS (
    SELECT DATE '2025-07-01' AS period_start, DATE '2025-10-01' AS period_end
),
active_start AS (
    -- Customers with active MRR at the start of Q3 FY2025
    SELECT
        s.customer_id,
        SUM(s.mrr) AS mrr_start
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    CROSS JOIN period p
    LEFT JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
    WHERE s.started_at < p.period_start
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= p.period_start)
      AND COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
    GROUP BY s.customer_id
),
active_end AS (
    -- Same cohort, MRR retained at end of Q3 (no expansion counted)
    SELECT
        s.customer_id,
        SUM(s.mrr) AS mrr_end
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    CROSS JOIN period p
    LEFT JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
    WHERE s.started_at < p.period_start
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= p.period_end)
      AND COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
    GROUP BY s.customer_id
)
SELECT
    SUM(LEAST(COALESCE(e.mrr_end, 0), s.mrr_start)) AS retained_mrr,
    SUM(s.mrr_start) AS starting_mrr,
    CASE WHEN SUM(s.mrr_start) > 0
         THEN SUM(LEAST(COALESCE(e.mrr_end, 0), s.mrr_start)) / SUM(s.mrr_start)
    END AS gross_retention
FROM active_start s
LEFT JOIN active_end e ON e.customer_id = s.customer_id;

WITH period AS (
    SELECT
        DATE '2025-07-01' AS period_start,
        DATE '2025-10-01' AS period_end
),
starting_mrr AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(s.mrr), 0) AS mrr_start
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    CROSS JOIN period p
    JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
    WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
      AND s.started_at < p.period_start
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= p.period_start)
),
retained_mrr AS (
    -- MRR from those same starting subs that survived through end of period,
    -- minus any downgrades (taking the lesser of start vs current MRR)
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(s.mrr), 0) AS mrr_retained
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    CROSS JOIN period p
    JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
    WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
      AND s.started_at < p.period_start
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= p.period_end)
)
SELECT
    sm.mrr_start                                        AS starting_mrr,
    rm.mrr_retained                                     AS retained_mrr,
    (sm.mrr_start - rm.mrr_retained)                    AS churned_mrr,
    CASE WHEN sm.mrr_start > 0
         THEN rm.mrr_retained / sm.mrr_start
         ELSE NULL
    END                                                 AS gross_retention
FROM starting_mrr sm
CROSS JOIN retained_mrr rm;

WITH fy2025_invoices AS (

      AND paid_at <  DATE '2026-01-01'
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
customer_lifetimes AS (
    SELECT
        c.customer_id,
        fi.gross_revenue,
        fi.gross_revenue * 0.75 AS gross_profit,
        DATE_DIFF(
            'month',
            COALESCE(c.signup_date, c.joined_dt),
            COALESCE(CAST(c.churned_at AS DATE), DATE '2025-12-31')
        ) + 1 AS lifetime_months

    WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
),
totals AS (
    SELECT
        SUM(gross_profit) AS total_gross_profit_fy2025,
        AVG(gross_profit) AS avg_gross_profit_per_customer,
        AVG(lifetime_months) AS avg_lifetime_months,
        COUNT(*) AS customer_count
    FROM customer_lifetimes
)
SELECT
    customer_count,
    total_gross_profit_fy2025,
    avg_gross_profit_per_customer,
    avg_lifetime_months,
    0.75 AS gross_margin_assumption,
    avg_gross_profit_per_customer * avg_lifetime_months AS ltv_fy2025

    WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
),
metrics AS (

WITH monthly_mrr AS (
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('month', started_at) AS month,
        SUM(mrr) AS total_mrr
    FROM fct_subscriptions
    WHERE status = 'active'
      AND DATE_TRUNC('month', started_at) IN (DATE '2026-01-01', DATE '2026-02-01')
    GROUP BY 1
),
jan AS (SELECT total_mrr AS jan_mrr FROM monthly_mrr WHERE month = DATE '2026-01-01'),
feb AS (SELECT total_mrr AS feb_mrr FROM monthly_mrr WHERE month = DATE '2026-02-01')
SELECT
    jan.jan_mrr,
    feb.feb_mrr,
    feb.feb_mrr - jan.jan_mrr AS mom_change,
    (feb.feb_mrr - jan.jan_mrr) / NULLIF(jan.jan_mrr, 0) AS mom_pct_change
FROM jan, feb;

WITH monthly_mrr AS (
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('month', started_at) AS month,
        SUM(mrr) AS total_mrr
    FROM fct_subscriptions
    WHERE status = 'active'
      AND started_at <= '2026-02-28'
      AND (ended_at IS NULL OR ended_at > DATE_TRUNC('month', started_at))
    GROUP BY 1
),
active_by_month AS (
    SELECT
        m.month,
        SUM(s.mrr) AS mrr
    FROM (SELECT DATE '2026-01-01' AS month UNION ALL SELECT DATE '2026-02-01') m
    LEFT JOIN fct_subscriptions s
        ON s.started_at <= (m.month + INTERVAL 1 MONTH - INTERVAL 1 DAY)
       AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= m.month)
    GROUP BY m.month
)
SELECT
    MAX(CASE WHEN month = DATE '2026-01-01' THEN mrr END) AS jan_2026_mrr,
    MAX(CASE WHEN month = DATE '2026-02-01' THEN mrr END) AS feb_2026_mrr,
    MAX(CASE WHEN month = DATE '2026-02-01' THEN mrr END)
        - MAX(CASE WHEN month = DATE '2026-01-01' THEN mrr END) AS mom_change
FROM active_by_month;

WITH q1_start AS (SELECT DATE '2026-01-01' AS d),
q1_end AS (SELECT DATE '2026-04-01' AS d),
prior_start AS (SELECT DATE '2025-10-01' AS d),
prior_end AS (SELECT DATE '2026-01-01' AS d),
-- Customers active at the start of Q1 2026 (cohort)
cohort AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT s.customer_id
    FROM fct_subscriptions s, q1_start qs
    WHERE s.started_at < qs.d
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= qs.d)
),
-- Starting MRR: MRR for cohort at start of Q1 2026
starting_mrr AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(s.mrr), 0) AS mrr
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    JOIN cohort c ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
    CROSS JOIN q1_start qs
    WHERE s.started_at < qs.d
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= qs.d)
),
-- Ending MRR: MRR for same cohort at end of Q1 2026
ending_mrr AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(s.mrr), 0) AS mrr
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    JOIN cohort c ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
    CROSS JOIN q1_end qe
    WHERE s.started_at < qe.d
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= qe.d)
)
SELECT
    (SELECT mrr FROM starting_mrr) AS starting_mrr,
    (SELECT mrr FROM ending_mrr)   AS ending_mrr,
    CASE WHEN (SELECT mrr FROM starting_mrr) = 0 THEN NULL
         ELSE (SELECT mrr FROM ending_mrr) * 1.0 / (SELECT mrr FROM starting_mrr)
    END AS net_revenue_retention;

WITH q1_start AS (SELECT DATE '2026-01-01' AS d),
q1_end AS (SELECT DATE '2026-04-01' AS d),
prior_start AS (SELECT DATE '2025-10-01' AS d),
-- Customers active at start of Q1 2026 (cohort)
cohort AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT s.customer_id
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
    WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
      AND s.started_at < (SELECT d FROM q1_start)
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= (SELECT d FROM q1_start))
),
-- Starting MRR: MRR for cohort active at start of Q1 2026
starting_mrr AS (
    SELECT SUM(s.mrr) AS mrr_start
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    WHERE s.customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM cohort)
      AND s.started_at < (SELECT d FROM q1_start)
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= (SELECT d FROM q1_start))
),
-- Ending MRR: MRR from same cohort active at end of Q1 2026
ending_mrr AS (
    SELECT SUM(s.mrr) AS mrr_end
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    WHERE s.customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM cohort)
      AND s.started_at < (SELECT d FROM q1_end)
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= (SELECT d FROM q1_end))
)
SELECT
    (SELECT mrr_start FROM starting_mrr) AS starting_mrr,
    (SELECT mrr_end FROM ending_mrr) AS ending_mrr,
    (SELECT mrr_end FROM ending_mrr) / NULLIF((SELECT mrr_start FROM starting_mrr), 0) AS net_revenue_retention;

WITH start_mrr AS (
    SELECT customer_id, SUM(mrr) AS mrr_start
    FROM fct_subscriptions
    WHERE started_at < DATE '2024-01-01'
      AND (ended_at IS NULL OR ended_at >= DATE '2024-01-01')
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
end_mrr AS (
    SELECT customer_id, SUM(mrr) AS mrr_end
    FROM fct_subscriptions
    WHERE started_at < DATE '2025-01-01'
      AND (ended_at IS NULL OR ended_at >= DATE '2025-01-01')
    GROUP BY customer_id
)
SELECT
    SUM(COALESCE(e.mrr_end, 0)) / NULLIF(SUM(s.mrr_start), 0) AS net_revenue_retention_fy2024
FROM start_mrr s
LEFT JOIN end_mrr e USING (customer_id);

WITH fy_start AS (SELECT DATE '2025-01-01' AS d),
fy_end AS (SELECT DATE '2025-12-31' AS d),
-- Identify customers active at the start of FY2025 (cohort)
cohort_customers AS (

    WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
      AND s.started_at < (SELECT d FROM fy_start)
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= (SELECT d FROM fy_start))
),
-- Starting MRR: sum of MRR for cohort subs active at FY start
starting_mrr AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(s.mrr), 0) AS mrr
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    WHERE s.customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM cohort_customers)
      AND s.started_at < (SELECT d FROM fy_start)
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= (SELECT d FROM fy_start))
),
-- Ending MRR: sum of MRR from those same cohort customers active at FY end
ending_mrr AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(s.mrr), 0) AS mrr
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    WHERE s.customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM cohort_customers)
      AND s.started_at <= (SELECT d FROM fy_end)
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at > (SELECT d FROM fy_end))
)
SELECT
    (SELECT mrr FROM starting_mrr) AS starting_mrr,
    (SELECT mrr FROM ending_mrr)   AS ending_mrr,
    CASE WHEN (SELECT mrr FROM starting_mrr) = 0 THEN NULL
         ELSE (SELECT mrr FROM ending_mrr) * 1.0 / (SELECT mrr FROM starting_mrr)
    END AS net_revenue_retention;

WITH fy2025 AS (
    SELECT DATE '2024-02-01' AS fy_start, DATE '2025-01-31' AS fy_end
),
-- MRR at start of FY2025: subscriptions active as of fy_start
starting_mrr AS (
    SELECT s.customer_id, SUM(s.mrr) AS start_mrr
    FROM fct_subscriptions s, fy2025 f
    WHERE s.started_at <= f.fy_start
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at > f.fy_start)
    GROUP BY s.customer_id
),
-- MRR at end of FY2025 from the same starting cohort (includes expansion, contraction, churn)
ending_mrr AS (
    SELECT s.customer_id, SUM(s.mrr) AS end_mrr
    FROM fct_subscriptions s, fy2025 f
    WHERE s.customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM starting_mrr)
      AND s.started_at <= f.fy_end
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at > f.fy_end)
    GROUP BY s.customer_id
)
SELECT
    SUM(sm.start_mrr)                                  AS starting_mrr,
    COALESCE(SUM(em.end_mrr), 0)                       AS ending_mrr_from_cohort,
    COALESCE(SUM(em.end_mrr), 0) / SUM(sm.start_mrr)   AS net_retention
FROM starting_mrr sm
LEFT JOIN ending_mrr em USING (customer_id);

WITH fy_start AS (SELECT DATE '2025-01-01' AS d_start, DATE '2026-01-01' AS d_end),

-- CAC payback period (months) = CAC / (ARPU * Gross Margin)
-- Schema has no CAC/marketing spend or cost data, so we approximate
-- payback as: months for cumulative new-customer MRR to recoup
-- a proxy CAC. With no spend table available, compute the simplest
-- defensible proxy: average months from signup to cumulative invoice
-- revenue >= first-year MRR run-rate. Here we report the standard
-- ARPU-based payback assuming CAC is unavailable -> use median MRR
-- as denominator and NULL CAC, returning months = NULL when missing.

WITH active_subs AS (
    SELECT customer_id, mrr
    FROM fct_subscriptions
    WHERE started_at <= TIMESTAMP '2026-03-31 23:59:59'
      AND (ended_at IS NULL OR ended_at > TIMESTAMP '2026-03-31 23:59:59')
      AND status = 'active'
),
arpu AS (
    SELECT AVG(mrr) AS arpu_monthly
    FROM active_subs
    WHERE mrr > 0
),
cac AS (
    -- No marketing spend table in schema; CAC unknown.
    SELECT CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) AS cac_value
)
SELECT
    cac.cac_value                                    AS cac,
    arpu.arpu_monthly                                AS arpu,
    cac.cac_value / NULLIF(arpu.arpu_monthly, 0)     AS payback_period_months
FROM cac, arpu;

-- CAC Payback Period = CAC / (ARPU * Gross Margin)
-- Without CAC or cost data in the schema, we approximate payback period as:
-- months until cumulative revenue per customer covers their first invoice (proxy for CAC)
-- Standard approximation: CAC / Monthly Gross Profit per customer
-- Here we compute: (avg first-invoice amount per customer) / (avg MRR per active customer)

WITH active_subs AS (
    SELECT customer_id, mrr
    FROM fct_subscriptions
    WHERE started_at <= DATE '2026-03-31'
      AND (ended_at IS NULL OR ended_at > DATE '2026-03-31')
      AND status = 'active'
),
first_invoice AS (
    SELECT customer_id, MIN(paid_at) AS first_paid_at
    FROM fct_invoices
    WHERE paid_at <= DATE '2026-03-31'
      AND status = 'paid'
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
acquisition_cost AS (
    SELECT i.customer_id, i.amount AS acq_amount
    FROM fct_invoices i
    JOIN first_invoice f
      ON i.customer_id = f.customer_id
     AND i.paid_at = f.first_paid_at
),
metrics AS (
    SELECT
        AVG(ac.acq_amount) AS avg_cac_proxy,
        AVG(s.mrr) AS avg_mrr
    FROM active_subs s
    LEFT JOIN acquisition_cost ac ON ac.customer_id = s.customer_id
)
SELECT
    avg_cac_proxy,
    avg_mrr,
    CASE WHEN avg_mrr > 0 THEN avg_cac_proxy / avg_mrr END AS payback_period_months
FROM metrics;

-- Payback period (months) = CAC / (ARPU * Gross Margin)
-- Without cost data, approximate as: months to recover average customer acquisition
-- via average MRR. Here we compute as 1 / (avg monthly revenue per customer / avg acquisition spend proxy).
-- Proxy: payback_period_months = avg_first_invoice_amount / avg_mrr (active subs as of cutoff)

WITH cutoff AS (
    SELECT DATE '2025-12-31' AS as_of
),
active_subs AS (
    SELECT s.customer_id, s.mrr
    FROM fct_subscriptions s, cutoff c
    WHERE s.started_at <= c.as_of
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at > c.as_of)
      AND s.status = 'active'
),
arpu AS (
    SELECT AVG(mrr) AS avg_mrr FROM active_subs
),
cac_proxy AS (
    SELECT AVG(amount) AS avg_acq_cost
    FROM (
        SELECT customer_id, MIN(paid_at) AS first_paid, MIN_BY(amount, paid_at) AS amount
        FROM fct_invoices, cutoff
        WHERE paid_at <= cutoff.as_of AND status = 'paid'
        GROUP BY customer_id
    )
)
SELECT
    cac_proxy.avg_acq_cost / NULLIF(arpu.avg_mrr, 0) AS payback_period_months
FROM arpu, cac_proxy;

-- Payback period (months) = CAC / (ARPA * Gross Margin)
-- Without cost/CAC data in the schema, we approximate payback as:
-- average months for cumulative invoice revenue per customer to recoup their first-month MRR-equivalent acquisition proxy.
-- Here we compute: avg months from signup to the point where cumulative paid invoices >= first observed MRR (proxy for CAC).

WITH cust AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        signup_date
    FROM dim_customers
    WHERE COALESCE(is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
      AND signup_date <= DATE '2025-12-31'
),
first_mrr AS (
    SELECT
        s.customer_id,
        MIN(s.mrr) AS cac_proxy
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    WHERE s.started_at <= TIMESTAMP '2025-12-31 23:59:59'
    GROUP BY s.customer_id
),
inv AS (
    SELECT
        i.customer_id,
        i.paid_at,
        i.amount
    FROM fct_invoices i
    WHERE i.status = 'paid'
      AND i.paid_at <= TIMESTAMP '2025-12-31 23:59:59'
),
cum AS (
    SELECT
        c.customer_id,
        c.signup_date,
        f.cac_proxy,
        i.paid_at,
        SUM(i.amount) OVER (
            PARTITION BY c.customer_id
            ORDER BY i.paid_at
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS cum_rev
    FROM cust c
    JOIN first_mrr f USING (customer_id)
    JOIN inv i USING (customer_id)
),
payback_per_cust AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        MIN(DATE_DIFF('month', signup_date, paid_at)) AS payback_months
    FROM cum
    WHERE cum_rev >= cac_proxy
    GROUP BY customer_id
)
SELECT AVG(payback_months) AS payback_period_months
FROM payback_per_cust;

-- CAC payback period (months) as of end of FY2025 (assume FY2025 ends 2025-12-31)
-- Payback = CAC / ARPU_monthly_gross_margin. Without cost/CAC data in schema, 
-- approximate using: months to recover acquisition by dividing average acquisition 
-- spend per new customer by average MRR. Since no marketing/cost table exists,
-- compute as: (sum of first invoice amounts for customers acquired in FY2025) / 
-- (avg MRR of active subs at FY2025 end).

WITH fy_end AS (
    SELECT DATE '2025-12-31' AS d
),
new_customers_fy25 AS (
    SELECT customer_id
    FROM dim_customers
    WHERE COALESCE(is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
      AND signup_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
),
acquisition_cost AS (
    -- Proxy: assume CAC ~ first invoice amount per newly-acquired customer
    SELECT AVG(first_amt) AS cac_per_customer
    FROM (
        SELECT i.customer_id,
               MIN(i.amount) AS first_amt
        FROM fct_invoices i
        JOIN new_customers_fy25 n ON n.customer_id = i.customer_id
        WHERE i.paid_at <= (SELECT d FROM fy_end)
        GROUP BY i.customer_id
    ) t
),
arpu AS (
    SELECT AVG(mrr) AS avg_mrr
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    WHERE s.started_at <= (SELECT d FROM fy_end)
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at > (SELECT d FROM fy_end))
      AND s.status = 'active'
)
SELECT
    (SELECT cac_per_customer FROM acquisition_cost) AS cac,
    (SELECT avg_mrr FROM arpu) AS avg_monthly_revenue,
    (SELECT cac_per_customer FROM acquisition_cost) / NULLIF((SELECT avg_mrr FROM arpu), 0)
        AS payback_period_months;

-- CAC payback period (months) as of end of FY2025 (assumed = 2025-12-31)
-- Payback = CAC / Gross Margin per new customer per month
-- Without cost/marketing tables in schema, approximate using:
--   "CAC proxy" = average first-invoice amount per new customer in FY2025
--   "Monthly revenue per customer" = average MRR of active subs for those customers
-- Result expressed in months.

WITH fy_end AS (
    SELECT DATE '2025-12-31' AS d
),
new_customers AS (
    SELECT c.customer_id
    FROM dim_customers c, fy_end f
    WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
      AND COALESCE(c.signup_date, c.joined_dt) BETWEEN DATE '2025-01-01' AND f.d
),
first_invoice AS (
    SELECT i.customer_id, MIN(i.paid_at) AS first_paid_at
    FROM fct_invoices i
    JOIN new_customers n ON n.customer_id = i.customer_id
    WHERE i.status = 'paid'
    GROUP BY i.customer_id
),
cac_proxy AS (
    SELECT AVG(i.amount) AS avg_cac
    FROM fct_invoices i
    JOIN first_invoice fi
      ON fi.customer_id = i.customer_id AND fi.first_paid_at = i.paid_at
),
arpu AS (
    SELECT AVG(s.mrr) AS avg_mrr
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    JOIN new_customers n ON n.customer_id = s.customer_id
    WHERE s.status = 'active'
      AND s.mrr > 0
)
SELECT
    cac_proxy.avg_cac                          AS cac_usd,
    arpu.avg_mrr                               AS monthly_revenue_per_customer_usd,
    cac_proxy.avg_cac / NULLIF(arpu.avg_mrr,0) AS payback_period_months
FROM cac_proxy, arpu;

-- Pipeline coverage = (open pipeline entering the quarter) / (quarter quota/target)
-- Assumptions for Baseline A (raw schema only, no semantic layer):
--   * Q1 FY2026 begins 2026-01-01 (calendar fiscal year).
--   * "Going into" the quarter => snapshot as of the day before quarter start.
--   * Open pipeline = sum of properties_jsonb.amount for opportunity_* events
--     whose latest stage as of the snapshot is not 'closed_won' or 'closed_lost'.
--   * Quarter target = sum of properties_jsonb.target_amount from
--     'quota_set' events that apply to 2026-Q1.
WITH params AS (
    SELECT
        DATE '2026-01-01'                          AS quarter_start,
        DATE '2026-01-01' - INTERVAL 1 DAY         AS snapshot_ts
),
opp_events AS (
    SELECT
        e.*,
        CAST(json_extract_string(e.properties_jsonb, '$.opportunity_id') AS VARCHAR) AS opportunity_id,
        CAST(json_extract_string(e.properties_jsonb, '$.stage')           AS VARCHAR) AS stage,
        TRY_CAST(json_extract_string(e.properties_jsonb, '$.amount') AS DOUBLE)       AS amount
    FROM fct_events e, params p
    WHERE e.event_type LIKE 'opportunity_%'
      AND e."timestamp" <= p.snapshot_ts
),
latest_opp AS (
    SELECT opportunity_id, stage, amount
    FROM (
        SELECT
            opportunity_id,
            stage,
            amount,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY opportunity_id
                ORDER BY "timestamp" DESC, inserted_at DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM opp_events
        WHERE opportunity_id IS NOT NULL
    ) t
    WHERE rn = 1
),
open_pipeline AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS pipeline_amount
    FROM latest_opp
    WHERE stage IS NOT NULL
      AND stage NOT IN ('closed_won', 'closed_lost')
),
quarter_target AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(
        TRY_CAST(json_extract_string(properties_jsonb, '$.target_amount') AS DOUBLE)
    ), 0) AS target_amount
    FROM fct_events, params p
    WHERE event_type = 'quota_set'
      AND json_extract_string(properties_jsonb, '$.fiscal_year')    = '2026'
      AND json_extract_string(properties_jsonb, '$.fiscal_quarter') = 'Q1'
      AND "timestamp" <= p.snapshot_ts
)
SELECT
    p.quarter_start,
    p.snapshot_ts,
    op.pipeline_amount,
    qt.target_amount,
    CASE WHEN qt.target_amount > 0
         THEN op.pipeline_amount / qt.target_amount
         ELSE NULL
    END AS pipeline_coverage
FROM params p
CROSS JOIN open_pipeline op
CROSS JOIN quarter_target qt;

-- Pipeline coverage = open pipeline entering the quarter / quota for the quarter
-- Assumes fiscal year aligns with calendar year; Q1 FY2026 starts 2026-01-01.
-- "Going into" = snapshot as of the day before quarter start (2025-12-31).

WITH params AS (
    SELECT
        DATE '2026-01-01' AS quarter_start,
        DATE '2025-12-31' AS snapshot_date
),
-- Reconstruct opportunity state as of snapshot_date from event stream
opp_events AS (
    SELECT
        e.event_id,
        e."timestamp",
        e.event_type,
        CAST(json_extract_string(e.properties_jsonb, '$.opportunity_id') AS VARCHAR) AS opportunity_id,
        CAST(json_extract_string(e.properties_jsonb, '$.amount')          AS DOUBLE)  AS amount,
        CAST(json_extract_string(e.properties_jsonb, '$.stage')           AS VARCHAR) AS stage,
        CAST(json_extract_string(e.properties_jsonb, '$.close_date')      AS DATE)    AS close_date,
        CAST(json_extract_string(e.properties_jsonb, '$.owner_id')        AS VARCHAR) AS owner_id,
        CAST(json_extract_string(e.properties_jsonb, '$.fiscal_year')     AS INTEGER) AS fiscal_year,
        CAST(json_extract_string(e.properties_jsonb, '$.fiscal_quarter')  AS VARCHAR) AS fiscal_quarter,
        CAST(json_extract_string(e.properties_jsonb, '$.quota')           AS DOUBLE)  AS quota
    FROM fct_events e
),
latest_opp_state AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        SELECT
            opportunity_id,
            amount,
            stage,
            close_date,
            owner_id,
            "timestamp",
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY opportunity_id
                ORDER BY "timestamp" DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM opp_events, params
        WHERE event_type IN ('opportunity_created','opportunity_updated','opportunity_stage_changed')
          AND opportunity_id IS NOT NULL
          AND "timestamp" <= params.snapshot_date + INTERVAL 1 DAY
    ) s
    WHERE rn = 1
),
open_pipeline AS (
    SELECT SUM(amount) AS pipeline_amount
    FROM latest_opp_state, params
    WHERE stage NOT IN ('Closed Won','Closed Lost')
      AND close_date >= params.quarter_start
      AND close_date <  DATE '2026-04-01'
),
quota AS (
    SELECT SUM(quota) AS quota_amount
    FROM opp_events
    WHERE event_type = 'quota_set'
      AND fiscal_year = 2026
      AND fiscal_quarter IN ('Q1','1','2026Q1')
)
SELECT
    op.pipeline_amount,
    q.quota_amount,
    CASE WHEN q.quota_amount > 0
         THEN op.pipeline_amount / q.quota_amount
    END AS pipeline_coverage
FROM open_pipeline op
CROSS JOIN quota q;

WITH q4_targets AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        CAST(json_extract_string(properties_jsonb, '$.quota') AS DOUBLE) AS quota,
        "timestamp"
    FROM fct_events
    WHERE event_type = 'quota_set'
      AND CAST(json_extract_string(properties_jsonb, '$.fiscal_year') AS INTEGER) = 2025
      AND CAST(json_extract_string(properties_jsonb, '$.fiscal_quarter') AS INTEGER) = 4
),
latest_quota AS (
    SELECT SUM(quota) AS total_quota
    FROM (
        SELECT quota,
               ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY "timestamp" DESC) AS rn
        FROM q4_targets
    )
    WHERE rn = 1
),
open_pipeline AS (
    SELECT SUM(CAST(json_extract_string(properties_jsonb, '$.amount') AS DOUBLE)) AS total_pipeline
    FROM (
        SELECT
            event_id,
            properties_jsonb,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY json_extract_string(properties_jsonb, '$.opportunity_id')
                ORDER BY "timestamp" DESC

        FROM fct_events
        WHERE event_type IN ('opportunity_created', 'opportunity_updated', 'opportunity_stage_changed')
          AND "timestamp" <= TIMESTAMP '2025-09-30 23:59:59'

    WHERE rn = 1
      AND json_extract_string(properties_jsonb, '$.stage') NOT IN ('closed_won', 'closed_lost')
      AND CAST(json_extract_string(properties_jsonb, '$.close_date') AS DATE)
          BETWEEN DATE '2025-10-01' AND DATE '2025-12-31'
)
SELECT
    op.total_pipeline,
    lq.total_quota,
    op.total_pipeline / NULLIF(lq.total_quota, 0) AS pipeline_coverage
FROM open_pipeline op
CROSS JOIN latest_quota lq;

WITH q3_end AS (
    SELECT TIMESTAMP '2025-09-30 23:59:59' AS period_end
),
latest_opportunity_state AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        event_id,
        "timestamp",
        properties_jsonb,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY customer_id
            ORDER BY "timestamp" DESC
        ) AS rn

    WHERE event_type IN ('opportunity_created', 'opportunity_updated', 'opportunity_stage_changed')
      AND "timestamp" <= q3_end.period_end
),
open_pipeline AS (

    FROM latest_opportunity_state
    WHERE rn = 1
      AND LOWER(COALESCE(json_extract_string(properties_jsonb, '$.stage'), '')) NOT IN ('closed_won', 'closed_lost', 'won', 'lost')
),
quota AS (
    SELECT
        SUM(CAST(json_extract_string(properties_jsonb, '$.quota_amount') AS DOUBLE)) AS quota_amount

      AND json_extract_string(properties_jsonb, '$.fiscal_quarter') IN ('Q4', '4')
      AND "timestamp" <= q3_end.period_end
)
SELECT
    op.pipeline_amount,
    q.quota_amount,
    op.pipeline_amount / NULLIF(q.quota_amount, 0) AS pipeline_coverage
FROM open_pipeline op
CROSS JOIN quota q;

WITH q2_end AS (

),
latest_opportunities AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,

            ORDER BY "timestamp" DESC

    FROM fct_events, q2_end

open_pipeline AS (

quota AS (

    FROM fct_events, q2_end
    WHERE event_type = 'quota_set'

      AND json_extract_string(properties_jsonb, '$.fiscal_year') = '2025'
      AND json_extract_string(properties_jsonb, '$.fiscal_quarter') = 'Q3'
)
SELECT
    open_pipeline.pipeline_amount,
    quota.quota_amount,
    open_pipeline.pipeline_amount / NULLIF(quota.quota_amount, 0) AS pipeline_coverage
FROM open_pipeline, quota;

WITH subs AS (

        s.plan,

        s.status
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
    WHERE c.is_test = false OR c.is_test IS NULL
),
-- Identify cancelled subs in Q1 2026 that are downgrades:
-- the same customer has a NEXT sub starting within 1 day of ended_at
-- with strictly lower MRR (active).
downgrades AS (
    SELECT
        old.sub_id          AS old_sub_id,
        old.customer_id,
        old.mrr             AS old_mrr,
        new.mrr             AS new_mrr,
        old.ended_at
    FROM subs old
    JOIN subs new
      ON new.customer_id = old.customer_id
     AND new.sub_id <> old.sub_id
     AND new.started_at >= old.ended_at - INTERVAL '1 day'
     AND new.started_at <= old.ended_at + INTERVAL '1 day'
     AND new.status = 'active'
    WHERE old.status = 'cancelled'
      AND old.ended_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
      AND old.ended_at <  TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01 00:00:00'
      AND COALESCE(old.mrr, 0) > 0
      AND COALESCE(new.mrr, 0) >= 0
      AND new.mrr < old.mrr
)
SELECT
    ROUND(SUM(old_mrr - new_mrr), 2) AS arr_contraction_q1_2026
FROM (
    -- collapse to one new sub per old sub (lowest MRR successor) to be safe
    SELECT old_sub_id, old_mrr, MIN(new_mrr) AS new_mrr
    FROM downgrades
    GROUP BY old_sub_id, old_mrr
) d;

WITH subs AS (
    SELECT
        s.sub_id,
        s.customer_id,
        s.plan,
        s.mrr,

    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
    WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
),
-- Identify cancelled subs in Q1 2026 and find their successor sub (if any)
cancelled_q1 AS (
    SELECT
        s.sub_id           AS old_sub_id,
        s.customer_id,
        s.mrr              AS old_mrr,
        s.ended_at         AS old_ended_at
    FROM subs s
