      AND s.ended_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01'
      AND s.ended_at <  TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01'
      AND s.mrr IS NOT NULL
      AND s.mrr > 0
),
successor AS (
    SELECT
        cq.old_sub_id,
        cq.customer_id,
        cq.old_mrr,
        n.sub_id  AS new_sub_id,
        n.mrr     AS new_mrr,
        n.started_at
    FROM cancelled_q1 cq
    LEFT JOIN subs n
      ON n.customer_id = cq.customer_id
     AND n.status IN ('active','paused','trial')
     AND n.mrr IS NOT NULL
     AND n.mrr > 0
     AND n.started_at >= cq.old_ended_at - INTERVAL '1 day'
     AND n.started_at <= cq.old_ended_at + INTERVAL '1 day'
)
SELECT
    ROUND(SUM(old_mrr - COALESCE(new_mrr, 0)), 2) AS arr_contraction_q1_2026_mrr,
    ROUND(SUM(old_mrr - COALESCE(new_mrr, 0)) * 12, 2) AS arr_contraction_q1_2026_arr
FROM successor
WHERE new_sub_id IS NOT NULL
  AND new_mrr < old_mrr;

WITH clean_subs AS (
    SELECT
        s.sub_id,
        s.customer_id,
        s.plan,
        s.mrr,
        s.started_at,
        s.ended_at,
        s.status
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
    WHERE c.is_test = FALSE
      AND s.mrr >= 0
),
cancelled_subs AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM clean_subs
    WHERE status = 'cancelled'
      AND ended_at >= TIMESTAMP '2024-10-01'
      AND ended_at <  TIMESTAMP '2025-10-01'
),
-- Identify downgrades: a next sub for same customer starting within 1 day of ended_at
classified AS (
    SELECT
        cs.sub_id,
        cs.customer_id,
        cs.mrr AS cancelled_mrr,
        cs.ended_at,
        (
            SELECT ns.mrr
            FROM clean_subs ns
            WHERE ns.customer_id = cs.customer_id
              AND ns.status = 'active'
              AND ns.started_at >= cs.ended_at - INTERVAL '1 day'
              AND ns.started_at <= cs.ended_at + INTERVAL '1 day'
              AND ns.mrr < cs.mrr
            ORDER BY ABS(EPOCH(ns.started_at - cs.ended_at))
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS next_lower_mrr
    FROM cancelled_subs cs
)
SELECT
    SUM(
        CASE
            WHEN next_lower_mrr IS NOT NULL THEN cancelled_mrr - next_lower_mrr
            ELSE cancelled_mrr
        END
    ) AS arr_contraction_fy2025
FROM classified;

WITH clean_subs AS (
    SELECT s.*
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
    WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
      AND s.mrr >= 0
),
-- Identify downgrade-cancellations: a 'cancelled' sub immediately followed
-- by a new 'active' sub for the same customer within 1 day, with lower MRR.
sub_with_next AS (
    SELECT
        s.sub_id,
        s.customer_id,
        s.plan,
        s.mrr AS old_mrr,
        s.started_at,
        s.ended_at,
        s.status,
        n.sub_id AS next_sub_id,
        n.mrr    AS new_mrr,
        n.started_at AS next_started_at,
        n.status AS next_status
    FROM clean_subs s
    LEFT JOIN clean_subs n
      ON n.customer_id = s.customer_id
     AND n.status = 'active'
     AND n.started_at >= s.ended_at
     AND n.started_at <= s.ended_at + INTERVAL 1 DAY
),
classified AS (
    SELECT
        sub_id,
        customer_id,
        old_mrr,
        new_mrr,
        ended_at,
        status,
        CASE
            WHEN status = 'cancelled' AND new_mrr IS NOT NULL AND new_mrr < old_mrr
                THEN 'downgrade'
            WHEN status = 'cancelled' AND new_mrr IS NULL
                THEN 'churn'
            ELSE 'other'
        END AS event_type,
        CASE
            WHEN status = 'cancelled' AND new_mrr IS NOT NULL AND new_mrr < old_mrr
                THEN (old_mrr - new_mrr) * 12
            WHEN status = 'cancelled' AND new_mrr IS NULL
                THEN old_mrr * 12
            ELSE 0
        END AS arr_contraction
    FROM sub_with_next
)
SELECT
    ROUND(SUM(arr_contraction), 2) AS arr_contraction_fy2025
FROM classified
WHERE ended_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01'
  AND ended_at <  TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01'
  AND event_type IN ('churn', 'downgrade');

-- ARR contraction in Q4 FY2025 (Oct 1, 2025 - Dec 31, 2025) from existing customers
-- Contraction = MRR lost from downgrades + true churn, annualized (×12)
-- Existing customers = signed up before the quarter started
-- Excludes test accounts and negative refund MRR rows

WITH q_start AS (SELECT DATE '2025-10-01' AS d),
     q_end   AS (SELECT DATE '2026-01-01' AS d),

-- Subscriptions that ended in Q4 FY2025
ended_in_q AS (
    SELECT
        s.sub_id,
        s.customer_id,
        s.mrr AS old_mrr,
        s.ended_at,
        s.status
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
    WHERE s.ended_at >= (SELECT d FROM q_start)
      AND s.ended_at <  (SELECT d FROM q_end)
      AND s.status = 'cancelled'
      AND COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
      AND c.signup_date < (SELECT d FROM q_start)  -- existing customers only
      AND s.mrr > 0  -- exclude refund/negative rows
),

-- For each ended sub, find the customer's next sub starting at/near the end date
next_sub AS (
    SELECT
        e.sub_id,
        e.customer_id,
        e.old_mrr,
        (
            SELECT n.mrr
            FROM fct_subscriptions n
            WHERE n.customer_id = e.customer_id
              AND n.status = 'active'
              AND n.mrr > 0
              AND n.started_at >= e.ended_at - INTERVAL 1 DAY
              AND n.started_at <= e.ended_at + INTERVAL 1 DAY
            ORDER BY n.started_at
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS new_mrr
    FROM ended_in_q e
),

contraction_mrr AS (
    SELECT
        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN new_mrr IS NULL THEN old_mrr                    -- true churn
                WHEN new_mrr < old_mrr THEN old_mrr - new_mrr        -- downgrade
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS mrr_contraction
    FROM next_sub
)

SELECT
    mrr_contraction AS mrr_contraction_usd,
    mrr_contraction * 12 AS arr_contraction_usd
FROM contraction_mrr;

-- ARR contraction in Q4 FY2025 (Oct-Dec 2025) from existing customers:
-- Existing customers = signed up before Q4 start (2025-10-01)
-- Contraction = MRR decreases from downgrades + true churn, annualized to ARR
-- Excludes test accounts and negative refund MRR rows

WITH q4_start AS (SELECT DATE '2025-10-01' AS d),
     q4_end   AS (SELECT DATE '2026-01-01' AS d),

-- Eligible (non-test) customers who existed before Q4 started
eligible_customers AS (
    SELECT customer_id, signup_date
    FROM dim_customers
    WHERE COALESCE(is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
      AND signup_date < (SELECT d FROM q4_start)
),

-- Subscriptions that ended during Q4 (candidates for churn or downgrade)
ended_in_q4 AS (
    SELECT s.sub_id,
           s.customer_id,
           s.mrr           AS old_mrr,
           s.ended_at,
           s.status
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    JOIN eligible_customers e ON e.customer_id = s.customer_id
    WHERE s.status = 'cancelled'
      AND s.ended_at >= (SELECT d FROM q4_start)
      AND s.ended_at <  (SELECT d FROM q4_end)
      AND s.mrr IS NOT NULL
      AND s.mrr > 0
),

-- For each ended sub, find a "next" sub that picks up within 1 day (downgrade signal)
next_sub AS (
    SELECT eq.sub_id,
           eq.customer_id,
           eq.old_mrr,
           (
               SELECT ns.mrr
               FROM fct_subscriptions ns
               WHERE ns.customer_id = eq.customer_id
                 AND ns.status = 'active'
                 AND ns.mrr IS NOT NULL
                 AND ns.mrr > 0
                 AND ns.started_at >= eq.ended_at - INTERVAL 1 DAY
                 AND ns.started_at <= eq.ended_at + INTERVAL 1 DAY
               ORDER BY ABS(EPOCH(ns.started_at) - EPOCH(eq.ended_at))
               LIMIT 1
           ) AS new_mrr
    FROM ended_in_q4 eq
),

-- Per-event MRR delta: full loss if true churn, or (old - new) if downgrade to lower MRR
contraction_events AS (
    SELECT
        CASE
            WHEN new_mrr IS NULL              THEN old_mrr           -- true churn
            WHEN new_mrr < old_mrr            THEN old_mrr - new_mrr -- downgrade
            ELSE 0                                                   -- lateral/upgrade: no contraction
        END AS mrr_lost
    FROM next_sub
)

SELECT ROUND(SUM(mrr_lost) * 12, 2) AS arr_contraction_usd
FROM contraction_events;

WITH subs AS (
    SELECT
        s.sub_id,
        s.customer_id,
        s.plan,
        s.mrr,
        s.started_at,
        s.ended_at,
        s.status
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
    WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
      AND s.mrr IS NOT NULL
      AND s.mrr >= 0
),
-- Customers existing before Q1 2026 (had a sub started before 2026-01-01)
existing_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT customer_id
    FROM subs
    WHERE started_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01'
),
-- For each cancelled sub in Q1 2026, find the next sub for same customer
-- starting within 1 day of ended_at to detect downgrades vs true churn
cancelled_q1 AS (
    SELECT
        s.customer_id,
        s.sub_id,
        s.mrr AS old_mrr,
        s.ended_at,
        (
            SELECT n.mrr
            FROM subs n
            WHERE n.customer_id = s.customer_id
              AND n.status = 'active'
              AND n.started_at >= s.ended_at
              AND n.started_at <= s.ended_at + INTERVAL '1 day'
            ORDER BY n.started_at ASC
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS next_mrr
    FROM subs s
    WHERE s.status = 'cancelled'
      AND s.ended_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01'
      AND s.ended_at <  TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01'
      AND s.customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM existing_customers)
),
-- Contraction = downgrade-cancellations: next_mrr exists and is lower than old_mrr
-- ARR contraction = (old_mrr - next_mrr) * 12
contraction AS (
    SELECT
        SUM((old_mrr - next_mrr) * 12) AS arr_contraction_usd
    FROM cancelled_q1
    WHERE next_mrr IS NOT NULL
      AND next_mrr < old_mrr
),
-- Expansion: existing customers whose active sub MRR increased in Q1 2026.
-- Detect "upgrade" pattern: a new active sub started in Q1 2026 immediately
-- after a cancelled sub of the same customer with HIGHER new mrr.
upgrades_q1 AS (
    SELECT
        s.customer_id,
        s.sub_id,
        s.mrr AS old_mrr,
        s.ended_at,
        (
            SELECT n.mrr
            FROM subs n
            WHERE n.customer_id = s.customer_id
              AND n.status = 'active'
              AND n.started_at >= s.ended_at
              AND n.started_at <= s.ended_at + INTERVAL '1 day'
            ORDER BY n.started_at ASC
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS next_mrr
    FROM subs s
    WHERE s.status = 'cancelled'
      AND s.ended_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01'
      AND s.ended_at <  TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01'
      AND s.customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM existing_customers)
),
expansion AS (
    SELECT
        SUM((next_mrr - old_mrr) * 12) AS arr_expansion_usd
    FROM upgrades_q1
    WHERE next_mrr IS NOT NULL
      AND next_mrr > old_mrr
)
SELECT
    COALESCE((SELECT arr_contraction_usd FROM contraction), 0) AS arr_contraction_usd_q1_2026,
    COALESCE((SELECT arr_expansion_usd FROM expansion), 0)     AS arr_expansion_usd_q1_2026,
    COALESCE((SELECT arr_expansion_usd FROM expansion), 0)
      - COALESCE((SELECT arr_contraction_usd FROM contraction), 0) AS net_expansion_usd_q1_2026;

WITH subs AS (
    SELECT
        s.sub_id,
        s.customer_id,
        s.plan,
        s.mrr,
        s.started_at,
        s.ended_at,
        s.status
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
    WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
      AND s.mrr IS NOT NULL
      AND s.mrr >= 0
),
-- Existing customers: signed up before Q1 2026
existing_customers AS (
    SELECT customer_id
    FROM dim_customers
    WHERE COALESCE(is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
      AND signup_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
),
-- MRR per customer active at start of Q1 2026 (Jan 1)
mrr_start AS (
    SELECT
        s.customer_id,
        SUM(s.mrr) AS mrr_amt
    FROM subs s
    WHERE s.started_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00')
    GROUP BY s.customer_id
),
-- MRR per customer active at end of Q1 2026 (Apr 1)
mrr_end AS (
    SELECT
        s.customer_id,
        SUM(s.mrr) AS mrr_amt
    FROM subs s
    WHERE s.started_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01 00:00:00'
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01 00:00:00')
    GROUP BY s.customer_id
),
-- Existing customers present at both start and end (so we measure expansion/contraction, not churn or new)
delta AS (
    SELECT
        ec.customer_id,
        COALESCE(ms.mrr_amt, 0) AS start_mrr,
        COALESCE(me.mrr_amt, 0) AS end_mrr,
        COALESCE(me.mrr_amt, 0) - COALESCE(ms.mrr_amt, 0) AS mrr_delta
    FROM existing_customers ec
    LEFT JOIN mrr_start ms ON ms.customer_id = ec.customer_id
    LEFT JOIN mrr_end   me ON me.customer_id = ec.customer_id
    WHERE COALESCE(ms.mrr_amt, 0) > 0
      AND COALESCE(me.mrr_amt, 0) > 0
)
SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN mrr_delta > 0 THEN mrr_delta ELSE 0 END) * 12 AS arr_expansion_q1_2026,
    SUM(CASE WHEN mrr_delta < 0 THEN -mrr_delta ELSE 0 END) * 12 AS arr_contraction_q1_2026,
    (SUM(CASE WHEN mrr_delta > 0 THEN mrr_delta ELSE 0 END)
     - SUM(CASE WHEN mrr_delta < 0 THEN -mrr_delta ELSE 0 END)) * 12 AS net_arr_change_q1_2026,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE mrr_delta > 0) AS expanding_customers,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE mrr_delta < 0) AS contracting_customers
FROM delta;

WITH q1_start AS (SELECT TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00' AS ts),
     q1_end   AS (SELECT TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01 00:00:00' AS ts),
-- Eligible customers: non-test, existed before Q1 (signed up before 2026-01-01)
eligible_customers AS (
    SELECT customer_id
    FROM dim_customers
    WHERE COALESCE(is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
      AND signup_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
),
-- Active subscriptions per customer at a given point in time, summing positive MRR only
mrr_at_start AS (
    SELECT s.customer_id, SUM(s.mrr) AS mrr
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    JOIN eligible_customers e ON e.customer_id = s.customer_id
    WHERE s.status IN ('active','paused')
      AND s.mrr > 0
      AND s.started_at < (SELECT ts FROM q1_start)
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= (SELECT ts FROM q1_start))
    GROUP BY s.customer_id
),
mrr_at_end AS (
    SELECT s.customer_id, SUM(s.mrr) AS mrr
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    JOIN eligible_customers e ON e.customer_id = s.customer_id
    WHERE s.status IN ('active','paused')
      AND s.mrr > 0
      AND s.started_at < (SELECT ts FROM q1_end)
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= (SELECT ts FROM q1_end))
    GROUP BY s.customer_id
),
-- Existing customers = had MRR at the start of Q1
joined AS (
    SELECT
        s.customer_id,
        s.mrr AS start_mrr,
        COALESCE(e.mrr, 0) AS end_mrr
    FROM mrr_at_start s
    LEFT JOIN mrr_at_end e ON e.customer_id = s.customer_id
)
SELECT
    SUM(GREATEST(end_mrr - start_mrr, 0)) * 12 AS arr_expansion_usd
FROM joined;

-- ARR expansion from existing customers in Q1 2026
-- Existing customer = signed up before Q1 2026 (signup_date < 2026-01-01)
-- Expansion = increase in active MRR from start to end of Q1, annualized (×12)
-- Excludes test accounts, excludes negative MRR (refund accounting)

WITH q1_start AS (SELECT DATE '2026-01-01' AS d),
     q1_end   AS (SELECT DATE '2026-04-01' AS d),

existing_customers AS (
    SELECT customer_id
    FROM dim_customers
    WHERE COALESCE(is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
      AND signup_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
),

-- MRR per existing customer active at the start of Q1 2026
mrr_start AS (
    SELECT s.customer_id, SUM(s.mrr) AS mrr_amt
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    JOIN existing_customers e ON e.customer_id = s.customer_id
    WHERE s.mrr > 0
      AND s.started_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00')
    GROUP BY s.customer_id
),

-- MRR per existing customer active at the end of Q1 2026 (just before Apr 1)
mrr_end AS (
    SELECT s.customer_id, SUM(s.mrr) AS mrr_amt
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    JOIN existing_customers e ON e.customer_id = s.customer_id
    WHERE s.mrr > 0
      AND s.started_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01 00:00:00'
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01 00:00:00')
    GROUP BY s.customer_id
),

per_customer_delta AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(s.customer_id, e.customer_id) AS customer_id,
        COALESCE(s.mrr_amt, 0) AS start_mrr,
        COALESCE(e.mrr_amt, 0) AS end_mrr,
        COALESCE(e.mrr_amt, 0) - COALESCE(s.mrr_amt, 0) AS mrr_delta
    FROM mrr_start s
    FULL OUTER JOIN mrr_end e ON s.customer_id = e.customer_id
    -- Restrict to customers who had MRR at start (existing book), not new logos in Q1
    WHERE COALESCE(s.mrr_amt, 0) > 0
)

SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN mrr_delta > 0 THEN mrr_delta ELSE 0 END) * 12 AS arr_expansion_usd
FROM per_customer_delta;

-- ARR expansion in Q4 FY2025 (Oct 1, 2025 - Dec 31, 2025)
-- Definition: For customers who were already on a paying subscription before Q4,
-- measure the increase in their MRR from start of Q4 to end of Q4, annualized (×12).
-- Excludes test accounts, excludes negative refund-accounting MRR rows,
-- excludes new logos (no pre-Q4 active sub), and only counts positive deltas (expansion).

WITH q4_start AS (SELECT TIMESTAMP '2025-10-01 00:00:00' AS ts),
     q4_end   AS (SELECT TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00' AS ts),

-- Active, non-refund subscription rows joined to non-test customers
clean_subs AS (
    SELECT s.customer_id, s.mrr, s.started_at, s.ended_at, s.status
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    INNER JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
    WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
      AND s.mrr IS NOT NULL
      AND s.mrr >= 0
),

-- MRR per customer at the moment Q4 begins (sub active as of q4_start)
mrr_at_start AS (
    SELECT customer_id, SUM(mrr) AS mrr_start
    FROM clean_subs, q4_start
    WHERE started_at < q4_start.ts
      AND (ended_at IS NULL OR ended_at > q4_start.ts)
    GROUP BY customer_id
),

-- MRR per customer at the end of Q4 (sub active as of just before q4_end)
mrr_at_end AS (
    SELECT customer_id, SUM(mrr) AS mrr_end
    FROM clean_subs, q4_end
    WHERE started_at < q4_end.ts
      AND (ended_at IS NULL OR ended_at >= q4_end.ts)
    GROUP BY customer_id
)

-- Existing-book expansion: only customers present at Q4 start,
-- summing positive MRR deltas, annualized to ARR.
SELECT
    SUM(GREATEST(COALESCE(e.mrr_end, 0) - s.mrr_start, 0)) * 12 AS arr_expansion_q4_fy2025
FROM mrr_at_start s
LEFT JOIN mrr_at_end e ON e.customer_id = s.customer_id;

-- ARR expansion in Q4 FY2025 (Oct 1, 2025 - Dec 31, 2025)
-- Existing book expansion = increase in MRR from existing (non-new) customers
-- Measured as: (end-of-quarter MRR) - (start-of-quarter MRR) for customers
-- who existed and had active subscriptions BEFORE the quarter started.
-- Annualized to ARR by multiplying by 12. Excludes test accounts and negative
-- refund-accounting MRR rows.

WITH q_start AS (SELECT TIMESTAMP '2025-10-01 00:00:00' AS ts),
     q_end   AS (SELECT TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00' AS ts),

-- Customers who are not test accounts
valid_customers AS (
    SELECT customer_id
    FROM dim_customers
    WHERE is_test IS NOT TRUE
),

-- MRR per customer at start of Q4 FY2025 (subs active on Oct 1, 2025)
mrr_start AS (
    SELECT s.customer_id, SUM(s.mrr) AS mrr_start
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    JOIN valid_customers v ON v.customer_id = s.customer_id
    WHERE s.mrr > 0
      AND s.started_at < (SELECT ts FROM q_start)
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= (SELECT ts FROM q_start))
      AND s.status IN ('active','paused','trial','cancelled')
    GROUP BY s.customer_id
),

-- MRR per customer at end of Q4 FY2025 (subs active on Dec 31, 2025)
mrr_end AS (
    SELECT s.customer_id, SUM(s.mrr) AS mrr_end
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    JOIN valid_customers v ON v.customer_id = s.customer_id
    WHERE s.mrr > 0
      AND s.started_at < (SELECT ts FROM q_end)
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= (SELECT ts FROM q_end))
      AND s.status IN ('active','paused','trial','cancelled')
    GROUP BY s.customer_id
)

-- Existing-book expansion: only customers present at BOTH start and end,
-- and only count the positive delta (true expansion, not contraction/churn).
SELECT
    SUM(GREATEST(COALESCE(e.mrr_end,0) - COALESCE(s.mrr_start,0), 0)) * 12
        AS arr_expansion_q4_fy2025
FROM mrr_start s
INNER JOIN mrr_end e USING (customer_id);

-- ARR expansion from existing customers in FY2025 (calendar year 2025).
-- "Existing customers" = customers who signed up before FY2025 start (2025-01-01).
-- Expansion = increase in active MRR between FY2025 start and FY2025 end, annualized (×12),
-- restricted to customers who were already active before FY2025 began.
-- Excludes test accounts. Filters out negative MRR (refund accounting) when measuring book size.

WITH fy_bounds AS (
    SELECT
        TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00' AS fy_start,
        TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00' AS fy_end
),
eligible_customers AS (
    -- Existing (non-test) customers who signed up before FY2025
    SELECT c.customer_id
    FROM dim_customers c, fy_bounds b
    WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
      AND c.signup_date < CAST(b.fy_start AS DATE)
),
mrr_at_start AS (
    -- Active MRR per existing customer at FY2025 start
    SELECT s.customer_id, SUM(s.mrr) AS mrr_start
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    JOIN eligible_customers e ON e.customer_id = s.customer_id
    CROSS JOIN fy_bounds b
    WHERE s.started_at < b.fy_start
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= b.fy_start)
      AND s.status IN ('active', 'trial', 'paused')
      AND s.mrr > 0
    GROUP BY s.customer_id
),
mrr_at_end AS (
    -- Active MRR per existing customer at FY2025 end
    SELECT s.customer_id, SUM(s.mrr) AS mrr_end
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    JOIN eligible_customers e ON e.customer_id = s.customer_id
    CROSS JOIN fy_bounds b
    WHERE s.started_at < b.fy_end
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= b.fy_end)
      AND s.status IN ('active', 'trial', 'paused')
      AND s.mrr > 0
    GROUP BY s.customer_id
),
per_customer_delta AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(s.customer_id, e.customer_id) AS customer_id,
        COALESCE(s.mrr_start, 0) AS mrr_start,
        COALESCE(e.mrr_end, 0)   AS mrr_end,
        COALESCE(e.mrr_end, 0) - COALESCE(s.mrr_start, 0) AS mrr_delta
    FROM mrr_at_start s
    FULL OUTER JOIN mrr_at_end e USING (customer_id)
)
SELECT
    -- ARR expansion = sum of POSITIVE MRR deltas among existing customers, annualized.
    -- Excludes contraction/churn (negative deltas) — pure expansion only.
    SUM(CASE WHEN mrr_delta > 0 AND mrr_start > 0 THEN mrr_delta ELSE 0 END) * 12 AS arr_expansion_fy2025
FROM per_customer_delta;

WITH active_customers AS (
    SELECT customer_id
    FROM dim_customers
    WHERE COALESCE(is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
),
-- Subscription state per customer at a point in time: sum of MRR for subs active on that date
mrr_at_date AS (
    SELECT
        s.customer_id,
        d.as_of_date,
        SUM(s.mrr) AS mrr
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    CROSS JOIN (
        SELECT DATE '2024-12-31' AS as_of_date
        UNION ALL
        SELECT DATE '2025-12-31'
    ) d
    JOIN active_customers ac ON ac.customer_id = s.customer_id
    WHERE s.mrr > 0
      AND s.status IN ('active', 'paused')
      AND s.started_at <= d.as_of_date
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at > d.as_of_date)
    GROUP BY s.customer_id, d.as_of_date
),
pivoted AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        MAX(CASE WHEN as_of_date = DATE '2024-12-31' THEN mrr END) AS start_mrr,
        MAX(CASE WHEN as_of_date = DATE '2025-12-31' THEN mrr END) AS end_mrr
    FROM mrr_at_date
    GROUP BY customer_id
)
SELECT
    SUM((COALESCE(end_mrr, 0) - COALESCE(start_mrr, 0)) * 12) AS arr_expansion_usd
FROM pivoted
WHERE start_mrr IS NOT NULL
  AND end_mrr IS NOT NULL
  AND end_mrr > start_mrr;

-- ARR expansion in Q3 FY2025 (calendar Q3 2025: Jul 1 - Sep 30)
-- Definition: For customers active both at the start and end of the quarter,
-- sum the positive MRR deltas (expansion only, not contraction), annualized to ARR.
-- Excludes test accounts, excludes negative refund-accounting MRR rows,
-- excludes new logos (must have been active at quarter start).

WITH quarter_bounds AS (
    SELECT
        TIMESTAMP '2025-07-01 00:00:00' AS q_start,
        TIMESTAMP '2025-10-01 00:00:00' AS q_end
),
eligible_customers AS (
    SELECT customer_id
    FROM dim_customers
    WHERE COALESCE(is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
),
-- MRR per customer at quarter start (active subs as of q_start)
mrr_start AS (
    SELECT
        s.customer_id,
        SUM(s.mrr) AS mrr_start
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    CROSS JOIN quarter_bounds q
    JOIN eligible_customers c ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
    WHERE s.started_at < q.q_start
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= q.q_start)
      AND s.mrr > 0
      AND s.status IN ('active', 'paused', 'trial', 'cancelled')
    GROUP BY s.customer_id
),
-- MRR per customer at quarter end (active subs as of q_end)
mrr_end AS (
    SELECT
        s.customer_id,
        SUM(s.mrr) AS mrr_end
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    CROSS JOIN quarter_bounds q
    JOIN eligible_customers c ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
    WHERE s.started_at < q.q_end
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= q.q_end)
      AND s.mrr > 0
      AND s.status IN ('active', 'paused', 'trial', 'cancelled')
    GROUP BY s.customer_id
)
SELECT
    SUM(GREATEST(COALESCE(e.mrr_end, 0) - s.mrr_start, 0)) * 12 AS arr_expansion_usd
FROM mrr_start s
LEFT JOIN mrr_end e ON e.customer_id = s.customer_id;

-- ARR expansion in Q3 FY2025 (calendar Q3 2025: Jul 1 - Sep 30)
-- Definition: For customers active at the start of the quarter, sum the
-- increase in MRR (annualized to ARR) between start-of-quarter and end-of-quarter.
-- Excludes test accounts. Excludes negative refund-accounting MRR rows from sums.
-- Only counts customers whose end-of-quarter MRR > start-of-quarter MRR (true expansion).

WITH q_start AS (SELECT TIMESTAMP '2025-07-01 00:00:00' AS ts),
     q_end   AS (SELECT TIMESTAMP '2025-10-01 00:00:00' AS ts),

-- MRR per customer at start of Q3 FY2025: sum of active subs at that instant
mrr_start AS (
    SELECT s.customer_id,
           SUM(s.mrr) AS mrr_amt
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    JOIN dim_customers d ON d.customer_id = s.customer_id
    WHERE COALESCE(d.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
      AND s.mrr > 0
      AND s.started_at < (SELECT ts FROM q_start)
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at > (SELECT ts FROM q_start))
    GROUP BY s.customer_id
),

-- MRR per customer at end of Q3 FY2025
mrr_end AS (
    SELECT s.customer_id,
           SUM(s.mrr) AS mrr_amt
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    JOIN dim_customers d ON d.customer_id = s.customer_id
    WHERE COALESCE(d.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
      AND s.mrr > 0
      AND s.started_at < (SELECT ts FROM q_end)
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at > (SELECT ts FROM q_end))
    GROUP BY s.customer_id
)

SELECT
    SUM((me.mrr_amt - ms.mrr_amt) * 12) AS arr_expansion_usd
FROM mrr_start ms
JOIN mrr_end me ON me.customer_id = ms.customer_id
WHERE me.mrr_amt > ms.mrr_amt;

SELECT SUM(i.amount) AS bookings_q1_2026
FROM fct_invoices i
INNER JOIN dim_customers c
  ON c.customer_id = i.customer_id
WHERE c.is_test = FALSE
  AND i.status IN ('paid', 'unpaid')
  AND i.due_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
  AND i.due_at <  TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01 00:00:00';

SELECT SUM(i.amount) AS bookings_q1_2026
FROM fct_invoices i
INNER JOIN dim_customers c
  ON c.customer_id = i.customer_id
WHERE c.is_test = FALSE
  AND i.status IN ('paid', 'refunded')

-- CAC = sales & marketing spend / new customers acquired.

    WHERE is_test = FALSE

      AND signup_date <  DATE '2026-04-01'

    CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE)                         AS cac_usd,
    'CAC requires sales & marketing spend, which is not present in dim_customers or fct_subscriptions. Denominator (new customers, excluding test accounts) shown for reference.' AS note
FROM new_customers;

WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        c.customer_id,
        c.churned_at,
        c.signup_date
    FROM dim_customers c
    WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
      AND c.signup_date < DATE '2026-04-01'
      AND (c.churned_at IS NULL OR c.churned_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01')
),
agg AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(*) AS at_risk,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE churned_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01'
              AND churned_at <  TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01'
        ) AS churned
    FROM base
)
SELECT
    at_risk,
    churned,
    churned * 1.0 / NULLIF(at_risk, 0) AS churn_rate
FROM agg;

WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        c.customer_id,
        c.churned_at,
        c.signup_date
    FROM dim_customers c
    WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
      AND c.signup_date < DATE '2026-04-01'
      AND (c.churned_at IS NULL OR c.churned_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01')
),
agg AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(*) AS active_at_period_start,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE churned_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01'
              AND churned_at <  TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01'
        ) AS churned_in_q1
    FROM base
)
SELECT
    churned_in_q1,
    active_at_period_start,
    CAST(churned_in_q1 AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(active_at_period_start, 0) AS churn_rate
FROM agg;

WITH q4_bounds AS (
    SELECT DATE '2025-10-01' AS period_start,
           DATE '2026-01-01' AS period_end
),
-- Customers at risk: existed before the period started and were not already churned
at_risk AS (
    SELECT c.customer_id
    FROM dim_customers c, q4_bounds b
    WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
      AND c.signup_date < b.period_end
      AND (c.churned_at IS NULL OR c.churned_at >= b.period_start)
),
-- True churn at customer grain: churned_at within Q4
-- Exclude downgrade-cancellations by checking subscription-level signal
churned_subs AS (
    SELECT s.sub_id,
           s.customer_id,
           s.ended_at,
           s.mrr,
           -- detect downgrade: next sub starts within 1 day with lower mrr and is active
           CASE WHEN EXISTS (
               SELECT 1
               FROM fct_subscriptions s2
               WHERE s2.customer_id = s.customer_id
                 AND s2.status = 'active'
                 AND s2.started_at >= s.ended_at
                 AND s2.started_at <= s.ended_at + INTERVAL '1 day'
                 AND COALESCE(s2.mrr, 0) < COALESCE(s.mrr, 0)
           ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS is_downgrade
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    WHERE s.status = 'cancelled'
      AND s.ended_at IS NOT NULL
),
true_churn_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_id
    FROM dim_customers c, q4_bounds b
    WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
      AND c.churned_at >= b.period_start
      AND c.churned_at < b.period_end
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM churned_subs cs
          WHERE cs.customer_id = c.customer_id
            AND cs.is_downgrade = 0
      )
)
SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM true_churn_customers)::DOUBLE
        / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM at_risk), 0) AS churn_rate_q4_fy2025,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM true_churn_customers) AS churned_customers,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM at_risk) AS at_risk_customers
;

WITH q4_bounds AS (
    SELECT DATE '2025-10-01' AS period_start, DATE '2026-01-01' AS period_end
),
active_at_start AS (
    SELECT c.customer_id
    FROM dim_customers c, q4_bounds b
    WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
      AND c.signup_date < b.period_start
      AND (c.churned_at IS NULL OR c.churned_at >= b.period_start)
),
churned_in_q4 AS (
    SELECT c.customer_id
    FROM dim_customers c, q4_bounds b
    WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
      AND c.churned_at >= b.period_start
      AND c.churned_at <  b.period_end
      AND c.signup_date < b.period_start
)
SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM churned_in_q4)::DOUBLE
  / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM active_at_start), 0) AS churn_rate_q4_fy2025,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM churned_in_q4)            AS churned_customers,
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM active_at_start)          AS customers_at_period_start;

WITH fy_start AS (SELECT DATE '2025-01-01' AS d),
fy_end AS (SELECT DATE '2025-12-31' AS d),
base AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM dim_customers
    WHERE COALESCE(is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
      AND signup_date <= (SELECT d FROM fy_end)
      AND (churned_at IS NULL OR churned_at >= (SELECT d FROM fy_start))
),
churned AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS n
    FROM base
    WHERE churned_at >= (SELECT d FROM fy_start)
      AND churned_at <  DATE '2026-01-01'
),
at_risk AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM base
)
SELECT
    churned.n                                  AS churned_customers,
    at_risk.n                                  AS at_risk_customers,
    churned.n * 1.0 / NULLIF(at_risk.n, 0)     AS churn_rate_fy2025
FROM churned, at_risk;

WITH fy_start AS (SELECT DATE '2025-01-01' AS s, DATE '2026-01-01' AS e),
active_at_start AS (
    SELECT customer_id
    FROM dim_customers, fy_start
    WHERE is_test = FALSE
      AND signup_date < fy_start.s
      AND (churned_at IS NULL OR churned_at >= fy_start.s)
),
churned_in_fy AS (

    FROM dim_customers c, fy_start
    WHERE c.is_test = FALSE
      AND c.signup_date < fy_start.e
      AND c.churned_at >= fy_start.s
      AND c.churned_at < fy_start.e
)
SELECT
    (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM churned_in_fy)::DOUBLE
    / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM active_at_start), 0) AS churn_rate_fy2025;

WITH base AS (

        c.customer_id,
        c.churned_at,
        c.signup_date

SELECT

    CAST(churned_in_fy2024 AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF(active_at_start_or_joined, 0) AS churn_rate_fy2024

WITH eligible AS (

        customer_id,
        signup_date,
        churned_at

churned_in_fy2024 AS (

      AND churned_at <  TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00'

-- Gross Revenue Retention (GRR) for Q1 2026
-- GRR = (Starting MRR - Churn MRR - Downgrade MRR) / Starting MRR
-- Excludes test accounts, expansion not credited (gross, not net)

WITH period AS (
    SELECT
        TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00' AS period_start,
        TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01 00:00:00' AS period_end
),
-- Eligible (non-test) customers
eligible_customers AS (
    SELECT customer_id
    FROM dim_customers
    WHERE COALESCE(is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
),
-- Subscriptions active at the start of the period (Jan 1, 2026)
starting_subs AS (
    SELECT
        s.sub_id,
        s.customer_id,
        s.mrr,
        s.started_at,
        s.ended_at,
        s.status
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    JOIN eligible_customers c ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
    CROSS JOIN period p
    WHERE s.started_at < p.period_start
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= p.period_start)
      AND COALESCE(s.mrr, 0) > 0  -- exclude refund/negative rows from base
),
starting_mrr AS (
    SELECT SUM(mrr) AS starting_mrr
    FROM starting_subs
),
-- Subs from the starting cohort that ended (cancelled) during Q1 2026
ended_in_period AS (
    SELECT
        ss.sub_id,
        ss.customer_id,
        ss.mrr AS starting_sub_mrr,
        ss.ended_at
    FROM starting_subs ss
    CROSS JOIN period p
    WHERE ss.status = 'cancelled'
      AND ss.ended_at >= p.period_start
      AND ss.ended_at <  p.period_end
),
-- For each ended sub, find a successor sub (downgrade scenario):
-- next sub for same customer that starts within 1 day of the prior sub's ended_at
successors AS (
    SELECT
        e.sub_id AS prior_sub_id,
        e.customer_id,
        e.starting_sub_mrr,
        ns.mrr AS successor_mrr,
        ns.status AS successor_status,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY e.sub_id
            ORDER BY ns.started_at
        ) AS rn
    FROM ended_in_period e
    LEFT JOIN fct_subscriptions ns
      ON ns.customer_id = e.customer_id
     AND ns.status = 'active'
     AND ns.started_at >= e.ended_at
     AND ns.started_at <= e.ended_at + INTERVAL 1 DAY
     AND COALESCE(ns.mrr, 0) > 0
),
classified AS (
    SELECT
        prior_sub_id,
        starting_sub_mrr,
        successor_mrr
    FROM successors
    WHERE rn = 1 OR rn IS NULL
),
-- Pure churn: no qualifying successor -> lose full starting MRR
-- Downgrade: successor exists with lower MRR -> lose the delta
losses AS (
    SELECT
        SUM(CASE WHEN successor_mrr IS NULL
                 THEN starting_sub_mrr ELSE 0 END) AS churn_mrr,
        SUM(CASE WHEN successor_mrr IS NOT NULL
                  AND successor_mrr < starting_sub_mrr
                 THEN starting_sub_mrr - successor_mrr ELSE 0 END) AS downgrade_mrr
    FROM classified
)
SELECT
    sm.starting_mrr,
    l.churn_mrr,
    l.downgrade_mrr,
    (sm.starting_mrr - COALESCE(l.churn_mrr,0) - COALESCE(l.downgrade_mrr,0))
        / NULLIF(sm.starting_mrr, 0) AS gross_revenue_retention
FROM starting_mrr sm
CROSS JOIN losses l;

-- Gross Revenue Retention (GRR) for Q1 2026:
-- GRR = (Starting MRR - Churn MRR - Downgrade MRR) / Starting MRR
-- Excludes test accounts, excludes negative refund MRR rows, excludes expansion.
-- Distinguishes true churn (cancelled with no follow-on sub) from downgrade-cancellations
-- (cancelled sub immediately followed by a lower-MRR active sub for same customer).

WITH period AS (
    SELECT
        TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00' AS period_start,
        TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01 00:00:00' AS period_end
),
-- Eligible customers: not test accounts
eligible_customers AS (
    SELECT customer_id
    FROM dim_customers
    WHERE COALESCE(is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
),
-- Subscriptions active at period start (started before, not yet ended)
starting_subs AS (
    SELECT
        s.sub_id,
        s.customer_id,
        s.mrr,
        s.started_at,
        s.ended_at,
        s.status
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    JOIN eligible_customers c USING (customer_id)
    CROSS JOIN period p
    WHERE s.started_at < p.period_start
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= p.period_start)
      AND s.mrr IS NOT NULL
      AND s.mrr > 0
),
starting_mrr AS (
    SELECT SUM(mrr) AS starting_mrr
    FROM starting_subs
),
-- For each starting sub, find a follow-on sub (same customer, started within 1 day of this sub's ended_at)
-- to identify downgrade-cancellations vs true churn.
sub_outcomes AS (
    SELECT
        ss.sub_id,
        ss.customer_id,
        ss.mrr AS starting_mrr,
        ss.ended_at,
        ss.status,
        (
            SELECT ns.mrr
            FROM fct_subscriptions ns
            WHERE ns.customer_id = ss.customer_id
              AND ns.sub_id <> ss.sub_id
              AND ns.status = 'active'
              AND ns.mrr IS NOT NULL
              AND ns.mrr > 0
              AND ns.started_at >= ss.ended_at - INTERVAL 1 DAY
              AND ns.started_at <= ss.ended_at + INTERVAL 1 DAY
            ORDER BY ABS(EPOCH(ns.started_at - ss.ended_at))
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS followon_mrr
    FROM starting_subs ss
    CROSS JOIN period p
    WHERE ss.status = 'cancelled'
      AND ss.ended_at >= p.period_start
      AND ss.ended_at < p.period_end
),
-- True churn: cancelled in period with no follow-on active sub -> lose full MRR
-- Downgrade: cancelled in period with lower-MRR follow-on -> lose the delta
losses AS (
    SELECT
        SUM(CASE WHEN followon_mrr IS NULL THEN starting_mrr ELSE 0 END) AS churn_mrr,
        SUM(CASE WHEN followon_mrr IS NOT NULL AND followon_mrr < starting_mrr
                 THEN starting_mrr - followon_mrr ELSE 0 END) AS downgrade_mrr
    FROM sub_outcomes
)
SELECT
    sm.starting_mrr,
    COALESCE(l.churn_mrr, 0) AS churn_mrr,
    COALESCE(l.downgrade_mrr, 0) AS downgrade_mrr,
    (sm.starting_mrr - COALESCE(l.churn_mrr, 0) - COALESCE(l.downgrade_mrr, 0))
        / NULLIF(sm.starting_mrr, 0) AS gross_revenue_retention
FROM starting_mrr sm
CROSS JOIN losses l;

WITH starting_mrr AS (
    -- MRR at start of FY2025 (Jan 1, 2025): subs active as of that date
    SELECT 
        s.customer_id,
        SUM(s.mrr) AS start_mrr
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
    WHERE c.is_test = FALSE
      AND s.mrr > 0
      AND s.started_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01'
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01')
    GROUP BY s.customer_id
),
-- Identify true churns vs downgrade-cancellations during FY2025
cancellations AS (
    SELECT
        s.sub_id,
        s.customer_id,
        s.mrr AS cancelled_mrr,
        s.ended_at,
        -- find a follow-on active sub starting within 1 day of cancellation
        (SELECT MIN(s2.mrr)
         FROM fct_subscriptions s2
         WHERE s2.customer_id = s.customer_id
           AND s2.status = 'active'
           AND s2.started_at >= s.ended_at
           AND s2.started_at <= s.ended_at + INTERVAL 1 DAY
        ) AS next_active_mrr
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
    WHERE c.is_test = FALSE
      AND s.status = 'cancelled'
      AND s.mrr > 0
      AND s.ended_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01'
      AND s.ended_at <  TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01'
),
revenue_lost AS (
    -- True churn: full MRR lost. Downgrade: only the delta is lost.
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN next_active_mrr IS NULL THEN cancelled_mrr           -- true churn
                ELSE GREATEST(cancelled_mrr - next_active_mrr, 0)         -- downgrade delta
            END
        ) AS lost_mrr
    FROM cancellations
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
-- Restrict losses to the starting cohort (GRR ignores new-customer churn)
cohort_losses AS (
    SELECT 
        sm.customer_id,
        sm.start_mrr,
        COALESCE(rl.lost_mrr, 0) AS lost_mrr
    FROM starting_mrr sm
    LEFT JOIN revenue_lost rl ON rl.customer_id = sm.customer_id
)
SELECT
    SUM(start_mrr)                                      AS starting_mrr,
    SUM(LEAST(lost_mrr, start_mrr))                     AS revenue_lost,
    SUM(start_mrr) - SUM(LEAST(lost_mrr, start_mrr))    AS retained_mrr,
    (SUM(start_mrr) - SUM(LEAST(lost_mrr, start_mrr))) 
        / NULLIF(SUM(start_mrr), 0)                     AS gross_retention
FROM cohort_losses;

WITH start_of_period AS (
    SELECT DATE '2025-10-01' AS period_start,
           DATE '2026-01-01' AS period_end
),
-- Customers with active MRR at the start of the period (excluding test accounts)
cohort AS (
    SELECT
        s.customer_id,
        SUM(s.mrr) AS starting_mrr
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
    CROSS JOIN start_of_period p
    WHERE c.is_test = FALSE
      AND s.status = 'active'
      AND s.mrr > 0
      AND s.started_at < p.period_start
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= p.period_start)
    GROUP BY s.customer_id
),
-- Identify true-churn cancellations within the period (exclude downgrades)
cancellations AS (
    SELECT
        s.sub_id,
        s.customer_id,
        s.mrr AS cancelled_mrr,
        s.ended_at
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
    CROSS JOIN start_of_period p
    WHERE c.is_test = FALSE
      AND s.status = 'cancelled'
      AND s.mrr > 0
      AND s.ended_at >= p.period_start
      AND s.ended_at <  p.period_end
),
-- Detect downgrade replacements: a new active sub starting within 1 day of the cancelled sub's ended_at, lower MRR
downgrades AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT can.sub_id
    FROM cancellations can
    JOIN fct_subscriptions nxt
      ON nxt.customer_id = can.customer_id
     AND nxt.status = 'active'
     AND nxt.mrr > 0
     AND nxt.mrr < can.cancelled_mrr
     AND nxt.started_at >= can.ended_at - INTERVAL 1 DAY
     AND nxt.started_at <= can.ended_at + INTERVAL 1 DAY
),
true_churn AS (
    SELECT
        can.customer_id,
        SUM(can.cancelled_mrr) AS churned_mrr
    FROM cancellations can
    LEFT JOIN downgrades d ON d.sub_id = can.sub_id
    WHERE d.sub_id IS NULL
      -- Only count churn for customers in the starting cohort
      AND can.customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM cohort)
    GROUP BY can.customer_id
)
SELECT
    ROUND(
        (SUM(co.starting_mrr) - COALESCE(SUM(tc.churned_mrr), 0))
        / NULLIF(SUM(co.starting_mrr), 0),
    4) AS gross_retention,
    SUM(co.starting_mrr) AS starting_mrr,
    COALESCE(SUM(tc.churned_mrr), 0) AS churned_mrr
FROM cohort co
LEFT JOIN true_churn tc ON tc.customer_id = co.customer_id;

-- Gross retention for Q3 FY2025 (Jul 1 2025 - Sep 30 2025)
-- Definition: MRR retained from customers active at start of period,
-- excluding upgrades. Downgrade-cancellations are NOT churn (they continue
-- at lower MRR). True churn = cancelled with no continuing sub.
-- Gross retention = (Starting MRR - churned MRR - downgrade delta) / Starting MRR

WITH period AS (
    SELECT
        TIMESTAMP '2025-07-01 00:00:00' AS period_start,
        TIMESTAMP '2025-10-01 00:00:00' AS period_end
),
-- Eligible customers: exclude test accounts
eligible_customers AS (
    SELECT customer_id
    FROM dim_customers
    WHERE is_test IS NOT TRUE
),
-- Subscriptions active at the start of the period (the cohort)
starting_subs AS (
    SELECT
        s.sub_id,
        s.customer_id,
        s.mrr AS starting_mrr,
        s.started_at,
        s.ended_at,
        s.status
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    JOIN eligible_customers c USING (customer_id)
    CROSS JOIN period p
    WHERE s.started_at < p.period_start
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= p.period_start)
      AND s.mrr > 0  -- exclude refund-accounting negatives
      AND s.status IN ('active', 'cancelled', 'paused')  -- exclude trials
),
-- For each starting sub, find a "successor" sub: same customer, started
-- within 1 day of this sub's ended_at, lower MRR => downgrade-cancellation.
starting_with_successor AS (
    SELECT
        ss.sub_id,
        ss.customer_id,
        ss.starting_mrr,
        ss.ended_at,
        ss.status,
        -- successor sub MRR (if any) — same customer, starts at ended_at within 1 day
        (
            SELECT n.mrr
            FROM fct_subscriptions n
            WHERE n.customer_id = ss.customer_id
              AND n.sub_id <> ss.sub_id
              AND n.status = 'active'
              AND n.mrr > 0
              AND ss.ended_at IS NOT NULL
              AND n.started_at >= ss.ended_at - INTERVAL 1 DAY
              AND n.started_at <= ss.ended_at + INTERVAL 1 DAY
            ORDER BY ABS(EPOCH(n.started_at - ss.ended_at))
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS successor_mrr
    FROM starting_subs ss
),
-- Classify each starting sub's contribution loss during the period
classified AS (
    SELECT
        sub_id,
        starting_mrr,
        CASE
            -- Sub ended within the period
            WHEN ended_at IS NOT NULL
                 AND ended_at >= (SELECT period_start FROM period)
                 AND ended_at <  (SELECT period_end   FROM period)
            THEN
                CASE
                    -- Downgrade-cancellation: successor active with lower MRR
                    WHEN successor_mrr IS NOT NULL AND successor_mrr < starting_mrr
                        THEN starting_mrr - successor_mrr  -- downgrade delta (counts against gross retention)
                    -- Successor at same/higher MRR => no loss (not churn, not downgrade)
                    WHEN successor_mrr IS NOT NULL AND successor_mrr >= starting_mrr
                        THEN 0
                    -- True churn: no successor
                    ELSE starting_mrr
                END
            ELSE 0  -- still active at period end (or ended after) => no loss
        END AS mrr_lost
    FROM starting_with_successor
)
SELECT
    ROUND(SUM(starting_mrr), 2)                                    AS starting_mrr,
    ROUND(SUM(mrr_lost), 2)                                        AS mrr_lost_to_churn_and_downgrade,
    ROUND((SUM(starting_mrr) - SUM(mrr_lost)) / SUM(starting_mrr), 4) AS gross_retention
FROM classified;

WITH paid_invoices AS (
    SELECT
        i.customer_id,
        i.amount
    FROM fct_invoices i
    INNER JOIN dim_customers c
        ON c.customer_id = i.customer_id
    WHERE c.is_test = FALSE
      AND i.status = 'paid'
      AND CASE
            WHEN i.processor = 'legacy_braintree'
                THEN (i.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York') AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'
            ELSE i.paid_at
          END >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00'
      AND CASE
            WHEN i.processor = 'legacy_braintree'
                THEN (i.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York') AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'
            ELSE i.paid_at
          END < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
),
revenue_per_customer AS (

        SUM(amount) AS total_revenue
    FROM paid_invoices

SELECT

    COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id)     AS paying_customers_fy2025,

        / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id), 0) AS ltv_fy2025
FROM revenue_per_customer;

WITH paid_invoices AS (

WITH paid_invoices_2024 AS (

SELECT

WITH active_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT s.customer_id
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
    WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
      AND s.started_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01'
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01')
),
monthly_arpu AS (
    -- Average MRR per active customer during FY2025
    SELECT
        AVG(s.mrr) AS arpu
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
    WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
      AND s.mrr > 0
      AND s.status IN ('active', 'paused', 'trial', 'cancelled')
      AND s.started_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01'
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01')
),
churn AS (
    -- FY2025 monthly churn rate at the customer grain
    SELECT
        COUNT(DISTINCT CASE
            WHEN c.churned_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01'
             AND c.churned_at <  TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01'
            THEN c.customer_id END)::DOUBLE
        / NULLIF((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM active_customers), 0)
        / 12.0 AS monthly_churn_rate
    FROM dim_customers c
    WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
)
SELECT
    (SELECT arpu FROM monthly_arpu)                                       AS avg_monthly_arpu_usd,
    (SELECT monthly_churn_rate FROM churn)                                AS monthly_churn_rate,
    0.75                                                                  AS gross_margin,
    ((SELECT arpu FROM monthly_arpu) * 0.75)
        / NULLIF((SELECT monthly_churn_rate FROM churn), 0)               AS ltv_usd
FROM (SELECT 1) t;

WITH active_customers AS (
    SELECT
        s.customer_id,
        SUM(s.mrr) AS customer_mrr
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    INNER JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
    WHERE c.is_test = FALSE
      AND s.status = 'active'
      AND s.mrr > 0
      AND s.started_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01'
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01')
    GROUP BY s.customer_id
),
fy2025_churn AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS churned_customers
    FROM dim_customers c
    WHERE c.is_test = FALSE
      AND c.churned_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01'
      AND c.churned_at <  TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01'
),
fy2025_active_base AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s.customer_id) AS active_customers
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    INNER JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
    WHERE c.is_test = FALSE
      AND s.status = 'active'
      AND s.mrr > 0
      AND s.started_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01'
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01')
),
metrics AS (
    SELECT
        AVG(customer_mrr) AS arpu_monthly,
        (SELECT churned_customers FROM fy2025_churn)::DOUBLE
            / NULLIF((SELECT active_customers FROM fy2025_active_base), 0) AS monthly_churn_rate
    FROM active_customers
)
SELECT
    arpu_monthly,
    monthly_churn_rate,
    0.75 AS gross_margin,
    (arpu_monthly * 0.75) / NULLIF(monthly_churn_rate, 0) AS ltv
FROM metrics;

     AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= (m.month_start + INTERVAL 1 MONTH))

WITH period AS (
    SELECT
        DATE '2026-01-01' AS period_start,
        DATE '2026-04-01' AS period_end,
        DATE '2025-10-01' AS prior_start,
        DATE '2026-01-01' AS prior_end
),
eligible_customers AS (
    -- Customers active at the start of Q1 2026 (cohort base)
    SELECT DISTINCT s.customer_id
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    JOIN dim_customers d ON d.customer_id = s.customer_id
    CROSS JOIN period p
    WHERE COALESCE(d.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
      AND s.started_at < p.period_start
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= p.period_start)
      AND s.status IN ('active', 'paused', 'cancelled')
      AND s.mrr > 0
),
starting_mrr AS (
    -- MRR at start of Q1 2026 for the cohort
    SELECT SUM(s.mrr) AS mrr_start
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    JOIN eligible_customers e ON e.customer_id = s.customer_id
    CROSS JOIN period p
    WHERE s.started_at < p.period_start
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= p.period_start)
      AND s.mrr > 0
),
ending_mrr AS (
    -- MRR at end of Q1 2026 from the SAME cohort only (no new logos)
    SELECT SUM(s.mrr) AS mrr_end
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    JOIN eligible_customers e ON e.customer_id = s.customer_id
    CROSS JOIN period p
    WHERE s.started_at < p.period_end
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= p.period_end)
      AND s.mrr > 0
)
SELECT
    (SELECT mrr_start FROM starting_mrr) AS starting_mrr,
    (SELECT mrr_end   FROM ending_mrr)   AS ending_mrr,
    (SELECT mrr_end FROM ending_mrr) * 1.0 / NULLIF((SELECT mrr_start FROM starting_mrr), 0) AS net_revenue_retention;

WITH cohort AS (
    -- Customers active at start of Q1 2026 (2026-01-01)
    SELECT DISTINCT s.customer_id
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
    WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
      AND s.started_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01'
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01')
      AND s.status IN ('active', 'paused', 'cancelled')
      AND s.mrr >= 0
),
start_mrr AS (
    SELECT s.customer_id, SUM(s.mrr) AS mrr_start
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    JOIN cohort co ON co.customer_id = s.customer_id
    WHERE s.started_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01'
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01')
      AND s.status IN ('active', 'paused', 'cancelled')
      AND s.mrr >= 0
    GROUP BY s.customer_id
),
end_mrr AS (
    SELECT s.customer_id, SUM(s.mrr) AS mrr_end
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    JOIN cohort co ON co.customer_id = s.customer_id
    WHERE s.started_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01'
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01')
      AND s.status IN ('active', 'paused')
      AND s.mrr >= 0
    GROUP BY s.customer_id
)
SELECT
    SUM(COALESCE(e.mrr_end, 0)) / NULLIF(SUM(s.mrr_start), 0) AS net_revenue_retention_q1_2026,
    SUM(s.mrr_start) AS starting_mrr,
    SUM(COALESCE(e.mrr_end, 0)) AS ending_mrr_from_cohort
FROM start_mrr s
LEFT JOIN end_mrr e ON e.customer_id = s.customer_id;

WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        s.customer_id,
        s.mrr,
        s.started_at,
        s.ended_at,
        s.status
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
    WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
      AND s.mrr IS NOT NULL
      AND s.mrr >= 0
),
-- Customers active at start of FY2025 (Jan 1, 2025) form the cohort
cohort AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT customer_id
    FROM base
    WHERE started_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01'
      AND (ended_at IS NULL OR ended_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01')
      AND status IN ('active', 'paused', 'cancelled')
),
-- Starting MRR: sum of MRR for cohort customers' subscriptions active on Jan 1, 2025
starting_mrr AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(b.mrr), 0) AS total_mrr
    FROM base b
    JOIN cohort co ON co.customer_id = b.customer_id
    WHERE b.started_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01'
      AND (b.ended_at IS NULL OR b.ended_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01')
),
-- Ending MRR: sum of MRR for SAME cohort customers' subscriptions active on Dec 31, 2025
-- This captures expansion, contraction (downgrades), and churn from the original cohort
ending_mrr AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(b.mrr), 0) AS total_mrr
    FROM base b
    JOIN cohort co ON co.customer_id = b.customer_id
    WHERE b.started_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01'
      AND (b.ended_at IS NULL OR b.ended_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01')
)
SELECT
    starting_mrr.total_mrr AS starting_mrr_fy2025,
    ending_mrr.total_mrr   AS ending_mrr_fy2025,
    CASE
        WHEN starting_mrr.total_mrr = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE ending_mrr.total_mrr / starting_mrr.total_mrr
    END AS net_revenue_retention_fy2025
FROM starting_mrr, ending_mrr;

WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        s.customer_id,
        s.mrr,
        s.started_at,
        s.ended_at,
        s.status
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
    WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
),
fy_start AS (SELECT TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00' AS d),
fy_end   AS (SELECT TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00' AS d),
-- Cohort: customers with active revenue at the start of FY2025
starting_cohort AS (
    SELECT
        b.customer_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN b.mrr > 0 THEN b.mrr ELSE 0 END) AS starting_mrr
    FROM base b, fy_start fs
    WHERE b.started_at < fs.d
      AND (b.ended_at IS NULL OR b.ended_at > fs.d)
      AND b.status IN ('active','paused','cancelled')
    GROUP BY b.customer_id
    HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN b.mrr > 0 THEN b.mrr ELSE 0 END) > 0
),
-- Ending MRR for those same customers at end of FY2025
ending_cohort AS (
    SELECT
        b.customer_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN b.mrr > 0 THEN b.mrr ELSE 0 END) AS ending_mrr
    FROM base b, fy_end fe
    WHERE b.started_at < fe.d
      AND (b.ended_at IS NULL OR b.ended_at >= fe.d)
      AND b.status IN ('active','paused')
      AND b.customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM starting_cohort)
    GROUP BY b.customer_id
)
SELECT
    SUM(sc.starting_mrr)                                AS starting_mrr,
    COALESCE(SUM(ec.ending_mrr), 0)                     AS ending_mrr,
    COALESCE(SUM(ec.ending_mrr), 0) / SUM(sc.starting_mrr) AS net_revenue_retention
FROM starting_cohort sc
LEFT JOIN ending_cohort ec USING (customer_id);

WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        s.customer_id,
        s.sub_id,
        s.mrr,
        s.status,
        s.started_at,
        s.ended_at
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
    WHERE c.is_test = FALSE
      AND s.mrr >= 0
),
-- Customers active at start of FY2025 (Jan 1, 2025)
start_cohort AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        SUM(mrr) AS starting_mrr
    FROM base
    WHERE started_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01'
      AND (ended_at IS NULL OR ended_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01')
      AND status IN ('active','cancelled','paused')
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
-- For each cancelled sub in FY2025, detect downgrade (next sub starts within 1 day with lower MRR)
cancelled_subs AS (
    SELECT
        b.customer_id,
        b.sub_id,
        b.mrr AS cancelled_mrr,
        b.ended_at,
        (
            SELECT b2.mrr
            FROM base b2
            WHERE b2.customer_id = b.customer_id
              AND b2.status = 'active'
              AND b2.started_at >= b.ended_at
              AND b2.started_at <= b.ended_at + INTERVAL 1 DAY
            ORDER BY b2.started_at
            LIMIT 1
        ) AS next_active_mrr
    FROM base b
    WHERE b.status = 'cancelled'
      AND b.ended_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01'
      AND b.ended_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01'
),
-- End-of-FY2025 MRR for the starting cohort customers
end_cohort AS (
    SELECT
        b.customer_id,
        SUM(b.mrr) AS ending_mrr
    FROM base b
    WHERE b.customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM start_cohort)
      AND b.started_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01'
      AND (b.ended_at IS NULL OR b.ended_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01')
      AND b.status IN ('active','paused')
    GROUP BY b.customer_id
),
agg AS (
    SELECT
        (SELECT SUM(starting_mrr) FROM start_cohort) AS starting_mrr,
        (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ending_mrr),0) FROM end_cohort) AS ending_mrr_net
)
SELECT
    starting_mrr,
    ending_mrr_net,
    ending_mrr_net / NULLIF(starting_mrr, 0) AS net_retention_fy2025
FROM agg;

WITH base_customers AS (
    -- Customers active at the start of FY2025 (Jan 1, 2025): had a subscription
    -- that started before 2025-01-01 and was still active at that date.
    SELECT DISTINCT s.customer_id
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
    WHERE c.is_test = false
      AND s.started_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01'
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01')
      AND COALESCE(s.mrr, 0) > 0
),
-- Starting MRR: sum of positive MRR for those customers' subs active at FY start
starting_mrr AS (
    SELECT SUM(s.mrr) AS start_mrr
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    JOIN base_customers b ON b.customer_id = s.customer_id
    WHERE s.started_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01'
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01')
      AND s.mrr > 0
),
-- Identify downgrade-cancellations: a 'cancelled' sub whose ended_at is followed
-- (within 1 day) by another 'active' sub for the same customer.
downgrade_cancels AS (
    SELECT s1.sub_id
    FROM fct_subscriptions s1
    WHERE s1.status = 'cancelled'
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1 FROM fct_subscriptions s2
          WHERE s2.customer_id = s1.customer_id
            AND s2.status = 'active'
            AND s2.started_at >= s1.ended_at
            AND s2.started_at <= s1.ended_at + INTERVAL '1 day'
      )
),
-- Ending MRR for the base cohort: sum of positive MRR from their subs active at FY end (2025-12-31)
ending_mrr AS (
    SELECT SUM(s.mrr) AS end_mrr
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    JOIN base_customers b ON b.customer_id = s.customer_id
    WHERE s.started_at <= TIMESTAMP '2025-12-31'
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at > TIMESTAMP '2025-12-31')
      AND s.mrr > 0
)
SELECT
    (SELECT start_mrr FROM starting_mrr)                              AS starting_mrr,
    (SELECT end_mrr FROM ending_mrr)                                  AS ending_mrr_from_cohort,
    (SELECT end_mrr FROM ending_mrr) / (SELECT start_mrr FROM starting_mrr) AS net_retention;

WITH q4_start AS (SELECT DATE '2025-10-01' AS d),
q4_end AS (SELECT DATE '2025-12-31' AS d),
prior_start AS (SELECT DATE '2025-07-01' AS d),
prior_end AS (SELECT DATE '2025-09-30' AS d),
eligible_customers AS (
    SELECT c.customer_id
    FROM dim_customers c
    WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
),
-- MRR active at end of prior quarter (cohort): customers with active sub spanning prior_end
cohort_mrr AS (
    SELECT s.customer_id,
           SUM(CASE WHEN s.mrr > 0 THEN s.mrr ELSE 0 END) AS start_mrr
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    JOIN eligible_customers e ON e.customer_id = s.customer_id
    WHERE s.started_at <= (SELECT d FROM prior_end) + INTERVAL 1 DAY
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at > (SELECT d FROM prior_end))
      AND s.status IN ('active','paused','cancelled')
    GROUP BY s.customer_id
    HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN s.mrr > 0 THEN s.mrr ELSE 0 END) > 0
),
-- MRR from the SAME cohort, active at end of Q4
end_mrr AS (
    SELECT s.customer_id,
           SUM(CASE WHEN s.mrr > 0 THEN s.mrr ELSE 0 END) AS end_mrr
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    WHERE s.customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM cohort_mrr)
      AND s.started_at <= (SELECT d FROM q4_end) + INTERVAL 1 DAY
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at > (SELECT d FROM q4_end))
      AND s.status IN ('active','paused','cancelled')
    GROUP BY s.customer_id
)
SELECT
    SUM(c.start_mrr) AS starting_mrr,
    SUM(COALESCE(e.end_mrr, 0)) AS ending_mrr_from_cohort,
    SUM(COALESCE(e.end_mrr, 0)) / NULLIF(SUM(c.start_mrr), 0) AS net_revenue_retention
FROM cohort_mrr c
LEFT JOIN end_mrr e ON e.customer_id = c.customer_id;

WITH q4_start AS (SELECT DATE '2024-10-01' AS d),
q4_end AS (SELECT DATE '2024-12-31' AS d),
cohort_customers AS (
    -- Customers who had active revenue at the start of Q4 FY2025
    SELECT DISTINCT s.customer_id
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
    WHERE c.is_test = false
      AND s.mrr > 0
      AND s.started_at < (SELECT d FROM q4_start)
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= (SELECT d FROM q4_start))
),
starting_mrr AS (
    SELECT SUM(s.mrr) AS mrr_start
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    JOIN cohort_customers cc ON cc.customer_id = s.customer_id
    WHERE s.mrr > 0
      AND s.started_at < (SELECT d FROM q4_start)
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= (SELECT d FROM q4_start))
),
ending_mrr AS (
    -- Same cohort's MRR at end of Q4 (expansion/contraction/churn captured)
    SELECT SUM(s.mrr) AS mrr_end
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    JOIN cohort_customers cc ON cc.customer_id = s.customer_id
    WHERE s.mrr > 0
      AND s.started_at <= (SELECT d FROM q4_end)
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at > (SELECT d FROM q4_end))
)
SELECT
    (SELECT mrr_start FROM starting_mrr) AS starting_mrr,
    (SELECT mrr_end FROM ending_mrr)     AS ending_mrr,
    (SELECT mrr_end FROM ending_mrr) * 1.0 / NULLIF((SELECT mrr_start FROM starting_mrr), 0) AS net_revenue_retention;
