-- CAC payback period (months) = CAC / ARPU_gross_margin
-- Without CAC/marketing spend data in the warehouse, approximate payback period
-- as: months required for a new customer's cumulative MRR to equal the average
-- acquisition cost. Since we have no spend table, compute the proxy as:
--   avg monthly MRR per newly-acquired customer in the trailing 12 months
-- and report 1 / (that ARPU normalized) — i.e., months to recoup 1 unit of CAC
-- assuming CAC ≈ 1x first-month MRR is NOT defensible here, so we instead
-- return the components needed to compute payback and the ratio under the
-- common assumption CAC = 12 * new-customer ARPU is also not available.
--
-- Best-effort answer: payback_months = avg_CAC / (avg_new_customer_MRR * gross_margin)
-- We don't have CAC or COGS in this warehouse. Return ARPU for new customers
-- acquired in the 12 months ending 2026-03-31, excluding test accounts,
-- excluding negative refund MRR, at the customer grain — this is the
-- denominator of payback. Numerator (CAC) must come from finance.

WITH cutoff AS (
  SELECT DATE '2026-03-31' AS as_of
),
eligible_customers AS (
  SELECT c.customer_id, c.signup_date
  FROM dim_customers c, cutoff
  WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
    AND c.signup_date >  (cutoff.as_of - INTERVAL 12 MONTH)
    AND c.signup_date <= cutoff.as_of
),
first_sub_mrr AS (
  SELECT
    s.customer_id,
    SUM(s.mrr) AS initial_mrr
  FROM fct_subscriptions s
  JOIN eligible_customers e ON e.customer_id = s.customer_id
  WHERE s.mrr > 0
    AND s.started_at <= (SELECT as_of FROM cutoff)
    AND s.started_at >= (SELECT as_of - INTERVAL 12 MONTH FROM cutoff)
  GROUP BY s.customer_id
),
arpu AS (
  SELECT AVG(initial_mrr) AS avg_new_customer_mrr,
         COUNT(*)         AS new_customers
  FROM first_sub_mrr
)
SELECT
  avg_new_customer_mrr,
  new_customers,
  CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) AS cac_usd,           -- not available in warehouse; supply from finance
  CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) AS gross_margin_pct,  -- not available in warehouse; supply from finance
  -- payback_period_months = cac_usd / (avg_new_customer_mrr * gross_margin_pct)
  CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) AS payback_period_months
FROM arpu;

-- CAC payback period (months) = CAC / Average monthly gross margin per new customer
-- Without a CAC table or marketing spend, we approximate payback as:
--   months to recover acquisition by using average new-customer MRR.
-- Since no CAC/spend table exists, we compute the effective payback as
--   1 / (avg first-sub MRR per new customer / avg first-sub MRR per new customer) is degenerate,
-- so we instead report the standard proxy: average months for a new customer's
-- cumulative MRR to equal their first-month MRR — i.e., 1 month — unless we have spend.
-- Best-effort: compute average new-customer MRR as of 2026-03-31 from non-test, non-negative subs.

WITH cohort AS (
    SELECT
        c.customer_id,
        MIN(s.started_at) AS first_started_at
    FROM dim_customers c
    JOIN fct_subscriptions s ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
    WHERE c.is_test = FALSE
      AND c.signup_date <= DATE '2026-03-31'
      AND s.started_at <= TIMESTAMP '2026-03-31 23:59:59'
      AND s.mrr > 0
    GROUP BY c.customer_id
),
first_mrr AS (
    SELECT
        ch.customer_id,
        s.mrr AS initial_mrr
    FROM cohort ch
    JOIN fct_subscriptions s
      ON s.customer_id = ch.customer_id
     AND s.started_at = ch.first_started_at
    WHERE s.mrr > 0
),
acquisition_spend AS (
    -- Proxy CAC: total invoiced amount in the customer's first 30 days is NOT spend;
    -- with no spend table, we cannot compute true CAC. Return NULL months and the
    -- average initial MRR so the caller sees the gap.
    SELECT
        AVG(initial_mrr) AS avg_initial_mrr,
        COUNT(*)         AS new_customers
    FROM first_mrr
)
SELECT
    avg_initial_mrr,
    new_customers,
    CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE) AS payback_period_months,
    'CAC payback period cannot be computed: no marketing spend / CAC table exists in the warehouse (dim_customers, fct_subscriptions, fct_invoices only). Reporting average initial MRR per new customer as of 2026-03-31 for context.' AS note
FROM acquisition_spend;

WITH customers AS (
    SELECT customer_id, signup_date
    FROM dim_customers
    WHERE COALESCE(is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
      AND signup_date IS NOT NULL
),
-- CAC proxy: we don't have a spend table, so approximate CAC as
-- average first-month-equivalent acquisition cost using first invoice amount?
-- Without a marketing spend source, derive payback as:
--   avg first-12-month cumulative gross profit recovery time.
-- Standard SaaS payback (months) = CAC / (ARPA * gross_margin).
-- No CAC or margin tables exist here, so compute a revenue-based proxy:
--   payback_months = avg_initial_invoice_amount / avg_monthly_mrr
-- using non-test customers acquired on/before 2025-12-31.
first_invoice AS (
    SELECT i.customer_id,
           MIN(i.paid_at) AS first_paid_at
    FROM fct_invoices i
    JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = i.customer_id
    WHERE i.status = 'paid'
      AND i.paid_at <= TIMESTAMP '2025-12-31 23:59:59'
    GROUP BY i.customer_id
),
initial_amount AS (
    SELECT i.customer_id, i.amount
    FROM fct_invoices i
    JOIN first_invoice f
      ON f.customer_id = i.customer_id
     AND f.first_paid_at = i.paid_at
    WHERE i.status = 'paid'
),
active_mrr AS (
    SELECT s.customer_id,
           SUM(s.mrr) AS customer_mrr
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
    WHERE s.status = 'active'
      AND s.mrr > 0
      AND s.started_at <= TIMESTAMP '2025-12-31 23:59:59'
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at > TIMESTAMP '2025-12-31 23:59:59')
    GROUP BY s.customer_id
)
SELECT
    AVG(ia.amount)            AS avg_initial_invoice_usd,
    AVG(am.customer_mrr)      AS avg_active_mrr_usd,
    AVG(ia.amount) / NULLIF(AVG(am.customer_mrr), 0) AS payback_period_months
FROM initial_amount ia
JOIN active_mrr am ON am.customer_id = ia.customer_id;

-- Payback period (months) as of 2025-12-31
-- Definition: CAC payback proxy using available data:
--   payback_months = average new-customer acquisition cohort's
--                    initial MRR inverted -> 1 / (avg new MRR per customer)
-- Since we have no CAC/marketing spend table, we approximate payback as:
--   (cumulative gross margin to recover) ~ first-month MRR
--   payback_months = total_initial_mrr_of_cohort / monthly_recurring_revenue_recovered_per_month
-- Practically: average months for a customer's cumulative paid invoices
-- to equal/exceed their first subscription's MRR.

WITH clean_customers AS (
    SELECT customer_id, signup_date
    FROM dim_customers
    WHERE COALESCE(is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
),
first_sub AS (
    SELECT
        s.customer_id,
        MIN(s.started_at) AS first_started_at,
        ARG_MIN(s.mrr, s.started_at) AS initial_mrr
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    JOIN clean_customers c USING (customer_id)
    WHERE s.mrr > 0
      AND s.started_at <= TIMESTAMP '2025-12-31 23:59:59'
    GROUP BY s.customer_id
),
paid_invoices AS (
    SELECT
        i.customer_id,
        SUM(i.amount) AS total_paid
    FROM fct_invoices i
    JOIN clean_customers c USING (customer_id)
    WHERE i.status = 'paid'
      AND i.amount > 0
      AND CASE
            WHEN i.processor = 'legacy_braintree'
              THEN i.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York' AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'
            ELSE i.paid_at
          END <= TIMESTAMP '2025-12-31 23:59:59'
    GROUP BY i.customer_id
),
cohort AS (
    SELECT
        f.customer_id,
        f.initial_mrr,
        COALESCE(p.total_paid, 0) AS total_paid
    FROM first_sub f
    LEFT JOIN paid_invoices p USING (customer_id)
)
SELECT
    SUM(initial_mrr) / NULLIF(SUM(total_paid) / 12.0, 0) AS payback_period_months
FROM cohort;

-- CAC Payback Period (months) as of end of FY2025 (assume FY2025 = calendar 2025, ending 2025-12-31)
-- Definition used: CAC Payback = Average CAC per new customer / Average monthly gross profit per customer
-- Simplified (no CAC/cost data in warehouse): approximate as
--   (Average first-month-equivalent revenue per newly acquired customer) inverse,
--   i.e., months of MRR needed to recoup an assumed CAC.
-- Since no marketing spend table exists, we compute the closest proxy:
--   Payback (months) = Total acquisition-period invoiced revenue per new customer
--                      / Average MRR per new customer
-- For FY2025 cohort: customers who signed up in 2025, excluding test accounts.

WITH fy_bounds AS (
    SELECT DATE '2025-01-01' AS fy_start, DATE '2025-12-31' AS fy_end
),
new_customers AS (
    SELECT c.customer_id
    FROM dim_customers c, fy_bounds b
    WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
      AND c.signup_date BETWEEN b.fy_start AND b.fy_end
),
cust_mrr AS (
    SELECT s.customer_id, AVG(s.mrr) AS avg_mrr
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    JOIN new_customers n ON n.customer_id = s.customer_id
    WHERE s.mrr > 0
      AND s.started_at <= TIMESTAMP '2025-12-31 23:59:59'
    GROUP BY s.customer_id
),
cust_rev AS (
    SELECT i.customer_id, SUM(i.amount) AS total_paid
    FROM fct_invoices i
    JOIN new_customers n ON n.customer_id = i.customer_id
    WHERE i.status = 'paid'
      AND i.paid_at <= TIMESTAMP '2025-12-31 23:59:59'
    GROUP BY i.customer_id
)
SELECT
    AVG(cr.total_paid)                                AS avg_revenue_per_new_customer_usd,
    AVG(cm.avg_mrr)                                   AS avg_mrr_per_new_customer_usd,
    CASE WHEN AVG(cm.avg_mrr) > 0
         THEN AVG(cr.total_paid) / AVG(cm.avg_mrr)
    END                                               AS cac_payback_period_months
FROM new_customers n
LEFT JOIN cust_mrr cm ON cm.customer_id = n.customer_id
LEFT JOIN cust_rev cr ON cr.customer_id = n.customer_id;

-- CAC Payback Period as of end of FY2025 (assumed = 2025-12-31)
-- Definition used: CAC Payback (months) = CAC / ARPU_monthly_gross_margin
-- Without a CAC source table or cost data in the warehouse, we approximate:
--   Payback (months) = Avg CAC per new customer acquired in FY2025
--                      / Avg monthly gross profit per customer
-- Since we have no marketing spend table, we proxy CAC as 0 unavailable —
-- so we instead compute the closest defensible proxy:
--   Months to recoup = (median first-month MRR) inverse relationship.
-- Concretely: payback_months = 1 / (sum(active MRR) / sum(cumulative MRR to date))
-- is not meaningful either. The honest answer with available data:
-- compute average monthly recurring revenue per customer acquired in FY2025
-- and report payback assuming a benchmark CAC parameter.

WITH params AS (
    SELECT
        DATE '2025-12-31' AS fy_end,
        DATE '2025-01-01' AS fy_start
),
eligible_customers AS (
    SELECT c.customer_id, c.signup_date
    FROM dim_customers c, params p
    WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
      AND c.signup_date BETWEEN p.fy_start AND p.fy_end
),
new_cust_mrr AS (
    -- average starting MRR per FY2025-acquired customer (excluding refund negatives)
    SELECT
        AVG(first_mrr) AS avg_new_mrr
    FROM (
        SELECT
            s.customer_id,
            -- first non-negative MRR at acquisition
            (ARRAY_AGG(s.mrr ORDER BY s.started_at ASC)
                FILTER (WHERE s.mrr IS NOT NULL AND s.mrr >= 0))[1] AS first_mrr
        FROM fct_subscriptions s
        JOIN eligible_customers e ON e.customer_id = s.customer_id
        WHERE s.started_at <= TIMESTAMP '2025-12-31 23:59:59'
        GROUP BY s.customer_id
    ) t
    WHERE first_mrr IS NOT NULL AND first_mrr > 0
),
cac_proxy AS (
    -- CAC proxy: average total invoiced amount per FY2025-acquired customer
    -- in their first 90 days is NOT CAC. With no spend table, we use the
    -- conventional placeholder: report CAC as NULL and surface the inputs
    -- so the consumer can divide by their CAC figure.
    SELECT
        AVG(first_90d_revenue) AS avg_first_90d_revenue
    FROM (
        SELECT
            e.customer_id,
            SUM(CASE WHEN i.status = 'paid' THEN i.amount ELSE 0 END) AS first_90d_revenue
        FROM eligible_customers e
        LEFT JOIN fct_invoices i
          ON i.customer_id = e.customer_id
         AND i.paid_at IS NOT NULL
         AND i.paid_at <= e.signup_date + INTERVAL 90 DAY
        GROUP BY e.customer_id
    ) t
)
SELECT
    (SELECT avg_new_mrr FROM new_cust_mrr)             AS avg_new_customer_mrr_usd,
    (SELECT avg_first_90d_revenue FROM cac_proxy)      AS avg_first_90d_revenue_usd,
    -- Payback period in months = CAC / avg_new_customer_mrr.
    -- Warehouse contains no marketing-spend / CAC table, so CAC is not derivable here.
    CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE)                               AS cac_usd,
    CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE)                               AS payback_period_months,
    'CAC not available in warehouse (no spend table); payback_period_months cannot be computed. Provided avg new-customer MRR so caller can divide their CAC by it.' AS note;

-- Pipeline coverage = open pipeline entering Q2 FY2026 / Q2 bookings target proxy
-- Assuming fiscal year aligns with calendar year: Q2 FY2026 starts 2026-04-01
-- "Going into Q2" => snapshot as of 2026-04-01
-- Pipeline = sum of deal_value for opps created but not yet won/lost/no_decision before 2026-04-01
-- Coverage ratio = open pipeline / prior-quarter (Q1 FY2026) won bookings as target proxy

WITH opp_events AS (
    SELECT
        event_id,
        event_type,
        -- normalize timestamp to UTC
        CASE
            WHEN timezone = 'America/Los_Angeles'
                THEN "timestamp" AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles' AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'
            ELSE "timestamp"
        END AS ts_utc,
        -- normalize jsonb keys (camelCase or snake_case)
        COALESCE(
            properties_jsonb->>'opp_id',
            properties_jsonb->>'oppId'
        ) AS opp_id,
        COALESCE(
            TRY_CAST(properties_jsonb->>'deal_value' AS DOUBLE),
            TRY_CAST(properties_jsonb->>'dealValue' AS DOUBLE)
        ) AS deal_value
    FROM fct_events
    WHERE event_type IN ('opp_created', 'opp_won', 'opp_lost', 'opp_no_decision')
),
opp_state AS (
    SELECT
        opp_id,
        MAX(CASE WHEN event_type = 'opp_created' AND ts_utc < TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01' THEN deal_value END) AS created_value,
        MAX(CASE WHEN event_type = 'opp_created' AND ts_utc < TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS was_created,
        MAX(CASE WHEN event_type IN ('opp_won','opp_lost','opp_no_decision') AND ts_utc < TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS was_closed
    FROM opp_events
    WHERE opp_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY opp_id
),
open_pipeline AS (
    SELECT SUM(created_value) AS open_pipeline_value
    FROM opp_state
    WHERE was_created = 1 AND was_closed = 0
),
q1_bookings AS (
    SELECT SUM(deal_value) AS q1_won_value
    FROM opp_events
    WHERE event_type = 'opp_won'
      AND ts_utc >= TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01'
      AND ts_utc <  TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01'
)
SELECT
    op.open_pipeline_value,
    qb.q1_won_value AS prior_quarter_bookings_target_proxy,
    op.open_pipeline_value / NULLIF(qb.q1_won_value, 0) AS pipeline_coverage_ratio
FROM open_pipeline op
CROSS JOIN q1_bookings qb;

-- Pipeline coverage = open pipeline entering Q2 FY2026 / Q2 FY2026 quota (or won)
-- Assuming fiscal year aligns with calendar year: Q2 FY2026 = 2026-04-01 to 2026-06-30
-- "Going into Q2" = snapshot as of 2026-04-01
-- Pipeline coverage ratio = (open pipeline value as of Q2 start) / (closed-won value in Q2 start reference, here we use Q1 closed-won as the target baseline)

WITH normalized AS (
    SELECT
        event_id,
        event_type,
        -- Convert timestamp to UTC based on timezone column
        CASE
            WHEN timezone = 'America/Los_Angeles'
                THEN timezone('UTC', timezone('America/Los_Angeles', "timestamp"))
            ELSE "timestamp"
        END AS event_ts_utc,
        -- Normalize JSON keys: try snake_case then camelCase
        COALESCE(
            properties_jsonb->>'opp_id',
            properties_jsonb->>'oppId'
        ) AS opp_id,
        TRY_CAST(COALESCE(
            properties_jsonb->>'deal_value',
            properties_jsonb->>'dealValue'
        ) AS DOUBLE) AS deal_value,
        COALESCE(
            properties_jsonb->>'stage',
            properties_jsonb->>'Stage'
        ) AS stage
    FROM fct_events
    WHERE event_type IN ('opp_created', 'opp_won', 'opp_lost', 'opp_no_decision', 'opp_stage_advanced')
),
opp_latest_state AS (
    -- Latest known state of each opp as of Q2 FY2026 start (2026-04-01)
    SELECT
        opp_id,
        ARG_MAX(event_type, event_ts_utc) AS latest_event_type,
        ARG_MAX(deal_value, event_ts_utc) AS latest_deal_value,
        MAX(event_ts_utc) AS last_update_ts
    FROM normalized
    WHERE opp_id IS NOT NULL
      AND event_ts_utc < TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01 00:00:00'
    GROUP BY opp_id
),
open_pipeline AS (
    SELECT SUM(latest_deal_value) AS open_pipeline_value
    FROM opp_latest_state
    WHERE latest_event_type IN ('opp_created', 'opp_stage_advanced')
),
q2_target AS (
    -- Use trailing quarter (Q1 FY2026) closed-won as proxy target
    SELECT SUM(deal_value) AS target_value
    FROM normalized
    WHERE event_type = 'opp_won'
      AND event_ts_utc >= TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
      AND event_ts_utc <  TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01 00:00:00'
)
SELECT
    op.open_pipeline_value,
    qt.target_value,
    op.open_pipeline_value / NULLIF(qt.target_value, 0) AS pipeline_coverage_ratio
FROM open_pipeline op
CROSS JOIN q2_target qt;

-- Pipeline coverage going into Q1 FY2026:
-- "Going into Q1 FY2026" = as of the start of Q1 FY2026 (2026-01-01).
-- Pipeline coverage = open pipeline value / target (here we use Q1 won as proxy target is wrong;
-- standard definition: open pipeline at period start / quarter quota/target).
-- Without a target table, compute: sum(deal_value) of opps created but not yet won/lost/no_decision
-- as of 2026-01-01, divided by Q1 2026 closed-won bookings target proxy = sum of opp_won deal_value in Q1 2026.
-- We normalize timestamps to UTC and handle camelCase/snake_case keys in properties_jsonb.

WITH events_utc AS (
    SELECT
        event_id,
        event_type,
        CASE
            WHEN timezone = 'America/Los_Angeles'
                THEN timezone(timezone, "timestamp") -- interpret as LA local, convert to UTC
            ELSE "timestamp"
        END AS ts_utc,
        properties_jsonb
    FROM fct_events
    WHERE event_type IN ('opp_created', 'opp_won', 'opp_lost', 'opp_no_decision')
),
opp_events AS (
    SELECT
        event_type,
        ts_utc,
        COALESCE(
            properties_jsonb->>'opp_id',
            properties_jsonb->>'oppId'
        ) AS opp_id,
        TRY_CAST(COALESCE(
            properties_jsonb->>'deal_value',
            properties_jsonb->>'dealValue'
        ) AS DOUBLE) AS deal_value
    FROM events_utc
),
-- Open pipeline as of 2026-01-01: opps created before that date with no terminal event before that date
opp_status AS (
    SELECT
        opp_id,
        MAX(deal_value) FILTER (WHERE event_type = 'opp_created') AS deal_value,
        MIN(ts_utc)     FILTER (WHERE event_type = 'opp_created') AS created_at,
        MIN(ts_utc)     FILTER (WHERE event_type IN ('opp_won','opp_lost','opp_no_decision')) AS closed_at
    FROM opp_events
    WHERE opp_id IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY opp_id
),
open_pipeline AS (
    SELECT SUM(deal_value) AS open_pipeline_value
    FROM opp_status
    WHERE created_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01'
      AND (closed_at IS NULL OR closed_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01')
),
q1_won AS (
    SELECT SUM(deal_value) AS q1_won_value
    FROM opp_events
    WHERE event_type = 'opp_won'
      AND ts_utc >= TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01'
      AND ts_utc <  TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01'
)
SELECT
    op.open_pipeline_value,
    qw.q1_won_value AS q1_target_proxy,
    op.open_pipeline_value / NULLIF(qw.q1_won_value, 0) AS pipeline_coverage_ratio
FROM open_pipeline op
CROSS JOIN q1_won qw;

WITH normalized AS (
    SELECT
        event_id,
        event_type,
        -- Normalize timestamp to UTC
        CASE
            WHEN timezone = 'America/Los_Angeles'
                THEN timezone(CAST('UTC' AS VARCHAR), timezone(CAST('America/Los_Angeles' AS VARCHAR), "timestamp"))
            ELSE "timestamp"
        END AS ts_utc,
        -- Normalize JSON keys for stage and deal_value
        COALESCE(
            TRY_CAST(properties_jsonb ->> 'deal_value' AS DOUBLE),
            TRY_CAST(properties_jsonb ->> 'dealValue'  AS DOUBLE)
        ) AS deal_value,
        COALESCE(
            properties_jsonb ->> 'stage',
            properties_jsonb ->> 'opp_stage',
            properties_jsonb ->> 'oppStage'
        ) AS stage,
        COALESCE(
            properties_jsonb ->> 'opp_id',
            properties_jsonb ->> 'oppId'
        ) AS opp_id
    FROM fct_events
),
-- Latest known state per opportunity as of the snapshot date (start of Q1 FY2026 = 2025-02-01 ... 
-- but typical SaaS FY2026 Q1 starts 2025-02-01; we'll use calendar Q1 FY2026 == 2026-01-01 going-in snapshot)
-- "Going into Q1 FY2026" => snapshot at 2026-01-01 00:00 UTC
snapshot AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM normalized
    WHERE ts_utc < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
      AND event_type IN ('opp_created', 'opp_won', 'opp_lost', 'opp_no_decision', 'opp_stage_advanced')
      AND opp_id IS NOT NULL
),
latest_per_opp AS (
    SELECT
        opp_id,
        ARG_MAX(event_type, ts_utc)  AS last_event_type,
        ARG_MAX(stage, ts_utc)       AS last_stage,
        MAX(deal_value)              AS deal_value
    FROM snapshot
    GROUP BY opp_id
),
open_pipeline AS (
    SELECT SUM(deal_value) AS open_pipeline_value
    FROM latest_per_opp
    WHERE last_event_type NOT IN ('opp_won', 'opp_lost', 'opp_no_decision')
),
-- Q1 FY2026 bookings target proxy: sum of opp_won deal_value during Q1 FY2026
-- Since we are "going into" the quarter, target is typically a plan number not in events.
-- Use prior-quarter (Q4 FY2025) won bookings as the comparable target proxy.
prior_q_won AS (
    SELECT SUM(deal_value) AS prior_q_won_value
    FROM normalized
    WHERE event_type = 'opp_won'
      AND ts_utc >= TIMESTAMP '2025-10-01 00:00:00'
      AND ts_utc <  TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
)
SELECT
    op.open_pipeline_value,
    pq.prior_q_won_value                                   AS quota_proxy,
    op.open_pipeline_value / NULLIF(pq.prior_q_won_value, 0) AS pipeline_coverage_ratio
FROM open_pipeline op
CROSS JOIN prior_q_won pq;

WITH normalized AS (
    SELECT
        event_id,
        event_type,
        CASE 
            WHEN timezone = 'America/Los_Angeles' 
                THEN "timestamp" AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles' AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'
            ELSE "timestamp"
        END AS event_ts_utc,
        COALESCE(
            TRY_CAST(properties_jsonb->>'opp_id' AS VARCHAR),
            TRY_CAST(properties_jsonb->>'oppId' AS VARCHAR)
        ) AS opp_id,
        COALESCE(
            TRY_CAST(properties_jsonb->>'deal_value' AS DOUBLE),

        ) AS stage
    FROM fct_events
    WHERE event_type IN ('opp_created','opp_won','opp_lost','opp_no_decision','opp_stage_advanced')
),
-- Q3 FY2025 end: assuming calendar fiscal year, Q3 ends 2025-09-30
opp_state AS (
    SELECT
        opp_id,
        MAX(CASE WHEN event_type = 'opp_created' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS was_created,
        MAX(CASE WHEN event_type IN ('opp_won','opp_lost','opp_no_decision') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS was_closed,
        MAX(deal_value) AS deal_value
    FROM normalized
    WHERE opp_id IS NOT NULL
      AND event_ts_utc <= TIMESTAMP '2025-09-30 23:59:59'

),
open_pipeline AS (

    FROM opp_state
    WHERE was_created = 1 AND was_closed = 0
),
q3_won AS (
    SELECT SUM(deal_value) AS won_value
    FROM normalized
    WHERE event_type = 'opp_won'
      AND event_ts_utc >= TIMESTAMP '2025-07-01 00:00:00'
      AND event_ts_utc <= TIMESTAMP '2025-09-30 23:59:59'
)
SELECT
    op.open_pipeline_value,
    qw.won_value AS q3_won_value,

WITH normalized AS (
    SELECT

-- Q3 FY2025 = calendar Q3 2025 (Jul 1 - Sep 30, 2025)
opp_latest AS (

SELECT

WITH events_utc AS (

-- Q2 FY2025 assumed calendar: 2025-04-01 .. 2025-06-30. End of Q2 = 2025-06-30.
opp_state AS (

opp_events AS (

        COALESCE(
            properties_jsonb->>'opp_id',

        ) AS opp_id,

            properties_jsonb->>'deal_value',

        ) AS stage
    FROM events_utc
    WHERE event_type IN ('opp_created','opp_won','opp_lost','opp_no_decision','opp_stage_advanced')
),
-- Latest state per opp as of end of Q2 FY2025 (assume calendar FY: Q2 ends 2025-06-30)
opp_latest AS (
    SELECT

        ARG_MAX(event_type, event_ts_utc) AS last_event_type,
        ARG_MAX(deal_value, event_ts_utc) FILTER (WHERE deal_value IS NOT NULL) AS last_deal_value,
        ARG_MAX(stage, event_ts_utc) FILTER (WHERE stage IS NOT NULL) AS last_stage
    FROM opp_events

),
-- Q3 FY2025 target = sum of opps won in Q3 (or use a quota proxy: won deals in next quarter)
-- Pipeline coverage = open pipeline at end of Q2 / Q3 closed-won target
q3_won AS (

    FROM (

WITH monthly_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('month',
            CASE
                WHEN i.processor = 'legacy_braintree' THEN i.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York' AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'
                ELSE i.paid_at
            END
        ) AS revenue_month,
        SUM(i.amount) AS revenue
    FROM fct_invoices i
    INNER JOIN dim_customers c ON i.customer_id = c.customer_id
    WHERE i.status = 'paid'
      AND (c.is_test = FALSE OR c.is_test IS NULL)
      AND i.paid_at IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
    MAX(CASE WHEN revenue_month = DATE '2026-02-01' THEN revenue END) AS feb_2026_revenue,
    MAX(CASE WHEN revenue_month = DATE '2026-03-01' THEN revenue END) AS mar_2026_revenue,
    MAX(CASE WHEN revenue_month = DATE '2026-03-01' THEN revenue END)
        - MAX(CASE WHEN revenue_month = DATE '2026-02-01' THEN revenue END) AS mom_change
FROM monthly_revenue;

  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('month', period_start) AS month,
    COUNT(DISTINCT u.user_id) AS active_users
  FROM (
    SELECT TIMESTAMP '2026-02-01 00:00:00' AS period_start, TIMESTAMP '2026-03-01 00:00:00' AS period_end
    UNION ALL
    SELECT TIMESTAMP '2026-03-01 00:00:00', TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01 00:00:00'
  ) p
  JOIN dim_users u
    ON u.last_active_at >= p.period_start
   AND u.last_active_at < p.period_end
  JOIN fct_subscriptions s
    ON s.customer_id = u.customer_id
   AND s.status = 'active'
   AND s.mrr > 0
   AND s.started_at < p.period_end
   AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= p.period_start)
  JOIN dim_customers c
    ON c.customer_id = u.customer_id
   AND c.is_test = false
  WHERE u.deleted_at IS NULL
  GROUP BY 1
)

  MAX(CASE WHEN month = DATE '2026-02-01' THEN active_users END) AS active_users_feb_2026,
  MAX(CASE WHEN month = DATE '2026-03-01' THEN active_users END) AS active_users_mar_2026,
  MAX(CASE WHEN month = DATE '2026-03-01' THEN active_users END)
    - MAX(CASE WHEN month = DATE '2026-02-01' THEN active_users END) AS mom_change_absolute,
  (MAX(CASE WHEN month = DATE '2026-03-01' THEN active_users END)
    - MAX(CASE WHEN month = DATE '2026-02-01' THEN active_users END))

WITH revenue AS (

  FROM fct_invoices i
  JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = i.customer_id
  WHERE i.paid_at >= DATE '2026-01-01'
    AND i.paid_at < DATE '2026-04-01'
    AND i.status = 'paid'
    AND c.is_test = false
),
period_cogs AS (
  SELECT period_month,
    COALESCE(
      MAX(CASE WHEN source = 'cost_of_goods_sold' THEN amount END),

    ) AS dedupped_cogs
  FROM fct_cogs

),

  FROM revenue
)
SELECT

   / NULLIF(revenue_total, 0)) * 100 AS gross_margin_pct

WITH starting_customers AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS cust_count
  FROM dim_customers c
  JOIN fct_subscriptions s ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE c.is_test = false
    AND c.signup_date < DATE '2025-01-01'
    AND s.status = 'active'
    AND s.started_at < DATE '2025-01-01'
    AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at > DATE '2025-01-01')
),
churned AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS cust_count
  FROM dim_customers c
  WHERE c.is_test = false
    AND c.churned_at >= DATE '2025-01-01'
    AND c.churned_at < DATE '2026-01-01'
),
revenue AS (
  SELECT SUM(i.amount) AS rev
  FROM fct_invoices i
  JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = i.customer_id
  WHERE (CASE WHEN i.processor = 'legacy_braintree'
              THEN i.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York' AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles'
              ELSE i.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles'
         END) >= DATE '2025-01-01'
    AND (CASE WHEN i.processor = 'legacy_braintree'
              THEN i.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York' AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles'
              ELSE i.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles'
         END) < DATE '2026-01-01'
    AND i.status = 'paid'
    AND c.is_test = false
)

       / NULLIF(churned.cust_count::float / NULLIF(starting_customers.cust_count, 0), 0) AS ltv

WITH starting AS (
  SELECT c.customer_id,
         SUM(CASE WHEN s.status = 'active' AND s.mrr > 0
                   AND s.started_at < DATE '2026-01-01'
                   AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at > DATE '2026-01-01')
                  THEN s.mrr ELSE 0 END) AS arr_start
  FROM dim_customers c
  LEFT JOIN fct_subscriptions s ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE c.is_test = false AND c.signup_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY c.customer_id
),
ending AS (
  SELECT c.customer_id,
         SUM(CASE WHEN s.status = 'active' AND s.mrr > 0
                   AND s.started_at < DATE '2026-04-01'
                   AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at > DATE '2026-04-01')
                  THEN s.mrr ELSE 0 END) AS arr_end
  FROM dim_customers c
  LEFT JOIN fct_subscriptions s ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE c.is_test = false AND c.signup_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY c.customer_id
)
SELECT SUM(e.arr_end)::float / NULLIF(SUM(s.arr_start), 0) * 100 AS net_retention_pct
FROM starting s
JOIN ending e ON e.customer_id = s.customer_id
WHERE s.arr_start > 0;

    AND s.started_at <= DATE '2026-03-31'
    AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at > DATE '2026-03-31')
),
mrr_total AS (
  SELECT SUM(s.mrr) AS total_mrr
  FROM fct_subscriptions s
  JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
  WHERE c.is_test = false
    AND c.signup_date <= DATE '2026-03-31'
    AND (c.churned_at IS NULL OR c.churned_at > DATE '2026-03-31')
    AND s.mrr > 0
    AND s.started_at <= DATE '2026-03-31'
    AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at > DATE '2026-03-31')
),
new_paying AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS n
  FROM dim_customers c
  JOIN fct_subscriptions s ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE c.signup_date >= DATE '2026-03-31' - INTERVAL '1 month'
    AND c.signup_date < DATE '2026-03-31'

WITH open_opps AS (
  SELECT
    COALESCE(e.properties_jsonb->>'opp_id', e.properties_jsonb->>'oppId') AS opp_id,

  FROM fct_events e
  WHERE e.event_type = 'opp_created'
    AND (e.timestamp AT TIME ZONE e.timezone AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') < TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01 00:00:00' AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles' AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'

      SELECT 1

    )
)
SELECT SUM(deal_value) / 5000000.0 AS coverage_ratio

                      AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles'
    END)) AS month,
    SUM(i.amount) AS revenue
  FROM fct_invoices i

    (CASE

  SELECT DATE '2026-03-01' AS month_start

  COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN m.month_start = DATE '2026-03-01' THEN mau.active_users END), 0) AS active_users_mar_2026,
  COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN m.month_start = DATE '2026-03-01' THEN mau.active_users END), 0)
    - COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN m.month_start = DATE '2026-02-01' THEN mau.active_users END), 0) AS mom_change_active_users

WITH current_arr AS (

    AND (ended_at IS NULL OR ended_at > TIMESTAMP '2026-12-31 23:59:59')

start_of_year_arr AS (

WITH q_start AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        SUM(mrr) AS mrr_at_q_start
    FROM fct_subscriptions
    WHERE started_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01'
      AND (ended_at IS NULL OR ended_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01')
      AND COALESCE(status, '') <> 'canceled'
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
q_end AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        SUM(mrr) AS mrr_at_q_end
    FROM fct_subscriptions
    WHERE started_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01'
      AND (ended_at IS NULL OR ended_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01')
      AND COALESCE(status, '') <> 'canceled'
    GROUP BY customer_id
)
SELECT
    SUM(GREATEST(qs.mrr_at_q_start - COALESCE(qe.mrr_at_q_end, 0), 0)) AS arr_contraction
FROM q_start qs
LEFT JOIN q_end qe
  ON qs.customer_id = qe.customer_id
JOIN dim_customers dc
  ON dc.customer_id = qs.customer_id
WHERE COALESCE(dc.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE;

WITH q_start AS (
    SELECT customer_id, SUM(mrr) AS mrr_start
    FROM fct_subscriptions
    WHERE started_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01'
      AND COALESCE(ended_at, TIMESTAMP '9999-12-31') >= TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01'
      AND status = 'active'
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
q_end AS (
    SELECT customer_id, SUM(mrr) AS mrr_end
    FROM fct_subscriptions
    WHERE started_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01'
      AND COALESCE(ended_at, TIMESTAMP '9999-12-31') >= TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01'
      AND status = 'active'
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
existing_customers AS (
    SELECT customer_id
    FROM q_start
)
SELECT SUM(GREATEST(qs.mrr_start - COALESCE(qe.mrr_end, 0), 0)) AS arr_contraction_q1_2026
FROM existing_customers ec
JOIN q_start qs ON ec.customer_id = qs.customer_id
LEFT JOIN q_end qe ON ec.customer_id = qe.customer_id
JOIN dim_customers dc ON ec.customer_id = dc.customer_id
WHERE COALESCE(dc.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE;

WITH subscription_periods AS (
    SELECT
        fs.sub_id,
        COALESCE(fs.customer_id, fs.cust_id) AS customer_key,
        fs.mrr,
        fs.started_at,
        COALESCE(fs.ended_at, TIMESTAMP '9999-12-31 23:59:59') AS ended_at
    FROM fct_subscriptions fs
    LEFT JOIN dim_customers dc
        ON COALESCE(fs.customer_id, fs.cust_id) = COALESCE(dc.customer_id, dc.cust_id)
    WHERE COALESCE(dc.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
),
book_snapshots AS (
    SELECT
        SUM(CASE
            WHEN started_at <= TIMESTAMP '2024-12-31 23:59:59'
             AND ended_at > TIMESTAMP '2024-12-31 23:59:59'
            THEN mrr ELSE 0 END) AS start_mrr,
        SUM(CASE
            WHEN started_at <= TIMESTAMP '2025-12-31 23:59:59'
             AND ended_at > TIMESTAMP '2025-12-31 23:59:59'
            THEN mrr ELSE 0 END) AS end_mrr
    FROM subscription_periods
)
SELECT start_mrr - end_mrr AS arr_contraction
FROM book_snapshots;

WITH fy_bounds AS (
    SELECT
        TIMESTAMP '2024-02-01 00:00:00' AS fy_start,
        TIMESTAMP '2025-02-01 00:00:00' AS fy_end
),
daily_mrr AS (
    SELECT
        d.day,
        SUM(s.mrr) AS total_mrr
    FROM fy_bounds b
    CROSS JOIN generate_series(
        CAST(b.fy_start AS DATE),
        CAST(b.fy_end AS DATE),
        INTERVAL 1 DAY
    ) AS d(day)
    JOIN fct_subscriptions s
      ON s.started_at <= d.day
     AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at > d.day)
    LEFT JOIN dim_customers c
      ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
      OR (c.customer_id IS NULL AND c.cust_id = s.cust_id)
    WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
    GREATEST(
        COALESCE((SELECT total_mrr FROM daily_mrr WHERE day = DATE '2024-02-01'), 0) -
        COALESCE((SELECT total_mrr FROM daily_mrr WHERE day = DATE '2025-02-01'), 0),
        0
    ) AS arr_contraction

WITH q4_fy2025 AS (
  SELECT
    DATE '2024-11-01' AS q_start,
    DATE '2025-02-01' AS q_end
),
existing_customers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT s.customer_id
  FROM fct_subscriptions s
  CROSS JOIN q4_fy2025 q
  JOIN dim_customers c
    ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
  WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
    AND s.started_at < q.q_start
),
start_mrr AS (
  SELECT
    s.customer_id,
    SUM(s.mrr) AS mrr_start
  FROM fct_subscriptions s
  CROSS JOIN q4_fy2025 q
  JOIN existing_customers ec
    ON ec.customer_id = s.customer_id
  WHERE s.started_at < q.q_start
    AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= q.q_start)
  GROUP BY 1
),
end_mrr AS (
  SELECT
    s.customer_id,
    SUM(s.mrr) AS mrr_end
  FROM fct_subscriptions s
  CROSS JOIN q4_fy2025 q
  JOIN existing_customers ec
    ON ec.customer_id = s.customer_id
  WHERE s.started_at < q.q_end
    AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= q.q_end)
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  SUM(GREATEST(COALESCE(sm.mrr_start, 0) - COALESCE(em.mrr_end, 0), 0)) AS arr_contraction
FROM existing_customers ec
LEFT JOIN start_mrr sm
  ON sm.customer_id = ec.customer_id
LEFT JOIN end_mrr em
  ON em.customer_id = ec.customer_id;

WITH fiscal_bounds AS (
    SELECT
        TIMESTAMP '2024-11-01 00:00:00' AS q4_start,
        TIMESTAMP '2025-02-01 00:00:00' AS q4_end
),
existing_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT s.customer_id
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    CROSS JOIN fiscal_bounds fb
    JOIN dim_customers c
      ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
    WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
      AND s.started_at < fb.q4_start
),
customer_q4_contraction AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN mrr < 0
                 AND started_at >= (SELECT q4_start FROM fiscal_bounds)
                 AND started_at <  (SELECT q4_end   FROM fiscal_bounds)
                THEN -mrr
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS contraction_mrr
    FROM fct_subscriptions
    WHERE customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM existing_customers)
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(contraction_mrr), 0) AS arr_contraction
FROM customer_q4_contraction;

WITH q_start AS (
    SELECT TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00' AS dt
),
q_end AS (
    SELECT TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01 00:00:00' AS dt
),
eligible_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT customer_id
    FROM dim_customers
    WHERE COALESCE(is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
),
subs_start AS (
    SELECT
        fs.customer_id,
        SUM(fs.mrr) AS mrr_start
    FROM fct_subscriptions fs
    CROSS JOIN q_start qs
    JOIN eligible_customers ec
      ON ec.customer_id = fs.customer_id
    WHERE fs.started_at < qs.dt
      AND (fs.ended_at IS NULL OR fs.ended_at >= qs.dt)
    GROUP BY 1
),
subs_end AS (
    SELECT
        fs.customer_id,
        SUM(fs.mrr) AS mrr_end
    FROM fct_subscriptions fs
    CROSS JOIN q_end qe
    JOIN eligible_customers ec
      ON ec.customer_id = fs.customer_id
    WHERE fs.started_at < qe.dt
      AND (fs.ended_at IS NULL OR fs.ended_at >= qe.dt)
    GROUP BY 1
),
existing_customers AS (
    SELECT customer_id, mrr_start
    FROM subs_start
    WHERE mrr_start > 0
),
customer_deltas AS (
    SELECT
        ec.customer_id,
        ec.mrr_start,
        COALESCE(se.mrr_end, 0) AS mrr_end,
        COALESCE(se.mrr_end, 0) - ec.mrr_start AS delta_mrr
    FROM existing_customers ec
    LEFT JOIN subs_end se
      ON se.customer_id = ec.customer_id
)
SELECT
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN delta_mrr < 0 THEN -delta_mrr * 12 ELSE 0 END), 2) AS existing_customer_arr_contraction_q1_2026,
    ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN delta_mrr > 0 THEN  delta_mrr * 12 ELSE 0 END), 2) AS arr_expansion_q1_2026,
    ROUND(
        SUM(CASE WHEN delta_mrr < 0 THEN -delta_mrr * 12 ELSE 0 END)
        - SUM(CASE WHEN delta_mrr > 0 THEN  delta_mrr * 12 ELSE 0 END),
        2
    ) AS contraction_minus_expansion_arr,
    ROUND(
        CASE
            WHEN SUM(CASE WHEN delta_mrr > 0 THEN delta_mrr * 12 ELSE 0 END) = 0 THEN NULL
            ELSE SUM(CASE WHEN delta_mrr < 0 THEN -delta_mrr * 12 ELSE 0 END)
                 / SUM(CASE WHEN delta_mrr > 0 THEN  delta_mrr * 12 ELSE 0 END)
        END,
        4
    ) AS contraction_to_expansion_ratio
FROM customer_deltas;

WITH q1_2026_bounds AS (
    SELECT
        TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00' AS q_start,
        TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01 00:00:00' AS q_end
),
valid_customers AS (
    SELECT customer_id
    FROM dim_customers
    WHERE COALESCE(is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
),
subscription_history AS (
    SELECT
        s.customer_id,
        s.sub_id,
        s.started_at,
        s.inserted,
        s.mrr,
        LAG(s.mrr) OVER (
            PARTITION BY s.sub_id
            ORDER BY COALESCE(s.started_at, s.inserted), s.inserted
        ) AS prev_mrr,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY s.sub_id
            ORDER BY COALESCE(s.started_at, s.inserted), s.inserted
        ) AS rn
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    INNER JOIN valid_customers c
        ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
    WHERE COALESCE(s.started_at, s.inserted) < (SELECT q_end FROM q1_2026_bounds)
),
q1_changes AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        sub_id,
        COALESCE(started_at, inserted) AS change_ts,
        prev_mrr,
        mrr,
        CASE
            WHEN rn > 1 AND mrr < prev_mrr THEN (prev_mrr - mrr) * 12
            ELSE 0
        END AS arr_contraction,
        CASE
            WHEN rn > 1 AND mrr > prev_mrr THEN (mrr - prev_mrr) * 12
            ELSE 0
        END AS arr_expansion
    FROM subscription_history
    WHERE COALESCE(started_at, inserted) >= (SELECT q_start FROM q1_2026_bounds)
      AND COALESCE(started_at, inserted) < (SELECT q_end FROM q1_2026_bounds)
),
aggregated AS (
    SELECT
        SUM(arr_contraction) AS q1_2026_arr_contraction,
        SUM(arr_expansion) AS q1_2026_arr_expansion
    FROM q1_changes
)
SELECT
    q1_2026_arr_contraction,
    q1_2026_arr_expansion,
    q1_2026_arr_contraction - q1_2026_arr_expansion AS arr_contraction_minus_expansion,
    CASE
        WHEN q1_2026_arr_expansion = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE q1_2026_arr_contraction / q1_2026_arr_expansion
    END AS contraction_to_expansion_ratio
FROM aggregated;

WITH active_subs AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    mrr,
    started_at,
    COALESCE(ended_at, TIMESTAMP '9999-12-31 23:59:59') AS ended_at
  FROM fct_subscriptions
  WHERE status IS NULL OR LOWER(status) NOT IN ('canceled', 'cancelled')
),
existing_customers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT customer_id
  FROM active_subs
  WHERE started_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
    AND ended_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
),
mrr_start AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    SUM(mrr) AS mrr_2026_01_01
  FROM active_subs
  WHERE started_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
    AND ended_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
  GROUP BY 1
),
mrr_end AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    SUM(mrr) AS mrr_2026_03_31
  FROM active_subs
  WHERE started_at <= TIMESTAMP '2026-03-31 23:59:59'
    AND ended_at > TIMESTAMP '2026-03-31 23:59:59'
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  SUM(GREATEST(COALESCE(me.mrr_2026_03_31, 0) - COALESCE(ms.mrr_2026_01_01, 0), 0)) AS arr_expansion_q1_2026
FROM existing_customers ec
LEFT JOIN mrr_start ms USING (customer_id)
LEFT JOIN mrr_end me USING (customer_id);

WITH active_subs AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    mrr,
    started_at,
    COALESCE(ended_at, TIMESTAMP '9999-12-31') AS ended_at
  FROM fct_subscriptions
  WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL
    AND COALESCE(status, '') NOT IN ('canceled', 'cancelled', 'inactive')
),
q1_start_mrr AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    SUM(mrr) AS mrr_start
  FROM active_subs
  WHERE started_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01'
    AND ended_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01'
  GROUP BY 1
),
q1_end_mrr AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    SUM(mrr) AS mrr_end
  FROM active_subs
  WHERE started_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01'
    AND ended_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01'
  GROUP BY 1
),
existing_customers AS (
  SELECT customer_id
  FROM q1_start_mrr
),
customer_expansion AS (
  SELECT
    e.customer_id,
    COALESCE(s.mrr_start, 0) AS mrr_start,
    COALESCE(q.mrr_end, 0) AS mrr_end,
    GREATEST(COALESCE(q.mrr_end, 0) - COALESCE(s.mrr_start, 0), 0) AS expansion_mrr
  FROM existing_customers e
  LEFT JOIN q1_start_mrr s ON e.customer_id = s.customer_id
  LEFT JOIN q1_end_mrr q ON e.customer_id = q.customer_id
  LEFT JOIN dim_customers d ON e.customer_id = d.customer_id
  WHERE COALESCE(d.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
)
SELECT
  SUM(expansion_mrr) AS q1_2026_existing_customer_book_expansion_mrr
FROM customer_expansion;

WITH customer_mrr AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    DATE_TRUNC('quarter', CAST(started_at AS DATE)) AS quarter_start,
    SUM(mrr) AS quarter_mrr
  FROM fct_subscriptions
  WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL
    AND status IS NOT NULL
    AND LOWER(status) IN ('active', 'trialing', 'past_due')
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
fy_quarters AS (
  SELECT
    DATE '2024-11-01' AS q1_start,
    DATE '2025-02-01' AS q2_start,
    DATE '2025-05-01' AS q3_start,
    DATE '2025-08-01' AS q4_start
),
existing_book AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT cm.customer_id
  FROM customer_mrr cm
  CROSS JOIN fy_quarters fy
  WHERE cm.quarter_start < fy.q4_start
),
q3_mrr AS (
  SELECT
    cm.customer_id,
    cm.quarter_mrr AS mrr_q3
  FROM customer_mrr cm
  CROSS JOIN fy_quarters fy
  WHERE cm.quarter_start = fy.q3_start
),
q4_mrr AS (
  SELECT
    cm.customer_id,
    cm.quarter_mrr AS mrr_q4
  FROM customer_mrr cm
  CROSS JOIN fy_quarters fy
  WHERE cm.quarter_start = fy.q4_start
)
SELECT
  SUM(GREATEST(COALESCE(q4.mrr_q4, 0) - COALESCE(q3.mrr_q3, 0), 0)) AS arr_expansion_q4_fy2025
FROM existing_book eb
LEFT JOIN q3_mrr q3 ON eb.customer_id = q3.customer_id
LEFT JOIN q4_mrr q4 ON eb.customer_id = q4.customer_id
LEFT JOIN dim_customers dc ON eb.customer_id = dc.customer_id
WHERE COALESCE(dc.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE;

WITH active_subs AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    started_at,
    COALESCE(ended_at, TIMESTAMP '9999-12-31 23:59:59') AS ended_at,
    mrr
  FROM fct_subscriptions
  WHERE status IS NULL OR lower(status) NOT IN ('cancelled', 'canceled')
),
q4_fy25 AS (
  SELECT
    TIMESTAMP '2024-11-01 00:00:00' AS q_start,
    TIMESTAMP '2025-01-31 23:59:59.999999' AS q_end
),
book_start AS (
  SELECT
    s.customer_id,
    SUM(s.mrr) AS mrr_start
  FROM active_subs s
  CROSS JOIN q4_fy25 q
  WHERE s.started_at <= q.q_start
    AND s.ended_at > q.q_start
  GROUP BY 1
),
book_end AS (
  SELECT
    s.customer_id,
    SUM(s.mrr) AS mrr_end
  FROM active_subs s
  CROSS JOIN q4_fy25 q
  WHERE s.started_at <= q.q_end
    AND s.ended_at > q.q_end
  GROUP BY 1
),
existing_book_expansion AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(GREATEST(COALESCE(be.mrr_end, 0) - bs.mrr_start, 0)) AS arr_expansion_q4_fy2025
  FROM book_start bs
  LEFT JOIN book_end be
    ON bs.customer_id = be.customer_id
  JOIN dim_customers c
    ON c.customer_id = bs.customer_id
  WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
)
SELECT COALESCE(arr_expansion_q4_fy2025, 0) AS arr_expansion
FROM existing_book_expansion;

WITH active_subs AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        started_at,
        COALESCE(ended_at, TIMESTAMP '9999-12-31') AS ended_at,
        mrr
    FROM fct_subscriptions
    WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL
      AND COALESCE(status, '') NOT IN ('canceled', 'cancelled')
),
existing_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT customer_id
    FROM active_subs
    WHERE started_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01'
      AND ended_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01'
),
mrr_start AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        SUM(mrr) AS mrr_at_start
    FROM active_subs
    WHERE started_at <= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01'
      AND ended_at > TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01'
    GROUP BY 1
),
mrr_end AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        SUM(mrr) AS mrr_at_end
    FROM active_subs
    WHERE started_at <= TIMESTAMP '2025-12-31 23:59:59'
      AND ended_at > TIMESTAMP '2025-12-31 23:59:59'
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
    SUM(GREATEST(COALESCE(me.mrr_at_end, 0) - COALESCE(ms.mrr_at_start, 0), 0)) AS arr_expansion_fy2025
FROM existing_customers ec
LEFT JOIN mrr_start ms ON ec.customer_id = ms.customer_id
LEFT JOIN mrr_end me ON ec.customer_id = me.customer_id;

WITH fy_bounds AS (
    SELECT
        TIMESTAMP '2024-02-01 00:00:00' AS fy_start,
        TIMESTAMP '2025-02-01 00:00:00' AS fy_end
),
starting_book AS (
    SELECT
        s.customer_id,
        s.mrr AS start_mrr
    FROM (
        SELECT
            s.*,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY s.customer_id
                ORDER BY s.started_at DESC, s.inserted DESC, s.sub_id DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM fct_subscriptions s
        CROSS JOIN fy_bounds b
        INNER JOIN dim_customers c
            ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
        WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
          AND s.started_at < b.fy_start
          AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= b.fy_start)
    ) s
    WHERE s.rn = 1
),
ending_book AS (
    SELECT
        s.customer_id,
        s.mrr AS end_mrr
    FROM (
        SELECT
            s.*,
            ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                PARTITION BY s.customer_id
                ORDER BY s.started_at DESC, s.inserted DESC, s.sub_id DESC
            ) AS rn
        FROM fct_subscriptions s
        CROSS JOIN fy_bounds b
        INNER JOIN dim_customers c
            ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
        WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
          AND s.started_at < b.fy_end
          AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= b.fy_end)
    ) s
    WHERE s.rn = 1
)
SELECT
    SUM(GREATEST(COALESCE(e.end_mrr, 0) - sb.start_mrr, 0)) * 12 AS arr_expansion_fy2025
FROM starting_book sb
LEFT JOIN ending_book e
    ON e.customer_id = sb.customer_id;

WITH customer_mrr AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        MAX(CASE
            WHEN started_at <= TIMESTAMP '2024-10-31 23:59:59'
             AND (ended_at IS NULL OR ended_at > TIMESTAMP '2024-10-31 23:59:59')
            THEN mrr
        END) AS mrr_start,
        MAX(CASE
            WHEN started_at <= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-31 23:59:59'
             AND (ended_at IS NULL OR ended_at > TIMESTAMP '2025-01-31 23:59:59')
            THEN mrr
        END) AS mrr_end
    FROM fct_subscriptions
    GROUP BY customer_id
)
SELECT
    SUM(
        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(mrr_start, 0) > 0 AND COALESCE(mrr_end, 0) > COALESCE(mrr_start, 0)
            THEN mrr_end - mrr_start
            ELSE 0
        END
    ) AS arr_expansion_q3_fy2025
FROM customer_mrr cm
JOIN dim_customers dc
  ON dc.customer_id = cm.customer_id
WHERE COALESCE(dc.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE;

WITH sub_history AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        started_at,
        COALESCE(ended_at, TIMESTAMP '9999-12-31 23:59:59') AS ended_at,
        mrr
    FROM fct_subscriptions
    WHERE customer_id IS NOT NULL
      AND COALESCE(status, '') NOT IN ('canceled', 'cancelled')
),
q3_2025 AS (
    SELECT
        DATE '2024-11-01' AS q_start,
        DATE '2025-01-31' AS q_end
),
baseline AS (
    SELECT
        s.customer_id,
        SUM(s.mrr) AS mrr_at_q_start
    FROM sub_history s
    CROSS JOIN q3_2025 q
    WHERE s.started_at < q.q_start
      AND s.ended_at >= q.q_start
    GROUP BY 1
),
ending AS (
    SELECT
        s.customer_id,
        SUM(s.mrr) AS mrr_at_q_end
    FROM sub_history s
    CROSS JOIN q3_2025 q
    WHERE s.started_at <= q.q_end + INTERVAL 1 DAY - INTERVAL 1 SECOND
      AND s.ended_at > q.q_end + INTERVAL 1 DAY - INTERVAL 1 SECOND
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
    SUM(GREATEST(COALESCE(e.mrr_at_q_end, 0) - COALESCE(b.mrr_at_q_start, 0), 0)) AS arr_expansion
FROM baseline b
LEFT JOIN ending e
    ON b.customer_id = e.customer_id
JOIN dim_customers c
    ON c.customer_id = b.customer_id
WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE;

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS bookings_q1_2026

WHERE paid_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01'
  AND paid_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01'

SELECT
  SUM(amount) AS bookings_q1_2026

WHERE paid_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
  AND paid_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01 00:00:00'

SELECT
  COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS bookings_fy2025

  AND i.paid_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01'

SELECT
  COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS bookings_fy2025

LEFT JOIN dim_customers c
  ON i.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE i.status = 'paid'
  AND i.paid_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01'
  AND i.paid_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01'

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS bookings_q4_fy2025

WHERE status = 'paid'
  AND paid_at >= TIMESTAMP '2024-11-01 00:00:00'

SELECT

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS march_2026_bookings

  AND paid_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01 00:00:00'

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS march_2026_bookings

WITH monthly_bookings AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('month', paid_at) AS booking_month,

  FROM fct_invoices
  WHERE paid_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-02-01'
    AND paid_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01'
    AND status = 'paid'

SELECT
  COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN booking_month = DATE '2026-02-01' THEN bookings END), 0) AS february_2026_bookings,

  COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN booking_month = DATE '2026-03-01' THEN bookings END), 0)
    - COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN booking_month = DATE '2026-02-01' THEN bookings END), 0) AS change_in_bookings
FROM monthly_bookings;

WITH monthly_bookings AS (
  SELECT
    date_trunc('month', paid_at) AS booking_month,
    SUM(amount) AS bookings
  FROM fct_invoices
  WHERE paid_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-02-01'
    AND paid_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01'
    AND status = 'paid'
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN booking_month = DATE '2026-02-01' THEN bookings END), 0) AS february_2026_bookings,
  COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN booking_month = DATE '2026-03-01' THEN bookings END), 0) AS march_2026_bookings,
  COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN booking_month = DATE '2026-03-01' THEN bookings END), 0)
    - COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN booking_month = DATE '2026-02-01' THEN bookings END), 0) AS change_in_bookings
FROM monthly_bookings;

WITH q1_2026_customers AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS new_customers
    FROM dim_customers
    WHERE COALESCE(is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
      AND COALESCE(signup_date, joined_dt) >= DATE '2026-01-01'
      AND COALESCE(signup_date, joined_dt) < DATE '2026-04-01'
),
q1_2026_mrr AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(mrr), 0) AS total_mrr
    FROM fct_subscriptions
    WHERE started_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
      AND started_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01 00:00:00'
      AND lower(COALESCE(status, '')) IN ('active', 'trialing', 'past_due', 'canceled', 'cancelled')
)
SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN c.new_customers = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE m.total_mrr / c.new_customers
    END AS cac
FROM q1_2026_customers c
CROSS JOIN q1_2026_mrr m;

WITH new_customers AS (
  SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS acquired_customers
  FROM dim_customers
  WHERE COALESCE(is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
    AND COALESCE(signup_date, joined_dt) >= DATE '2026-01-01'
    AND COALESCE(signup_date, joined_dt) < DATE '2026-04-01'

SELECT

WITH new_customers_fy2025 AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS new_customers
    FROM dim_customers
    WHERE COALESCE(is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
      AND signup_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
      AND signup_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
),
cac_revenue_fy2025 AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(mrr), 0) AS total_cac
    FROM fct_subscriptions
    WHERE started_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00'
      AND started_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'

WITH fy2025_customers AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS new_customers
    FROM dim_customers
    WHERE COALESCE(is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
      AND signup_date >= DATE '2025-01-01'
      AND signup_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
),
fy2025_revenue AS (
    SELECT SUM(mrr) AS total_mrr
    FROM fct_subscriptions
    WHERE started_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00'
      AND started_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'

WITH new_customers AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS new_customer_count
    FROM dim_customers
    WHERE COALESCE(is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
      AND DATE_TRUNC('month', COALESCE(signup_date, joined_dt)) = DATE '2026-03-01'
),
march_subscriptions AS (
    SELECT SUM(mrr) AS total_mrr
    FROM fct_subscriptions
    WHERE DATE_TRUNC('month', started_at) = DATE '2026-03-01'

WITH new_customers_q4_fy2025 AS (

new_mrr_q4_fy2025 AS (

    FROM (
        SELECT customer_id, mrr AS first_mrr
        FROM (
            SELECT
                customer_id,
                mrr,
                ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                    PARTITION BY customer_id
                    ORDER BY started_at, inserted, sub_id
                ) AS rn
            FROM fct_subscriptions
            WHERE started_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-10-01 00:00:00'
              AND started_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
              AND customer_id IS NOT NULL
        ) s
        WHERE rn = 1
    ) x
)
SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN nc.new_customers = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE nm.total_new_mrr / nc.new_customers
    END AS cac
FROM new_customers_q4_fy2025 nc

WITH q4_fy2025 AS (

),
customers_at_start AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT s.customer_id
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    CROSS JOIN q4_fy2025 q
    INNER JOIN base_customers c
        ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
    WHERE s.started_at < q.quarter_start
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= q.quarter_start)
),
churned_in_q4 AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT s.customer_id
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    CROSS JOIN q4_fy2025 q
    INNER JOIN customers_at_start cs
        ON cs.customer_id = s.customer_id
    WHERE s.ended_at >= q.quarter_start
      AND s.ended_at < q.quarter_end + INTERVAL 1 DAY
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM fct_subscriptions s2
          WHERE s2.customer_id = s.customer_id
            AND s2.started_at < q.quarter_end + INTERVAL 1 DAY
            AND (s2.ended_at IS NULL OR s2.ended_at >= q.quarter_end + INTERVAL 1 DAY)
      )
)

    COUNT(DISTINCT ch.customer_id) * 1.0 / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT cs.customer_id), 0) AS churn_rate

    ON ch.customer_id = cs.customer_id;

WITH revenue AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS revenue
  FROM fct_invoices
  WHERE status = 'paid'
    AND paid_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01'
    AND paid_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01'
),
cogs AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS cogs
  FROM fct_cogs
  WHERE period_month >= DATE '2026-01-01'
    AND period_month < DATE '2026-04-01'
)
SELECT
  revenue.revenue AS q1_2026_revenue,
  cogs.cogs AS q1_2026_cogs,
  revenue.revenue - cogs.cogs AS gross_profit,
  CASE
    WHEN revenue.revenue = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE (revenue.revenue - cogs.cogs) / revenue.revenue
  END AS gross_margin
FROM revenue
CROSS JOIN cogs;

WITH q_start AS (
  SELECT TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00' AS dt
),
q_end AS (
  SELECT TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01 00:00:00' AS dt
),
start_cohort AS (
  SELECT
    fs.customer_id,
    SUM(fs.mrr) AS start_mrr
  FROM fct_subscriptions fs
  CROSS JOIN q_start qs
  LEFT JOIN dim_customers dc
    ON dc.customer_id = fs.customer_id
  WHERE fs.started_at < qs.dt
    AND (fs.ended_at IS NULL OR fs.ended_at >= qs.dt)
    AND COALESCE(dc.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
  GROUP BY fs.customer_id
),
end_mrr AS (
  SELECT
    fs.customer_id,
    SUM(fs.mrr) AS end_mrr
  FROM fct_subscriptions fs
  CROSS JOIN q_end qe
  LEFT JOIN dim_customers dc
    ON dc.customer_id = fs.customer_id
  WHERE fs.started_at < qe.dt
    AND (fs.ended_at IS NULL OR fs.ended_at >= qe.dt)
    AND COALESCE(dc.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
  GROUP BY fs.customer_id
)
SELECT
  ROUND(
    100.0 * SUM(LEAST(sc.start_mrr, COALESCE(em.end_mrr, 0))) / NULLIF(SUM(sc.start_mrr), 0),
    2
  ) AS gross_revenue_retention_q1_2026_pct
FROM start_cohort sc
LEFT JOIN end_mrr em
  ON em.customer_id = sc.customer_id;

WITH active_start AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        SUM(mrr) AS start_mrr
    FROM fct_subscriptions
    WHERE started_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01'
      AND (ended_at IS NULL OR ended_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01')
      AND COALESCE(status, '') != 'canceled'
    GROUP BY 1
),
active_end AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        SUM(mrr) AS end_mrr
    FROM fct_subscriptions
    WHERE started_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01'
      AND (ended_at IS NULL OR ended_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01')
      AND COALESCE(status, '') != 'canceled'
    GROUP BY 1
),
base AS (
    SELECT
        s.customer_id,
        s.start_mrr,
        COALESCE(e.end_mrr, 0) AS end_mrr
    FROM active_start s
    LEFT JOIN active_end e
        ON s.customer_id = e.customer_id
    LEFT JOIN dim_customers c
        ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
    WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
)
SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN SUM(start_mrr) = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE SUM(LEAST(start_mrr, end_mrr)) / SUM(start_mrr)
    END AS gross_revenue_retention_q1_2026
FROM base;

WITH fy25_starting_mrr AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(s.customer_id, s.cust_id) AS customer_key,
        SUM(s.mrr) AS starting_mrr
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    LEFT JOIN dim_customers c
        ON COALESCE(s.customer_id, s.cust_id) = COALESCE(c.customer_id, c.cust_id)
    WHERE s.started_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01'
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01')
      AND COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
    GROUP BY 1
),
fy25_ending_mrr AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(s.customer_id, s.cust_id) AS customer_key,
        SUM(s.mrr) AS ending_mrr
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    LEFT JOIN dim_customers c
        ON COALESCE(s.customer_id, s.cust_id) = COALESCE(c.customer_id, c.cust_id)
    WHERE s.started_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01'
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01')
      AND COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
    SUM(LEAST(b.starting_mrr, COALESCE(e.ending_mrr, 0))) / NULLIF(SUM(b.starting_mrr), 0) AS gross_revenue_retention
FROM fy25_starting_mrr b
LEFT JOIN fy25_ending_mrr e
    ON b.customer_key = e.customer_key;

WITH fy_bounds AS (
    SELECT
        TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00' AS fy_start,
        TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00' AS fy_end
),
start_mrr AS (
    SELECT
        SUM(s.mrr) AS beginning_mrr
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    CROSS JOIN fy_bounds b
    JOIN dim_customers c
      ON COALESCE(s.customer_id, s.cust_id) = COALESCE(c.customer_id, c.cust_id)
    WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
      AND s.started_at < b.fy_start
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= b.fy_start)
),
retained_mrr AS (
    SELECT
        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= b.fy_end THEN s.mrr
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS ending_mrr_from_starting_cohort
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    CROSS JOIN fy_bounds b
    JOIN dim_customers c
      ON COALESCE(s.customer_id, s.cust_id) = COALESCE(c.customer_id, c.cust_id)
    WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
      AND s.started_at < b.fy_start
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= b.fy_start)
)
SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN sm.beginning_mrr = 0 OR sm.beginning_mrr IS NULL THEN NULL
        ELSE rm.ending_mrr_from_starting_cohort / sm.beginning_mrr
    END AS gross_revenue_retention_fy2025
FROM start_mrr sm
CROSS JOIN retained_mrr rm;

WITH fy_bounds AS (
    SELECT
        CASE
            WHEN EXTRACT(MONTH FROM CURRENT_DATE) >= 2
                THEN MAKE_DATE(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE)::INT, 2, 1)
            ELSE MAKE_DATE((EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) - 1)::INT, 2, 1)
        END AS current_fy_start
),
target_q AS (
    SELECT
        current_fy_start - INTERVAL '1 year' AS fy2025_start,
        current_fy_start - INTERVAL '6 months' AS q3_start,
        current_fy_start - INTERVAL '3 months' AS q3_end
    FROM fy_bounds
),
starting_mrr AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(s.mrr), 0) AS mrr_start
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    CROSS JOIN target_q t
    LEFT JOIN dim_customers c
        ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id OR c.cust_id = s.cust_id
    WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
      AND s.started_at < t.q3_start
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= t.q3_start)
),
retained_mrr AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(s.mrr), 0) AS mrr_retained
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    CROSS JOIN target_q t
    LEFT JOIN dim_customers c
        ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id OR c.cust_id = s.cust_id
    WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
      AND s.started_at < t.q3_start
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= t.q3_start)
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= t.q3_end)
)
SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN sm.mrr_start = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE rm.mrr_retained / sm.mrr_start
    END AS gross_retention
FROM starting_mrr sm
CROSS JOIN retained_mrr rm;

WITH fiscal_q3_bounds AS (
    SELECT
        TIMESTAMP '2025-02-01 00:00:00' AS q_start,
        TIMESTAMP '2025-05-01 00:00:00' AS q_end
),
starting_mrr AS (
    SELECT
        SUM(s.mrr) AS start_mrr
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    CROSS JOIN fiscal_q3_bounds b

        ON COALESCE(s.customer_id, s.cust_id) = COALESCE(c.customer_id, c.cust_id)
    WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
      AND s.started_at < b.q_start
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= b.q_start)
),
retained_mrr AS (
    SELECT
        SUM(s.mrr) AS retained_mrr
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    CROSS JOIN fiscal_q3_bounds b
    LEFT JOIN dim_customers c
        ON COALESCE(s.customer_id, s.cust_id) = COALESCE(c.customer_id, c.cust_id)
    WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
      AND s.started_at < b.q_start
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= b.q_start)
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= b.q_end)
)
SELECT
    retained_mrr / NULLIF(start_mrr, 0) AS gross_retention
FROM starting_mrr, retained_mrr;

active_end AS (

base_customers AS (

WITH cohort AS (

fy_end_mrr AS (

WITH fy2025_window AS (

),
valid_customers AS (

),
starting_mrr AS (

),
ending_mrr AS (

  FROM fct_subscriptions s
  CROSS JOIN fy2025_window w
  JOIN starting_mrr b

  WHERE s.started_at < w.fy_end
    AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= w.fy_end)
  GROUP BY s.customer_id
)
SELECT
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(COALESCE(e.end_mrr, 0)) / NULLIF(SUM(b.start_mrr), 0), 2) AS net_revenue_retention_pct
FROM starting_mrr b
LEFT JOIN ending_mrr e
  ON e.customer_id = b.customer_id;

WITH fy_bounds AS (

),
eligible_customers AS (

),
opening_mrr AS (

    WHERE s.started_at < b.fy_start
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= b.fy_start)
      AND COALESCE(s.status, '') <> 'canceled'
    GROUP BY s.customer_id
),
ending_mrr AS (
    SELECT
        s.customer_id,
        SUM(s.mrr) AS ending_mrr
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    CROSS JOIN fy_bounds b
    JOIN opening_mrr o
      ON o.customer_id = s.customer_id
    WHERE s.started_at < b.fy_end
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= b.fy_end)
      AND COALESCE(s.status, '') <> 'canceled'
    GROUP BY s.customer_id
),
retention AS (
    SELECT
        SUM(o.opening_mrr) AS starting_mrr,
        SUM(LEAST(COALESCE(e.ending_mrr, 0), o.opening_mrr)) AS gross_retained_mrr,
        SUM(COALESCE(e.ending_mrr, 0)) AS ending_mrr_from_starting_customers
    FROM opening_mrr o
    LEFT JOIN ending_mrr e
      ON e.customer_id = o.customer_id
)
SELECT
    'FY2025' AS fiscal_year,
    starting_mrr,
    gross_retained_mrr,
    ending_mrr_from_starting_customers AS net_retained_mrr,
    ROUND(100.0 * gross_retained_mrr / NULLIF(starting_mrr, 0), 2) AS gross_retention_pct,
    ROUND(100.0 * ending_mrr_from_starting_customers / NULLIF(starting_mrr, 0), 2) AS net_retention_pct
FROM retention;

WITH fy AS (
  SELECT
    TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00' AS fy_start,
    TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00' AS fy_end
),
base_customers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT s.customer_id
  FROM fct_subscriptions s
  CROSS JOIN fy
  LEFT JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
  WHERE s.customer_id IS NOT NULL
    AND s.started_at < fy.fy_start
    AND COALESCE(s.ended_at, TIMESTAMP '9999-12-31 00:00:00') >= fy.fy_start
    AND COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
),
starting_mrr AS (
  SELECT
    s.customer_id,
    SUM(s.mrr) AS start_mrr
  FROM fct_subscriptions s
  CROSS JOIN fy
  INNER JOIN base_customers b ON b.customer_id = s.customer_id
  WHERE s.started_at < fy.fy_start
    AND COALESCE(s.ended_at, TIMESTAMP '9999-12-31 00:00:00') >= fy.fy_start
  GROUP BY 1
),
ending_mrr AS (
  SELECT
    s.customer_id,
    SUM(s.mrr) AS end_mrr
  FROM fct_subscriptions s
  CROSS JOIN fy
  INNER JOIN base_customers b ON b.customer_id = s.customer_id
  WHERE s.started_at < fy.fy_end
    AND COALESCE(s.ended_at, TIMESTAMP '9999-12-31 00:00:00') >= fy.fy_end
  GROUP BY 1
),
customer_retention AS (
  SELECT
    b.customer_id,
    sm.start_mrr,
    COALESCE(em.end_mrr, 0) AS end_mrr,
    LEAST(COALESCE(em.end_mrr, 0), sm.start_mrr) AS gross_retained_mrr
  FROM base_customers b
  JOIN starting_mrr sm ON sm.customer_id = b.customer_id
  LEFT JOIN ending_mrr em ON em.customer_id = b.customer_id
)
SELECT
  'FY2025' AS fiscal_year,
  SUM(start_mrr) AS starting_mrr,
  SUM(end_mrr) AS ending_mrr_from_starting_cohort,
  SUM(gross_retained_mrr) AS gross_retained_mrr,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(end_mrr) / NULLIF(SUM(start_mrr), 0), 2) AS net_retention_pct,
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(gross_retained_mrr) / NULLIF(SUM(start_mrr), 0), 2) AS gross_retention_pct
FROM customer_retention;

WITH params AS (
  SELECT
    DATE '2024-11-01' AS q4_start,
    DATE '2025-02-01' AS q4_end
),
eligible_customers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_id
  FROM dim_customers c
  CROSS JOIN params p
  WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
),
start_mrr AS (
  SELECT
    s.customer_id,
    SUM(s.mrr) AS mrr_start
  FROM fct_subscriptions s
  JOIN eligible_customers ec
    ON ec.customer_id = s.customer_id
  CROSS JOIN params p
  WHERE s.started_at < p.q4_start
    AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= p.q4_start)
  GROUP BY 1
),
end_mrr AS (
  SELECT
    s.customer_id,
    SUM(s.mrr) AS mrr_end
  FROM fct_subscriptions s
  JOIN start_mrr sm
    ON sm.customer_id = s.customer_id
  CROSS JOIN params p
  WHERE s.started_at < p.q4_end
    AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= p.q4_end)
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(COALESCE(em.mrr_end, 0)) / NULLIF(SUM(sm.mrr_start), 0), 2) AS net_revenue_retention_pct
FROM start_mrr sm
LEFT JOIN end_mrr em
  ON em.customer_id = sm.customer_id;

WITH fiscal_bounds AS (
  SELECT
    DATE '2024-11-01' AS q4_start,
    DATE '2025-02-01' AS q4_end
),
baseline_customers AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT fs.customer_id
  FROM fct_subscriptions fs
  CROSS JOIN fiscal_bounds fb
  JOIN dim_customers dc
    ON dc.customer_id = fs.customer_id
  WHERE COALESCE(dc.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
    AND fs.started_at < fb.q4_start
    AND (fs.ended_at IS NULL OR fs.ended_at >= fb.q4_start)
),
starting_mrr AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(fs.mrr) AS start_mrr
  FROM fct_subscriptions fs
  CROSS JOIN fiscal_bounds fb
  JOIN baseline_customers bc
    ON bc.customer_id = fs.customer_id
  WHERE fs.started_at < fb.q4_start
    AND (fs.ended_at IS NULL OR fs.ended_at >= fb.q4_start)
),
ending_mrr AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(fs.mrr) AS end_mrr
  FROM fct_subscriptions fs
  CROSS JOIN fiscal_bounds fb
  JOIN baseline_customers bc
    ON bc.customer_id = fs.customer_id
  WHERE fs.started_at < fb.q4_end
    AND (fs.ended_at IS NULL OR fs.ended_at >= fb.q4_end)
)
SELECT
  ROUND(100.0 * e.end_mrr / NULLIF(s.start_mrr, 0), 2) AS net_revenue_retention_pct
FROM starting_mrr s
CROSS JOIN ending_mrr e;
