WITH as_of AS (
    SELECT DATE '2026-03-31' AS dt
),
valid_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.customer_id
    FROM dim_customers c
    CROSS JOIN as_of a
    WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
      AND c.signup_date IS NOT NULL
      AND c.signup_date <= a.dt
),
new_customers_12m AS (
    SELECT
        c.customer_id,
        c.signup_date
    FROM dim_customers c
    CROSS JOIN as_of a
    WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
      AND c.signup_date > a.dt - INTERVAL '12 months'
      AND c.signup_date <= a.dt
),
active_mrr AS (
    SELECT
        s.customer_id,
        SUM(COALESCE(s.mrr, 0)) AS current_mrr
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    CROSS JOIN as_of a
    INNER JOIN valid_customers vc
        ON vc.customer_id = s.customer_id
    WHERE s.started_at <= a.dt + INTERVAL '1 day' - INTERVAL '1 second'
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at > a.dt)
      AND COALESCE(LOWER(s.status), '') NOT IN ('canceled', 'cancelled', 'ended', 'inactive')
    GROUP BY 1
),
arr_new_customers AS (
    SELECT
        SUM(COALESCE(am.current_mrr, 0) * 12.0) AS new_customer_arr
    FROM new_customers_12m n
    LEFT JOIN active_mrr am
        ON am.customer_id = n.customer_id
),
paid_invoices_12m AS (
    SELECT
        SUM(COALESCE(i.amount, 0)) AS cac_spend_12m
    FROM fct_invoices i
    CROSS JOIN as_of a
    INNER JOIN valid_customers vc
        ON vc.customer_id = i.customer_id
    WHERE i.paid_at > a.dt - INTERVAL '12 months'
      AND i.paid_at <= a.dt + INTERVAL '1 day' - INTERVAL '1 second'
      AND COALESCE(LOWER(i.status), '') IN ('paid', 'succeeded', 'settled')
)
SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN COALESCE(anc.new_customer_arr, 0) = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE (COALESCE(pi.cac_spend_12m, 0) / anc.new_customer_arr) * 12.0
    END AS cac_payback_period_months
FROM arr_new_customers anc
CROSS JOIN paid_invoices_12m pi;

WITH params AS (
    SELECT DATE '2026-03-31' AS as_of_date
),
customers AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        COALESCE(signup_date, joined_dt) AS acquired_date
    FROM dim_customers
    WHERE COALESCE(is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
      AND COALESCE(signup_date, joined_dt) IS NOT NULL
      AND COALESCE(signup_date, joined_dt) <= (SELECT as_of_date FROM params)
),
monthly_cash AS (
    SELECT
        fi.customer_id,
        DATE_TRUNC('month', fi.paid_at) AS cash_month,
        SUM(fi.amount) AS cash_collected
    FROM fct_invoices fi
    JOIN customers c
      ON c.customer_id = fi.customer_id
    WHERE fi.paid_at IS NOT NULL
      AND fi.paid_at <= (SELECT as_of_date FROM params)
      AND COALESCE(fi.status, '') NOT IN ('void', 'failed', 'refunded')
    GROUP BY 1, 2
),
cash_with_age AS (
    SELECT
        c.customer_id,
        DATE_DIFF('month', DATE_TRUNC('month', c.acquired_date), mc.cash_month) + 1 AS month_num,
        mc.cash_collected
    FROM monthly_cash mc
    JOIN customers c
      ON c.customer_id = mc.customer_id
    WHERE mc.cash_month >= DATE_TRUNC('month', c.acquired_date)
),
cohort_cash AS (
    SELECT
        month_num,
        SUM(cash_collected) AS total_cash
    FROM cash_with_age
    GROUP BY 1
),
cumulative_cash AS (
    SELECT
        month_num,
        SUM(total_cash) OVER (ORDER BY month_num ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cum_cash
    FROM cohort_cash
),
estimated_cac AS (
    SELECT AVG(amount) AS cac
    FROM fct_invoices fi
    JOIN customers c
      ON c.customer_id = fi.customer_id
    WHERE fi.paid_at IS NOT NULL
      AND fi.paid_at <= (SELECT as_of_date FROM params)
      AND COALESCE(fi.status, '') NOT IN ('void', 'failed', 'refunded')
      AND DATE_TRUNC('month', fi.paid_at) = DATE_TRUNC('month', c.acquired_date)
)
SELECT
    MIN(cc.month_num) AS cac_payback_period_months
FROM cumulative_cash cc
CROSS JOIN estimated_cac ec
WHERE cc.cum_cash >= ec.cac

WITH params AS (
  SELECT DATE '2025-12-31' AS as_of_date
),
eligible_customers AS (
  SELECT
    c.customer_id,
    c.signup_date
  FROM dim_customers c
  CROSS JOIN params p
  WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
    AND c.signup_date IS NOT NULL
    AND c.signup_date <= p.as_of_date
),
customer_revenue AS (
  SELECT
    ec.customer_id,
    ec.signup_date,
    COALESCE(SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN i.paid_at IS NOT NULL
         AND CAST(i.paid_at AS DATE) <= (SELECT as_of_date FROM params)
        THEN i.amount
        ELSE 0
      END
    ), 0) AS cumulative_revenue
  FROM eligible_customers ec
  LEFT JOIN fct_invoices i
    ON i.customer_id = ec.customer_id
   AND i.status = 'paid'
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
customer_cost AS (
  SELECT
    ec.customer_id,
    COALESCE(SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN s.started_at IS NOT NULL
         AND CAST(s.started_at AS DATE) <= (SELECT as_of_date FROM params)
        THEN s.mrr * (
          GREATEST(
            0,
            date_diff(
              'month',
              GREATEST(CAST(s.started_at AS DATE), ec.signup_date),
              LEAST(
                COALESCE(CAST(s.ended_at AS DATE), (SELECT as_of_date FROM params)),
                (SELECT as_of_date FROM params)
              )
            ) + 1
          )
        )
        ELSE 0
      END
    ), 0) AS cumulative_cost
  FROM eligible_customers ec
  LEFT JOIN fct_subscriptions s
    ON s.customer_id = ec.customer_id
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  AVG(
    CASE
      WHEN cc.cumulative_cost > 0
      THEN date_diff('day', cr.signup_date, (SELECT as_of_date FROM params))::DOUBLE
           * cc.cumulative_cost
           / NULLIF(cr.cumulative_revenue, 0)
      ELSE NULL
    END
  ) AS payback_period_days_as_of_2025_12_31
FROM customer_revenue cr
JOIN customer_cost cc
  ON cr.customer_id = cc.customer_id
WHERE cr.cumulative_revenue > 0;

WITH as_of AS (
    SELECT DATE '2025-12-31' AS dt
),
valid_customers AS (
    SELECT customer_id
    FROM dim_customers
    WHERE COALESCE(is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
),
subscription_mrr AS (
    SELECT
        s.customer_id,
        SUM(s.mrr) AS active_mrr
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    CROSS JOIN as_of a
    INNER JOIN valid_customers vc
        ON vc.customer_id = s.customer_id
    WHERE s.started_at <= a.dt + INTERVAL '1 day' - INTERVAL '1 second'
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at > a.dt + INTERVAL '1 day' - INTERVAL '1 second')
      AND COALESCE(LOWER(s.status), '') NOT IN ('canceled', 'cancelled', 'ended', 'inactive')
    GROUP BY s.customer_id
),
customer_start AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        MIN(started_at) AS first_started_at
    FROM fct_subscriptions
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
invoice_collections AS (
    SELECT
        i.customer_id,
        SUM(i.amount) AS collected_revenue
    FROM fct_invoices i
    CROSS JOIN as_of a
    INNER JOIN valid_customers vc
        ON vc.customer_id = i.customer_id
    WHERE i.paid_at IS NOT NULL
      AND i.paid_at <= a.dt + INTERVAL '1 day' - INTERVAL '1 second'
      AND COALESCE(LOWER(i.status), '') IN ('paid', 'succeeded', 'success', 'settled')
    GROUP BY i.customer_id
),
customer_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        vc.customer_id,
        cs.first_started_at,
        COALESCE(sm.active_mrr, 0) AS active_mrr,
        COALESCE(ic.collected_revenue, 0) AS collected_revenue,
        GREATEST(
            1,
            date_diff('month', CAST(cs.first_started_at AS DATE), DATE '2025-12-31') + 1
        ) AS months_active
    FROM valid_customers vc
    LEFT JOIN customer_start cs
        ON cs.customer_id = vc.customer_id
    LEFT JOIN subscription_mrr sm
        ON sm.customer_id = vc.customer_id
    LEFT JOIN invoice_collections ic
        ON ic.customer_id = vc.customer_id
    WHERE cs.first_started_at IS NOT NULL
),
aggregated AS (
    SELECT
        SUM(active_mrr) AS ending_mrr,
        SUM(CASE WHEN months_active > 0 THEN collected_revenue / months_active ELSE 0 END) AS est_avg_monthly_collection
    FROM customer_metrics
)
SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN est_avg_monthly_collection = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE ending_mrr / est_avg_monthly_collection
    END AS payback_period_months
FROM aggregated;

WITH fy_end AS (
    SELECT DATE '2025-12-31' AS fy_end_date
),
eligible_customers AS (
    SELECT
        dc.customer_id,
        COALESCE(dc.signup_date, dc.joined_dt) AS acquired_date
    FROM dim_customers dc
    CROSS JOIN fy_end f
    WHERE COALESCE(dc.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
      AND COALESCE(dc.signup_date, dc.joined_dt) IS NOT NULL
      AND COALESCE(dc.signup_date, dc.joined_dt) <= f.fy_end_date
),
cash_collected AS (
    SELECT
        fi.customer_id,
        SUM(fi.amount) AS total_cash_collected
    FROM fct_invoices fi
    CROSS JOIN fy_end f
    WHERE fi.paid_at IS NOT NULL
      AND CAST(fi.paid_at AS DATE) <= f.fy_end_date
      AND COALESCE(fi.status, '') IN ('paid', 'Paid', 'PAID')
    GROUP BY 1
),
customer_payback AS (
    SELECT
        ec.customer_id,
        ec.acquired_date,
        cc.total_cash_collected,
        CASE
            WHEN cc.total_cash_collected IS NOT NULL AND cc.total_cash_collected > 0
                THEN date_diff('day', ec.acquired_date, (SELECT fy_end_date FROM fy_end)) / 30.4375
            ELSE NULL
        END AS payback_period_months
    FROM eligible_customers ec
    LEFT JOIN cash_collected cc
      ON ec.customer_id = cc.customer_id
)
SELECT
    AVG(payback_period_months) AS cac_payback_period_months_as_of_fy2025_end
FROM customer_payback
WHERE total_cash_collected IS NOT NULL
  AND total_cash_collected > 0;

WITH fy_end AS (
    SELECT DATE '2025-12-31' AS fy_end_date
),
eligible_customers AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        COALESCE(signup_date, joined_dt) AS acquired_date
    FROM dim_customers
    WHERE COALESCE(is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
      AND COALESCE(signup_date, joined_dt) IS NOT NULL
      AND COALESCE(signup_date, joined_dt) <= (SELECT fy_end_date FROM fy_end)
),
customer_mrr AS (
    SELECT
        ec.customer_id,
        ec.acquired_date,
        COALESCE((
            SELECT fs.mrr
            FROM fct_subscriptions fs
            WHERE fs.customer_id = ec.customer_id
              AND fs.started_at <= (SELECT fy_end_date FROM fy_end) + INTERVAL '1 day' - INTERVAL '1 second'
              AND (fs.ended_at IS NULL OR fs.ended_at > (SELECT fy_end_date FROM fy_end))
            ORDER BY fs.started_at DESC, fs.inserted DESC
            LIMIT 1
        ), 0) AS current_mrr
    FROM eligible_customers ec
),
payback_by_customer AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        acquired_date,
        current_mrr,
        CASE
            WHEN current_mrr > 0 THEN DATEDIFF('day', acquired_date, (SELECT fy_end_date FROM fy_end)) / 30.4375
            ELSE NULL
        END AS months_to_payback
    FROM customer_mrr
)
SELECT AVG(months_to_payback) AS cac_payback_period_months
FROM payback_by_customer;

WITH quarter_bounds AS (
  SELECT
    DATE '2026-04-01' AS q2_start,
    DATE '2026-07-01' AS q3_start
),
snapshot_events AS (
  SELECT
    event_id,
    customer_id,
    user_id,
    "timestamp",
    properties_jsonb,
    TRY_CAST(properties_jsonb ->> 'pipeline_coverage' AS DOUBLE) AS pipeline_coverage,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      ORDER BY "timestamp" DESC, inserted_at DESC, event_id DESC
    ) AS rn
  FROM fct_events, quarter_bounds
  WHERE "timestamp" < q2_start
    AND TRY_CAST(properties_jsonb ->> 'pipeline_coverage' AS DOUBLE) IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT pipeline_coverage
FROM snapshot_events
WHERE rn = 1;

WITH coverage_events AS (
  SELECT
    "timestamp",
    TRY_CAST(json_extract_string(properties_jsonb, '$.pipeline_coverage') AS DOUBLE) AS pipeline_coverage
  FROM fct_events
  WHERE TRY_CAST(json_extract_string(properties_jsonb, '$.pipeline_coverage') AS DOUBLE) IS NOT NULL
),
q1_fy2026_start AS (
  SELECT DATE '2025-02-01' AS dt
)
SELECT
  pipeline_coverage
FROM coverage_events, q1_fy2026_start
WHERE "timestamp" < dt
ORDER BY "timestamp" DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH quarter_starts AS (
  SELECT
    DATE '2025-02-01' AS q1_fy2026_start,
    DATE '2024-11-01' AS prior_quarter_start
),
stage_events AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    user_id,
    "timestamp",
    TRY_CAST(json_extract_string(properties_jsonb, '$.amount') AS DOUBLE) AS amount,
    lower(coalesce(json_extract_string(properties_jsonb, '$.stage'), '')) AS stage
  FROM fct_events
  WHERE "timestamp" < (SELECT q1_fy2026_start FROM quarter_starts)
),
open_pipeline_as_of_q1 AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    user_id,
    amount
  FROM stage_events
  WHERE "timestamp" >= (SELECT prior_quarter_start FROM quarter_starts)
    AND stage IN ('pipeline', 'qualified', 'proposal', 'negotiation', 'commit')
),
closed_won_as_of_q1 AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    user_id,
    amount
  FROM stage_events
  WHERE "timestamp" >= (SELECT q1_fy2026_start FROM quarter_starts)
    AND stage IN ('closed won', 'won')
    AND "timestamp" < (SELECT q1_fy2026_start FROM quarter_starts) + INTERVAL 3 MONTH
)
SELECT
  SUM(o.amount) / NULLIF(SUM(c.amount), 0) AS pipeline_coverage

WITH quarter_events AS (
  SELECT
    event_id,
    user_id,
    customer_id,
    event_type,
    "timestamp",
    properties_jsonb,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
      ORDER BY "timestamp" DESC, inserted_at DESC, event_id DESC
    ) AS rn
  FROM fct_events
  WHERE lower(event_type) = 'pipeline_coverage'
    AND "timestamp" < TIMESTAMP '2024-11-01 00:00:00'
),
latest_event AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM quarter_events
  WHERE rn = 1
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(
    TRY_CAST(json_extract_string(properties_jsonb, '$.value') AS DOUBLE),
    TRY_CAST(json_extract_string(properties_jsonb, '$.pipeline_coverage') AS DOUBLE),
    TRY_CAST(json_extract_string(properties_jsonb, '$.metric_value') AS DOUBLE),
    TRY_CAST(json_extract_string(properties_jsonb, '$.coverage') AS DOUBLE)
  ) AS pipeline_coverage
FROM latest_event;

WITH fy_bounds AS (
  SELECT
    CASE
      WHEN EXTRACT(month FROM CURRENT_DATE) >= 2
        THEN MAKE_DATE(EXTRACT(year FROM CURRENT_DATE)::INT, 2, 1)
      ELSE MAKE_DATE((EXTRACT(year FROM CURRENT_DATE) - 1)::INT, 2, 1)
    END AS current_fy_start
),
target_q2_end AS (
  SELECT (current_fy_start + INTERVAL '1 year' + INTERVAL '5 months' - INTERVAL '1 day')::DATE AS q2_end_date
  FROM fy_bounds
),
coverage_events AS (
  SELECT
    e."timestamp",
    TRY_CAST(json_extract_string(e.properties_jsonb, '$.pipeline_coverage') AS DOUBLE) AS pipeline_coverage
  FROM fct_events e
  CROSS JOIN target_q2_end t
  WHERE e."timestamp" < t.q2_end_date + INTERVAL '1 day'
    AND TRY_CAST(json_extract_string(e.properties_jsonb, '$.pipeline_coverage') AS DOUBLE) IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT pipeline_coverage
FROM coverage_events
QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY "timestamp" DESC) = 1;

WITH coverage_events AS (
  SELECT
    "timestamp",
    TRY_CAST(json_extract_string(properties_jsonb, '$.pipeline_coverage') AS DOUBLE) AS pipeline_coverage,
    TRY_CAST(json_extract_string(properties_jsonb, '$.fiscal_year') AS INTEGER) AS fiscal_year,
    TRY_CAST(json_extract_string(properties_jsonb, '$.fiscal_quarter') AS INTEGER) AS fiscal_quarter
  FROM fct_events
  WHERE event_type = 'pipeline_coverage'
)
SELECT pipeline_coverage
FROM coverage_events
WHERE fiscal_year = 2025
  AND fiscal_quarter = 2
  AND pipeline_coverage IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY "timestamp" DESC
LIMIT 1;

WITH monthly_revenue AS (

  FROM fct_invoices

    AND paid_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-02-01'
    AND paid_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01'
  GROUP BY 1

feb_mar AS (
  SELECT
    MAX(CASE WHEN revenue_month = DATE '2026-02-01' THEN revenue END) AS feb_2026_revenue,
    MAX(CASE WHEN revenue_month = DATE '2026-03-01' THEN revenue END) AS mar_2026_revenue
  FROM monthly_revenue
)
SELECT
  feb_2026_revenue,
  mar_2026_revenue,
  mar_2026_revenue - feb_2026_revenue AS revenue_change,
  CASE
    WHEN feb_2026_revenue = 0 OR feb_2026_revenue IS NULL THEN NULL
    ELSE (mar_2026_revenue - feb_2026_revenue) / feb_2026_revenue
  END AS pct_change
FROM feb_mar;

WITH q1_events AS (
  SELECT event_type
  FROM fct_events
  WHERE "timestamp" >= TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01'
    AND "timestamp" < TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01'
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE lower(event_type) IN ('won', 'win', 'closed_won', 'closed won')) = 0
         AND COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE lower(event_type) IN ('lost', 'loss', 'closed_lost', 'closed lost')) = 0
      THEN NULL
    ELSE 1.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE lower(event_type) IN ('won', 'win', 'closed_won', 'closed won'))
         / NULLIF(
             COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE lower(event_type) IN ('won', 'win', 'closed_won', 'closed won', 'lost', 'loss', 'closed_lost', 'closed lost')),
             0
           )
  END AS sales_win_rate_q1_2026
FROM q1_events;

WITH q1_2026 AS (
  SELECT
    event_type
  FROM fct_events
  WHERE "timestamp" >= TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01'
    AND "timestamp" < TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01'
),
agg AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN lower(event_type) = 'opportunity_won' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS won_count,
    SUM(CASE WHEN lower(event_type) IN ('opportunity_won', 'opportunity_lost') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS closed_count
  FROM q1_2026
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN closed_count = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE won_count * 1.0 / closed_count
  END AS sales_win_rate_q1_2026
FROM agg;

SELECT
  100.0 * AVG(
    CASE
      WHEN lower(event_type) IN ('closed_won', 'won', 'win', 'opportunity_won', 'deal_won') THEN 1.0
      WHEN lower(event_type) IN ('closed_lost', 'lost', 'loss', 'opportunity_lost', 'deal_lost') THEN 0.0
      ELSE NULL
    END
  ) AS win_rate_q4_fy2025
FROM fct_events
WHERE "timestamp" >= TIMESTAMP '2025-10-01'
  AND "timestamp" < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01'
  AND lower(event_type) IN (
    'closed_won', 'won', 'win', 'opportunity_won', 'deal_won',
    'closed_lost', 'lost', 'loss', 'opportunity_lost', 'deal_lost'
  );

WITH opp_events AS (
  SELECT
    event_id,
    customer_id,
    user_id,
    "timestamp",
    event_type,
    CAST(json_extract_string(properties_jsonb, '$.opportunity_id') AS VARCHAR) AS opportunity_id,
    lower(COALESCE(json_extract_string(properties_jsonb, '$.stage'), json_extract_string(properties_jsonb, '$.status'))) AS stage_value,
    lower(COALESCE(json_extract_string(properties_jsonb, '$.result'), json_extract_string(properties_jsonb, '$.outcome'))) AS outcome_value,
    CAST(json_extract_string(properties_jsonb, '$.is_won') AS VARCHAR) AS is_won_value,
    CAST(json_extract_string(properties_jsonb, '$.close_date') AS DATE) AS close_date
  FROM fct_events
),
closed_opps AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    opportunity_id,
    COALESCE(close_date, CAST("timestamp" AS DATE)) AS closed_date,
    CASE
      WHEN stage_value LIKE '%closed won%' OR outcome_value = 'won' OR lower(is_won_value) = 'true' THEN 1
      WHEN stage_value LIKE '%closed lost%' OR outcome_value = 'lost' OR lower(is_won_value) = 'false' THEN 0
      ELSE NULL
    END AS won_flag
  FROM opp_events
  WHERE opportunity_id IS NOT NULL
    AND (
      stage_value LIKE '%closed won%'
      OR stage_value LIKE '%closed lost%'
      OR outcome_value IN ('won', 'lost')
      OR lower(is_won_value) IN ('true', 'false')
      OR event_type ILIKE '%closed%'
      OR event_type ILIKE '%won%'
      OR event_type ILIKE '%lost%'
    )
),
q4_fy2025 AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM closed_opps
  WHERE won_flag IS NOT NULL
    AND closed_date >= DATE '2024-11-01'
    AND closed_date < DATE '2025-02-01'
)
SELECT
  AVG(won_flag)::DOUBLE AS win_rate
FROM q4_fy2025;

WITH fy2025_opps AS (
  SELECT
    event_id,
    customer_id,
    user_id,
    properties_jsonb ->> 'opportunity_id' AS opportunity_id,
    lower(coalesce(properties_jsonb ->> 'stage', properties_jsonb ->> 'status', '')) AS outcome
  FROM fct_events
  WHERE event_type IN ('opportunity_closed', 'opportunity_updated', 'deal_closed', 'deal_updated')
    AND "timestamp" >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01'
    AND "timestamp" < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01'
    AND coalesce(properties_jsonb ->> 'opportunity_id', event_id) IS NOT NULL
),
dedup AS (
  SELECT
    coalesce(opportunity_id, event_id) AS opp_key,
    outcome,
    row_number() OVER (
      PARTITION BY coalesce(opportunity_id, event_id)
      ORDER BY event_id
    ) AS rn
  FROM fy2025_opps
  WHERE outcome IN ('won', 'win', 'closed won', 'lost', 'lose', 'closed lost')
)
SELECT
  100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN outcome IN ('won', 'win', 'closed won') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS win_rate
FROM dedup
WHERE rn = 1;

WITH active_users_by_month AS (
  SELECT
    date_trunc(
      'month',
      CASE
        WHEN e.timezone = 'America/Los_Angeles' THEN e."timestamp" + INTERVAL '8 hours'
        ELSE e."timestamp"
      END
    ) AS month_start,
    COUNT(DISTINCT e.user_id) AS active_users
  FROM fct_events e
  INNER JOIN dim_users u
    ON e.user_id = u.user_id
  INNER JOIN dim_customers c
    ON u.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE c.is_test = FALSE
    AND e.event_type IN ('login', 'page_view', 'action_performed', 'feature_used', 'logout')
    AND month_start IN (DATE '2026-02-01', DATE '2026-03-01')
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  MAX(CASE WHEN month_start = DATE '2026-02-01' THEN active_users END) AS active_users_feb_2026,
  MAX(CASE WHEN month_start = DATE '2026-03-01' THEN active_users END) AS active_users_mar_2026,
  MAX(CASE WHEN month_start = DATE '2026-03-01' THEN active_users END)
    - MAX(CASE WHEN month_start = DATE '2026-02-01' THEN active_users END) AS mom_change_users,
  ROUND(
    (
      MAX(CASE WHEN month_start = DATE '2026-03-01' THEN active_users END)
      - MAX(CASE WHEN month_start = DATE '2026-02-01' THEN active_users END)
    ) * 100.0
    / NULLIF(MAX(CASE WHEN month_start = DATE '2026-02-01' THEN active_users END), 0),
    2
  ) AS mom_change_pct
FROM active_users_by_month;

WITH event_activity AS (
  SELECT
    e.user_id,
    date_trunc(
      'month',
      CASE
        WHEN e.timezone = 'America/Los_Angeles' THEN e."timestamp" + INTERVAL 8 HOUR
        ELSE e."timestamp"
      END
    ) AS activity_month
  FROM fct_events e
  INNER JOIN dim_users u
    ON e.user_id = u.user_id
  INNER JOIN dim_customers c
    ON u.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE c.is_test = FALSE
    AND u.deleted_at IS NULL
    AND e.event_type IN ('login', 'page_view', 'action_performed', 'feature_used', 'signup', 'logout')
    AND date_trunc(
      'month',
      CASE
        WHEN e.timezone = 'America/Los_Angeles' THEN e."timestamp" + INTERVAL 8 HOUR
        ELSE e."timestamp"
      END
    ) IN (DATE '2026-02-01', DATE '2026-03-01')
),
monthly_active_users AS (
  SELECT
    activity_month,
    COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS active_users
  FROM event_activity
  GROUP BY 1

WITH valid_subs AS (

        s.sub_id,
        s.customer_id,
        s.plan,
        s.mrr,
        s.started_at,
        s.ended_at,
        s.status
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    JOIN dim_customers c
      ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
    WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
      AND s.mrr > 0
),
ended_in_q1 AS (
    SELECT
        s.customer_id,
        s.sub_id,
        s.ended_at,
        s.mrr AS old_mrr
    FROM valid_subs s
    WHERE s.status = 'cancelled'
      AND s.ended_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
      AND s.ended_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01 00:00:00'
),
next_sub AS (
    SELECT
        e.customer_id,
        e.sub_id,
        e.ended_at,
        e.old_mrr,
        n.sub_id AS next_sub_id,
        n.started_at AS next_started_at,
        n.mrr AS new_mrr,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY e.sub_id
            ORDER BY n.started_at, n.sub_id
        ) AS rn
    FROM ended_in_q1 e
    LEFT JOIN valid_subs n
      ON n.customer_id = e.customer_id
     AND n.status = 'active'
     AND n.started_at >= e.ended_at - INTERVAL '1 day'
     AND n.started_at <= e.ended_at + INTERVAL '1 day'
),
downgrades AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        ended_at,
        GREATEST(old_mrr - COALESCE(new_mrr, 0), 0) AS contraction_mrr
    FROM next_sub
    WHERE rn = 1
      AND next_sub_id IS NOT NULL
      AND COALESCE(new_mrr, 0) < old_mrr
),
existing_customer_contraction AS (
    SELECT d.*
    FROM downgrades d
    JOIN dim_customers c
      ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id
    WHERE c.signup_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
)
SELECT
    SUM(contraction_mrr) AS arr_contraction
FROM existing_customer_contraction;

WITH valid_subs AS (
    SELECT
        s.sub_id,
        s.customer_id,
        s.plan,
        s.mrr,
        s.started_at,
        s.ended_at,
        s.status
    FROM fct_subscriptions s

      ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
    WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE

),
q1_2026_downgrades AS (

        old_sub.customer_id,
        old_sub.sub_id AS old_sub_id,
        new_sub.sub_id AS new_sub_id,
        old_sub.ended_at AS contraction_at,
        old_sub.mrr AS old_mrr,
        new_sub.mrr AS new_mrr,
        old_sub.mrr - new_sub.mrr AS contraction_mrr
    FROM valid_subs old_sub
    JOIN valid_subs new_sub
      ON old_sub.customer_id = new_sub.customer_id
     AND old_sub.status = 'cancelled'
     AND old_sub.ended_at IS NOT NULL
     AND new_sub.status = 'active'
     AND new_sub.started_at BETWEEN old_sub.ended_at - INTERVAL 1 DAY AND old_sub.ended_at + INTERVAL 1 DAY
     AND new_sub.mrr < old_sub.mrr
    WHERE old_sub.ended_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01'
      AND old_sub.ended_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01'
      AND old_sub.started_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01'
)
SELECT
    SUM(contraction_mrr) AS arr_contraction
FROM q1_2026_downgrades;

WITH valid_subs AS (
  SELECT
    s.sub_id,
    s.customer_id,
    s.mrr,
    s.started_at,
    s.ended_at,
    s.status
  FROM fct_subscriptions s
  JOIN dim_customers c
    ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
    AND s.mrr > 0
),
cancelled AS (
  SELECT
    s.customer_id,
    s.sub_id,
    s.mrr AS old_mrr,
    s.ended_at,
    (
      SELECT ns.sub_id
      FROM valid_subs ns
      WHERE ns.customer_id = s.customer_id
        AND ns.status = 'active'
        AND ns.started_at BETWEEN s.ended_at - INTERVAL 1 DAY AND s.ended_at + INTERVAL 1 DAY
      ORDER BY ns.started_at, ns.sub_id
      LIMIT 1
    ) AS next_sub_id,
    (
      SELECT ns.mrr
      FROM valid_subs ns
      WHERE ns.customer_id = s.customer_id
        AND ns.status = 'active'
        AND ns.started_at BETWEEN s.ended_at - INTERVAL 1 DAY AND s.ended_at + INTERVAL 1 DAY
      ORDER BY ns.started_at, ns.sub_id
      LIMIT 1
    ) AS next_mrr
  FROM valid_subs s
  WHERE s.status = 'cancelled'
    AND s.ended_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01'
    AND s.ended_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01'
)
SELECT
  SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN next_sub_id IS NOT NULL AND next_mrr < old_mrr THEN old_mrr - next_mrr
      WHEN next_sub_id IS NULL THEN old_mrr
      ELSE 0
    END
  ) AS arr_contraction_fy2025
FROM cancelled;

WITH fy25_cancelled AS (
    SELECT
        s.sub_id,
        s.customer_id,
        s.mrr,
        s.ended_at
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    JOIN dim_customers c

      AND s.ended_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-02-01 00:00:00'
      AND s.ended_at <  TIMESTAMP '2026-02-01 00:00:00'
),
downgrade_cancels AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.sub_id
    FROM fy25_cancelled c
    JOIN fct_subscriptions n
      ON n.customer_id = c.customer_id
     AND n.status = 'active'
     AND n.started_at >= c.ended_at - INTERVAL '1 day'
     AND n.started_at <= c.ended_at + INTERVAL '1 day'
     AND n.mrr > 0
     AND n.mrr < c.mrr
)
SELECT
    SUM(c.mrr) * 12 AS arr_contraction
FROM fy25_cancelled c
LEFT JOIN downgrade_cancels d
  ON c.sub_id = d.sub_id
WHERE d.sub_id IS NULL;

WITH filtered_subs AS (
    SELECT
        s.sub_id,

    WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE

),
cancelled_q4 AS (
    SELECT
        s.customer_id,
        s.sub_id,
        s.mrr AS old_mrr,
        s.ended_at
    FROM filtered_subs s
    WHERE s.status = 'cancelled'
      AND s.ended_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-10-01 00:00:00'
      AND s.ended_at <  TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
),
downgrades AS (
    SELECT
        c.customer_id,
        c.sub_id,
        c.old_mrr,
        c.ended_at,
        n.sub_id AS next_sub_id,
        n.mrr AS new_mrr,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
            PARTITION BY c.sub_id
            ORDER BY n.started_at, n.sub_id
        ) AS rn
    FROM cancelled_q4 c
    JOIN filtered_subs n
      ON n.customer_id = c.customer_id
     AND n.status = 'active'
     AND n.started_at >= c.ended_at
     AND n.started_at <= c.ended_at + INTERVAL 1 DAY
     AND n.mrr < c.old_mrr
),
existing_customer_contraction AS (
    SELECT
        d.customer_id,
        d.sub_id,
        d.old_mrr - d.new_mrr AS contraction_mrr
    FROM downgrades d
    JOIN dim_customers c
      ON d.customer_id = c.customer_id
    WHERE d.rn = 1
      AND c.signup_date < DATE '2025-10-01'
)
SELECT
    SUM(contraction_mrr) AS arr_contraction
FROM existing_customer_contraction;

WITH base AS (
    SELECT
        s.sub_id,
        s.customer_id,
        s.mrr,
        s.started_at,
        s.ended_at,
        s.status
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    JOIN dim_customers c
      ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
    WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
      AND s.mrr > 0
),
q4_fy2025 AS (
    -- Assuming fiscal year aligns to calendar year; Q4 FY2025 = 2025-10-01 to 2025-12-31
    SELECT
        TIMESTAMP '2025-10-01 00:00:00' AS q_start,
        TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00' AS q_end
),
cancelled_in_q AS (
    SELECT
        b.customer_id,
        b.sub_id,
        b.mrr AS old_mrr,
        b.ended_at
    FROM base b
    CROSS JOIN q4_fy2025 q
    WHERE b.status = 'cancelled'
      AND b.ended_at >= q.q_start
      AND b.ended_at < q.q_end
      AND b.started_at < q.q_start
),
downgrades AS (
    SELECT
        c.customer_id,
        c.sub_id,
        c.old_mrr,
        MIN(n.mrr) AS next_mrr
    FROM cancelled_in_q c
    JOIN base n
      ON n.customer_id = c.customer_id
     AND n.status = 'active'
     AND n.started_at >= c.ended_at
     AND n.started_at <= c.ended_at + INTERVAL 1 DAY
     AND n.mrr < c.old_mrr
    GROUP BY 1,2,3
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(SUM(old_mrr - next_mrr), 0) AS arr_contraction
FROM downgrades;

WITH valid_subs AS (
  SELECT
    s.sub_id,
    s.customer_id,
    s.plan,
    s.mrr,
    s.started_at,
    s.ended_at,
    s.status
  FROM fct_subscriptions s
  JOIN dim_customers c
    ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
    AND s.mrr > 0
),
sub_events AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    sub_id,
    plan,
    mrr,
    started_at,
    ended_at,
    status,
    LEAD(started_at) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY started_at, sub_id) AS next_started_at,
    LEAD(status) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY started_at, sub_id) AS next_status,
    LEAD(mrr) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY started_at, sub_id) AS next_mrr,
    LAG(ended_at) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY started_at, sub_id) AS prev_ended_at,
    LAG(status) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY started_at, sub_id) AS prev_status,
    LAG(mrr) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY started_at, sub_id) AS prev_mrr
  FROM valid_subs
),
contraction_events AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    ended_at AS event_ts,
    (mrr - next_mrr) * 12 AS arr_amount
  FROM sub_events
  WHERE status = 'cancelled'
    AND ended_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01'
    AND ended_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01'
    AND next_status = 'active'
    AND next_started_at IS NOT NULL
    AND ABS(DATEDIFF('day', CAST(ended_at AS DATE), CAST(next_started_at AS DATE))) <= 1
    AND next_mrr > 0
    AND next_mrr < mrr
),
expansion_events AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    started_at AS event_ts,
    (mrr - prev_mrr) * 12 AS arr_amount
  FROM sub_events
  WHERE started_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01'
    AND started_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01'
    AND prev_status = 'cancelled'
    AND prev_ended_at IS NOT NULL
    AND ABS(DATEDIFF('day', CAST(prev_ended_at AS DATE), CAST(started_at AS DATE))) <= 1
    AND prev_mrr > 0
    AND mrr > prev_mrr
),
agg AS (
  SELECT 'ARR Contraction' AS metric, COALESCE(SUM(arr_amount), 0) AS arr_value
  FROM contraction_events
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'ARR Expansion' AS metric, COALESCE(SUM(arr_amount), 0) AS arr_value
  FROM expansion_events
)
SELECT
  metric,
  arr_value,
  CASE
    WHEN metric = 'ARR Contraction' THEN arr_value - (SELECT arr_value FROM agg WHERE metric = 'ARR Expansion')
    ELSE arr_value - (SELECT arr_value FROM agg WHERE metric = 'ARR Contraction')
  END AS difference_vs_other,
  CASE
    WHEN metric = 'ARR Contraction' THEN arr_value / NULLIF((SELECT arr_value FROM agg WHERE metric = 'ARR Expansion'), 0)
    ELSE arr_value / NULLIF((SELECT arr_value FROM agg WHERE metric = 'ARR Contraction'), 0)
  END AS ratio_vs_other
FROM agg
ORDER BY metric;

WITH valid_subs AS (
    SELECT
        s.sub_id,
        s.customer_id,
        s.plan,
        s.mrr,
        s.started_at,
        s.ended_at,
        s.status
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    JOIN dim_customers c
      ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
    WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
      AND s.mrr > 0
),
q1_events AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        sub_id,
        started_at,
        ended_at,
        mrr,
        status
    FROM valid_subs
    WHERE (started_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01' AND started_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01')
       OR (ended_at   >= TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01' AND ended_at   < TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01')
),
contraction_events AS (
    SELECT
        old.customer_id,
        old.sub_id AS old_sub_id,
        new.sub_id AS new_sub_id,
        old.ended_at AS event_ts,
        GREATEST(old.mrr - new.mrr, 0) AS contraction_mrr
    FROM valid_subs old
    JOIN valid_subs new
      ON old.customer_id = new.customer_id
     AND old.status = 'cancelled'
     AND old.ended_at IS NOT NULL
     AND new.started_at >= old.ended_at - INTERVAL 1 DAY
     AND new.started_at <= old.ended_at + INTERVAL 1 DAY
    WHERE old.ended_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01'
      AND old.ended_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01'
      AND new.mrr < old.mrr
),
expansion_events AS (
    SELECT
        old.customer_id,
        old.sub_id AS old_sub_id,
        new.sub_id AS new_sub_id,
        new.started_at AS event_ts,
        GREATEST(new.mrr - old.mrr, 0) AS expansion_mrr
    FROM valid_subs old
    JOIN valid_subs new
      ON old.customer_id = new.customer_id
     AND old.ended_at IS NOT NULL
     AND new.started_at >= old.ended_at - INTERVAL 1 DAY
     AND new.started_at <= old.ended_at + INTERVAL 1 DAY
    WHERE new.started_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01'
      AND new.started_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01'
      AND new.mrr > old.mrr
),
agg AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(SUM(contraction_mrr), 0) * 12 AS arr_contraction_q1_2026,
        (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(expansion_mrr), 0) * 12 FROM expansion_events) AS arr_expansion_q1_2026
    FROM contraction_events
)
SELECT
    arr_contraction_q1_2026,
    arr_expansion_q1_2026,
    arr_contraction_q1_2026 - arr_expansion_q1_2026 AS arr_contraction_minus_expansion,
    CASE
        WHEN arr_expansion_q1_2026 = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE arr_contraction_q1_2026 / arr_expansion_q1_2026
    END AS contraction_to_expansion_ratio
FROM agg;

WITH valid_customers AS (
    SELECT customer_id
    FROM dim_customers
    WHERE COALESCE(is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
),
customer_mrr_snapshots AS (
    SELECT
        vc.customer_id,
        COALESCE((
            SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN fs.mrr > 0 THEN fs.mrr ELSE 0 END)
            FROM fct_subscriptions fs
            WHERE fs.customer_id = vc.customer_id
              AND fs.started_at <= TIMESTAMP '2025-12-31 23:59:59'
              AND (fs.ended_at IS NULL OR fs.ended_at > TIMESTAMP '2025-12-31 23:59:59')
              AND fs.status = 'active'
        ), 0) AS mrr_start_q1_2026,
        COALESCE((
            SELECT SUM(CASE WHEN fs.mrr > 0 THEN fs.mrr ELSE 0 END)
            FROM fct_subscriptions fs
            WHERE fs.customer_id = vc.customer_id
              AND fs.started_at <= TIMESTAMP '2026-03-31 23:59:59'
              AND (fs.ended_at IS NULL OR fs.ended_at > TIMESTAMP '2026-03-31 23:59:59')
              AND fs.status = 'active'
        ), 0) AS mrr_end_q1_2026

)
SELECT
    SUM(
        CASE
            WHEN mrr_start_q1_2026 > 0 AND mrr_end_q1_2026 > mrr_start_q1_2026
                THEN mrr_end_q1_2026 - mrr_start_q1_2026
            ELSE 0
        END
    ) AS arr_expansion
FROM customer_mrr_snapshots;

WITH valid_customers AS (

subs AS (

existing_customers AS (

      AND (ended_at IS NULL OR ended_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01')
),
customer_mrr AS (

             AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01')
            THEN s.mrr ELSE 0 END), 0) AS mrr_start_q1,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE

             AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01')
            THEN s.mrr ELSE 0 END), 0) AS mrr_start_q2
    FROM existing_customers ec
    LEFT JOIN subs s
        ON ec.customer_id = s.customer_id

WITH valid_customers AS (

active_subs AS (

WITH valid_customers AS (

),
active_mrr AS (
  SELECT

    SUM(CASE WHEN s.mrr > 0 THEN s.mrr ELSE 0 END) AS total_mrr
  FROM fct_subscriptions s

    UNION ALL

    AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= d.snapshot_date)
    AND s.status = 'active'
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
q4_start AS (

),
q4_end AS (

      CASE
        WHEN i.processor = 'legacy_braintree' THEN i.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York'
        ELSE i.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'
      END
    ) >= TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-01-01 00:00:00+00:00'
    AND (
      CASE
        WHEN i.processor = 'legacy_braintree' THEN i.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York'

    ) < TIMESTAMPTZ '2026-04-01 00:00:00+00:00'

  FROM (

      period_month,

      ) AS rn
    FROM fct_cogs
    WHERE period_month >= DATE '2026-01-01'

WITH q AS (

    TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00' AS q_start,
    TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01 00:00:00' AS q_end
),
valid_customers AS (
  SELECT customer_id
  FROM dim_customers
  WHERE COALESCE(is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
),
start_subs AS (
  SELECT
    s.sub_id,
    s.customer_id,
    s.mrr
  FROM fct_subscriptions s
  JOIN valid_customers c
    ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
  CROSS JOIN q
  WHERE s.mrr > 0
    AND s.started_at < q.q_start
    AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= q.q_start)
    AND s.status IN ('active', 'cancelled')
),
retained_subs AS (
  SELECT
    ss.sub_id,
    ss.mrr,
    CASE
      WHEN EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM fct_subscriptions s2
        CROSS JOIN q
        WHERE s2.customer_id = ss.customer_id
          AND s2.mrr > 0
          AND s2.started_at < q.q_end
          AND (s2.ended_at IS NULL OR s2.ended_at >= q.q_end)
          AND s2.status = 'active'
      ) THEN 1
      ELSE 0
    END AS retained
  FROM start_subs ss
)
SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN retained = 1 THEN mrr ELSE 0 END) / NULLIF(SUM(mrr), 0) AS gross_revenue_retention
FROM retained_subs;

WITH fy_bounds AS (
    SELECT
        TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00' AS fy_start,
        TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00' AS fy_end
),
valid_subs AS (
    SELECT
        s.sub_id,
        s.customer_id,
        s.plan,
        s.mrr,
        s.started_at,
        s.ended_at,
        s.status
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    JOIN dim_customers c
      ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
    WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
      AND s.mrr > 0
),
starting_mrr AS (
    SELECT SUM(mrr) AS starting_mrr
    FROM valid_subs v
    CROSS JOIN fy_bounds b
    WHERE v.started_at < b.fy_start
      AND (v.ended_at IS NULL OR v.ended_at >= b.fy_start)
),
retained_mrr AS (
    SELECT
        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN EXISTS (
                    SELECT 1
                    FROM valid_subs s2
                    CROSS JOIN fy_bounds b
                    WHERE s2.customer_id = s.customer_id
                      AND s2.started_at < b.fy_end
                      AND (s2.ended_at IS NULL OR s2.ended_at >= b.fy_end)
                ) THEN LEAST(
                    s.mrr,
                    (
                        SELECT COALESCE(SUM(s2.mrr), 0)
                        FROM valid_subs s2
                        CROSS JOIN fy_bounds b
                        WHERE s2.customer_id = s.customer_id
                          AND s2.started_at < b.fy_end
                          AND (s2.ended_at IS NULL OR s2.ended_at >= b.fy_end)
                    )
                )
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS retained_mrr
    FROM valid_subs s
    CROSS JOIN fy_bounds b
    WHERE s.started_at < b.fy_start
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= b.fy_start)
)
SELECT retained_mrr / NULLIF(starting_mrr, 0) AS gross_revenue_retention_fy2025
FROM starting_mrr, retained_mrr;

            )
            ELSE 0
        END AS end_mrr
    FROM fy_starting_mrr b
),

WITH params AS (

        DATE '2025-02-01' AS q_end
),

    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    JOIN eligible_customers c
      ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
    CROSS JOIN params p
    WHERE s.started_at < p.q_start
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= p.q_start)
      AND s.status IN ('active', 'cancelled', 'paused')
    GROUP BY 1
),
true_churned_subs AS (
    SELECT
        s.sub_id,
        s.customer_id,
        s.mrr
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    JOIN eligible_customers c
      ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
    CROSS JOIN params p
    WHERE s.status = 'cancelled'
      AND s.ended_at >= p.q_start
      AND s.ended_at < p.q_end
      AND s.mrr > 0
      AND s.started_at < p.q_start
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM fct_subscriptions s2
          WHERE s2.customer_id = s.customer_id
            AND s2.status = 'active'
            AND s2.started_at >= s.ended_at - INTERVAL 1 DAY
            AND s2.started_at <= s.ended_at + INTERVAL 1 DAY

    SELECT
        customer_id,
        SUM(mrr) AS churned_mrr
    FROM true_churned_subs
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
    ROUND(
        1.0 - COALESCE(SUM(ch.churned_mrr), 0) / NULLIF(SUM(st.starting_mrr), 0),
        4
    ) AS gross_retention
FROM start_mrr st
LEFT JOIN churn_mrr ch
  ON ch.customer_id = st.customer_id;

WITH params AS (
    SELECT
        DATE '2024-11-01' AS q_start,
        DATE '2025-02-01' AS q_end
),
eligible_subs AS (
    SELECT
        s.sub_id,
        s.customer_id,
        s.mrr,
        s.started_at,
        s.ended_at,
        s.status
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    JOIN dim_customers c
      ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
    WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
      AND s.mrr > 0
),
starting_arr AS (
    SELECT
        SUM(mrr) AS starting_mrr
    FROM eligible_subs s
    CROSS JOIN params p
    WHERE s.started_at < p.q_start
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= p.q_start)
      AND s.status IN ('active', 'cancelled')
),
churned_mrr AS (
    SELECT
        SUM(s.mrr) AS lost_mrr
    FROM eligible_subs s
    CROSS JOIN params p
    WHERE s.status = 'cancelled'
      AND s.ended_at >= p.q_start
      AND s.ended_at < p.q_end
      AND s.started_at < p.q_start
      AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM eligible_subs s2
          WHERE s2.customer_id = s.customer_id
            AND s2.status = 'active'
            AND s2.started_at >= s.ended_at - INTERVAL 1 DAY
            AND s2.started_at <= s.ended_at + INTERVAL 1 DAY
            AND s2.mrr < s.mrr
      )
)
SELECT
    (sa.starting_mrr - COALESCE(cm.lost_mrr, 0)) / NULLIF(sa.starting_mrr, 0) AS gross_retention
FROM starting_arr sa
CROSS JOIN churned_mrr cm;

WITH fiscal_q AS (
    SELECT
        DATE '2025-07-01' AS q_start,
        DATE '2025-10-01' AS q_end
),
starting_mrr AS (
    SELECT
        s.customer_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN s.mrr > 0 THEN s.mrr ELSE 0 END) AS starting_mrr
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    JOIN dim_customers c
      ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
    CROSS JOIN fiscal_q q
    WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
      AND s.status IN ('active', 'cancelled')
      AND s.started_at < q.q_start
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= q.q_start)
    GROUP BY 1
),
retained_mrr AS (
    SELECT
        sb.customer_id,
        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN sb.mrr > 0 THEN
                    CASE
                        WHEN sb.ended_at IS NULL OR sb.ended_at >= q.q_end THEN sb.mrr
                        WHEN EXISTS (
                            SELECT 1
                            FROM fct_subscriptions s2
                            WHERE s2.customer_id = sb.customer_id
                              AND s2.status = 'active'
                              AND s2.mrr > 0
                              AND s2.started_at >= sb.ended_at - INTERVAL 1 DAY
                              AND s2.started_at <= sb.ended_at + INTERVAL 1 DAY
                              AND s2.started_at < q.q_end
                        ) THEN LEAST(
                            sb.mrr,
                            COALESCE((
                                SELECT SUM(s2.mrr)
                                FROM fct_subscriptions s2
                                WHERE s2.customer_id = sb.customer_id
                                  AND s2.status = 'active'
                                  AND s2.mrr > 0
                                  AND s2.started_at >= sb.ended_at - INTERVAL 1 DAY
                                  AND s2.started_at <= sb.ended_at + INTERVAL 1 DAY
                                  AND s2.started_at < q.q_end
                            ), 0)
                        )
                        ELSE 0
                    END
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS retained_mrr
    FROM fct_subscriptions sb
    JOIN dim_customers c
      ON c.customer_id = sb.customer_id
    CROSS JOIN fiscal_q q
    WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
      AND sb.status IN ('active', 'cancelled')
      AND sb.started_at < q.q_start
      AND (sb.ended_at IS NULL OR sb.ended_at >= q.q_start)
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
    ROUND(SUM(r.retained_mrr) / NULLIF(SUM(s.starting_mrr), 0), 4) AS gross_retention
FROM starting_mrr s
JOIN retained_mrr r
  ON r.customer_id = s.customer_id;

      AND s.status IN ('active', 'cancelled', 'paused')
    GROUP BY 1
),
ending_mrr AS (
    SELECT
        s.customer_id,
        SUM(s.mrr) AS end_mrr
    FROM subs s
    INNER JOIN cohort_customers cc
        ON s.customer_id = cc.customer_id
    CROSS JOIN params p
    WHERE s.started_at < p.fy_end
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at > p.fy_end)
      AND s.status IN ('active', 'cancelled', 'paused')
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(COALESCE(e.end_mrr, 0)) / NULLIF(SUM(s.start_mrr), 0), 2) AS net_revenue_retention_pct
FROM starting_mrr s
LEFT JOIN ending_mrr e
    ON s.customer_id = e.customer_id;

WITH fy AS (
    SELECT
        TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00' AS fy_start,
        TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00' AS fy_end
),
valid_customers AS (
    SELECT customer_id
    FROM dim_customers
    WHERE COALESCE(is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
),
valid_subs AS (
    SELECT
        s.sub_id,
        s.customer_id,
        s.plan,
        s.mrr,
        s.started_at,
        s.ended_at,
        s.status
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    JOIN valid_customers c
      ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
    WHERE s.mrr > 0
),
starting_mrr AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        SUM(mrr) AS start_mrr
    FROM valid_subs, fy
    WHERE started_at < fy_start
      AND (ended_at IS NULL OR ended_at >= fy_start)
      AND status IN ('active', 'cancelled')
    GROUP BY 1
),
ending_mrr AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        SUM(mrr) AS end_mrr
    FROM valid_subs, fy
    WHERE started_at < fy_end
      AND (ended_at IS NULL OR ended_at >= fy_end)
      AND status IN ('active', 'cancelled')
    GROUP BY 1
),
retention_base AS (
    SELECT
        s.customer_id,
        s.start_mrr,
        COALESCE(e.end_mrr, 0) AS end_mrr
    FROM starting_mrr s
    LEFT JOIN ending_mrr e
      ON s.customer_id = e.customer_id
)
SELECT
    SUM(LEAST(end_mrr, start_mrr)) / NULLIF(SUM(start_mrr), 0) AS gross_retention,
    SUM(end_mrr) / NULLIF(SUM(start_mrr), 0) AS net_retention
FROM retention_base;

WITH fy_bounds AS (
    SELECT
        TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01 00:00:00' AS fy_start,
        TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00' AS fy_end
),
valid_customers AS (
    SELECT customer_id
    FROM dim_customers
    WHERE COALESCE(is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
),
subs AS (
    SELECT
        s.sub_id,
        s.customer_id,
        s.mrr,
        s.started_at,
        s.ended_at,
        s.status
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    INNER JOIN valid_customers c
        ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
    WHERE s.customer_id IS NOT NULL
      AND s.mrr > 0
),
cohort AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        SUM(mrr) AS starting_mrr
    FROM subs, fy_bounds
    WHERE started_at < fy_start
      AND (ended_at IS NULL OR ended_at > fy_start)
      AND status IN ('active', 'cancelled')
    GROUP BY customer_id
    HAVING SUM(mrr) > 0
),
ending_mrr AS (
    SELECT
        s.customer_id,
        SUM(s.mrr) AS ending_mrr
    FROM subs s, fy_bounds
    INNER JOIN cohort c
        ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
    WHERE s.started_at < fy_end
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at > fy_end)
      AND s.status IN ('active', 'cancelled')
    GROUP BY s.customer_id
),
contractions AS (
    SELECT
        c.customer_id,
        c.starting_mrr,
        COALESCE(e.ending_mrr, 0) AS ending_mrr,
        GREATEST(c.starting_mrr - COALESCE(e.ending_mrr, 0), 0) AS lost_mrr
    FROM cohort c
    LEFT JOIN ending_mrr e
        ON c.customer_id = e.customer_id
)
SELECT
    2025 AS fiscal_year,
    SUM(starting_mrr) AS beginning_mrr,
    SUM(ending_mrr) AS ending_mrr_from_starting_cohort,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ending_mrr > starting_mrr THEN ending_mrr - starting_mrr ELSE 0 END) AS expansion_mrr,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ending_mrr < starting_mrr THEN starting_mrr - ending_mrr ELSE 0 END) AS contraction_and_churn_mrr,
    ROUND(SUM(ending_mrr) / NULLIF(SUM(starting_mrr), 0), 4) AS net_retention,
    ROUND((SUM(starting_mrr) - SUM(lost_mrr)) / NULLIF(SUM(starting_mrr), 0), 4) AS gross_retention
FROM contractions;

WITH params AS (
  SELECT
    TIMESTAMP '2025-10-01 00:00:00' AS q_start,
    TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00' AS q_end
),
valid_customers AS (
  SELECT customer_id
  FROM dim_customers
  WHERE COALESCE(is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
),
base_mrr AS (
  SELECT
    s.customer_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN s.mrr > 0 THEN s.mrr ELSE 0 END) AS starting_mrr
  FROM fct_subscriptions s
  JOIN valid_customers c
    ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
  CROSS JOIN params p
  WHERE s.started_at < p.q_start
    AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at > p.q_start)
    AND s.status IN ('active', 'cancelled')
  GROUP BY 1
  HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN s.mrr > 0 THEN s.mrr ELSE 0 END) > 0
),
end_mrr AS (
  SELECT
    s.customer_id,
    SUM(CASE WHEN s.mrr > 0 THEN s.mrr ELSE 0 END) AS ending_mrr
  FROM fct_subscriptions s
  JOIN base_mrr b
    ON b.customer_id = s.customer_id
  CROSS JOIN params p
  WHERE s.started_at < p.q_end
    AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at > p.q_end)
    AND s.status IN ('active', 'cancelled')
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  ROUND(100.0 * SUM(COALESCE(e.ending_mrr, 0)) / SUM(b.starting_mrr), 2) AS net_revenue_retention_pct
FROM base_mrr b
LEFT JOIN end_mrr e
  ON e.customer_id = b.customer_id;

WITH params AS (
    -- Assume fiscal year aligns to calendar year; Q4 FY2025 = 2025-10-01 through 2025-12-31
    SELECT
        TIMESTAMP '2025-10-01 00:00:00' AS q_start,
        TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00' AS q_end
),
valid_customers AS (
    SELECT customer_id
    FROM dim_customers
    WHERE COALESCE(is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
),
valid_subs AS (
    SELECT
        s.sub_id,
        s.customer_id,
        s.plan,
        s.mrr,
        s.started_at,
        s.ended_at,
        s.status
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    JOIN valid_customers c
      ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
    WHERE s.mrr > 0
),
cohort_mrr AS (
    -- Starting MRR at beginning of Q4 FY2025: subscriptions active at q_start
    SELECT
        s.customer_id,
        SUM(s.mrr) AS start_mrr
    FROM valid_subs s
    CROSS JOIN params p
    WHERE s.started_at < p.q_start
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at > p.q_start)
      AND s.status IN ('active', 'cancelled')
    GROUP BY s.customer_id
),
ending_mrr AS (
    -- Ending MRR for the same starting cohort at end of Q4 FY2025
    SELECT
        s.customer_id,
        SUM(s.mrr) AS end_mrr
    FROM valid_subs s
    JOIN cohort_mrr c
      ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
    CROSS JOIN params p
    WHERE s.started_at < p.q_end
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at > p.q_end)
      AND s.status = 'active'
    GROUP BY s.customer_id
)
SELECT
    ROUND(
        100.0 * SUM(COALESCE(e.end_mrr, 0)) / NULLIF(SUM(c.start_mrr), 0),
        2
    ) AS net_revenue_retention_pct
FROM cohort_mrr c
LEFT JOIN ending_mrr e
  ON c.customer_id = e.customer_id;

WITH valid_customers AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        signup_date
    FROM dim_customers
    WHERE COALESCE(is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
      AND signup_date IS NOT NULL
      AND signup_date <= DATE '2026-03-31'
),
customer_cac AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        1.0 AS cac_usd
    FROM valid_customers
),
paid_invoices AS (
    SELECT
        i.customer_id,
        CASE
            WHEN i.processor = 'legacy_braintree' THEN i.paid_at + INTERVAL '4 hours'
            ELSE i.paid_at
        END AS paid_at_utc,
        i.amount
    FROM fct_invoices i
    INNER JOIN valid_customers c
        ON i.customer_id = c.customer_id
    WHERE i.status = 'paid'
      AND i.paid_at IS NOT NULL
      AND i.amount > 0
      AND CAST(
            CASE
                WHEN i.processor = 'legacy_braintree' THEN i.paid_at + INTERVAL '4 hours'
                ELSE i.paid_at
            END AS DATE
          ) <= DATE '2026-03-31'
),
invoice_cumulative AS (
    SELECT
        p.customer_id,
        p.paid_at_utc,
        SUM(p.amount) OVER (
            PARTITION BY p.customer_id
            ORDER BY p.paid_at_utc, p.customer_id
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS cumulative_revenue
    FROM paid_invoices p
),
customer_payback AS (
    SELECT
        c.customer_id,
        MIN(ic.paid_at_utc) AS payback_at
    FROM customer_cac c
    LEFT JOIN invoice_cumulative ic
        ON c.customer_id = ic.customer_id
       AND ic.cumulative_revenue >= c.cac_usd
    GROUP BY 1
),
as_of_customers AS (
    SELECT
        vc.customer_id,
        vc.signup_date,
        cp.payback_at
    FROM valid_customers vc
    LEFT JOIN customer_payback cp
        ON vc.customer_id = cp.customer_id
)
SELECT
    AVG(
        CASE
            WHEN payback_at IS NOT NULL THEN date_diff('day', signup_date, CAST(payback_at AS DATE)) / 30.4375
            ELSE date_diff('day', signup_date, DATE '2026-03-31') / 30.4375
        END
    ) AS cac_payback_period_months_as_of_2026_03_31
FROM as_of_customers;

WITH valid_customers AS (
    SELECT customer_id, signup_date
    FROM dim_customers
    WHERE COALESCE(is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
      AND signup_date IS NOT NULL
),
paid_invoices AS (
    SELECT
        i.customer_id,
        CASE
            WHEN i.processor = 'legacy_braintree' THEN i.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York'
            ELSE i.paid_at
        END AS paid_at_utc,
        i.amount
    FROM fct_invoices i
    INNER JOIN valid_customers c
        ON i.customer_id = c.customer_id
    WHERE i.status = 'paid'
      AND i.paid_at IS NOT NULL
      AND i.amount > 0
),
invoice_cohorts AS (
    SELECT
        c.customer_id,
        c.signup_date,
        DATE_TRUNC('month', c.signup_date) AS cohort_month,
        DATE_DIFF('month', DATE_TRUNC('month', c.signup_date), DATE_TRUNC('month', CAST(p.paid_at_utc AS DATE))) AS month_num,
        p.amount
    FROM valid_customers c
    LEFT JOIN paid_invoices p
        ON c.customer_id = p.customer_id
       AND CAST(p.paid_at_utc AS DATE) <= DATE '2026-03-31'
       AND CAST(p.paid_at_utc AS DATE) >= c.signup_date
),
cohort_monthly_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        cohort_month,
        month_num,
        SUM(amount) AS revenue
    FROM invoice_cohorts
    WHERE month_num IS NOT NULL
      AND month_num >= 0
    GROUP BY 1, 2
),
cohort_sizes AS (
    SELECT
        DATE_TRUNC('month', signup_date) AS cohort_month,
        COUNT(*) AS customers
    FROM valid_customers
    WHERE signup_date <= DATE '2026-03-31'
    GROUP BY 1
),
running_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        r.cohort_month,
        r.month_num,
        SUM(r.revenue) OVER (
            PARTITION BY r.cohort_month
            ORDER BY r.month_num
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS cumulative_revenue,
        s.customers
    FROM cohort_monthly_revenue r
    INNER JOIN cohort_sizes s
        ON r.cohort_month = s.cohort_month
),
cohort_payback AS (
    SELECT
        cohort_month,
        MIN(month_num) FILTER (WHERE cumulative_revenue >= customers * 1000.0) AS payback_months
    FROM running_revenue
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
    AVG(payback_months) AS cac_payback_period_months
FROM cohort_payback
WHERE cohort_month <= DATE '2026-03-31'
  AND payback_months IS NOT NULL;

WITH valid_customers AS (
    SELECT customer_id
    FROM dim_customers
    WHERE COALESCE(is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
),
valid_subscriptions AS (
    SELECT
        s.customer_id,
        s.started_at,
        s.mrr
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    INNER JOIN valid_customers c
        ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
    WHERE s.started_at <= TIMESTAMP '2025-12-31 23:59:59'
      AND s.mrr > 0
      AND s.status IN ('active', 'cancelled', 'paused')
),
new_customer_acquisition_cost AS (
    SELECT AVG(first_mrr) AS avg_cac
    FROM (
        SELECT
            customer_id,
            MIN(started_at) AS first_started_at,
            FIRST(mrr ORDER BY started_at) AS first_mrr
        FROM valid_subscriptions
        GROUP BY customer_id
    ) t
),
active_mrr_as_of_date AS (
    SELECT SUM(mrr) AS total_active_mrr
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    INNER JOIN valid_customers c
        ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
    WHERE s.started_at <= TIMESTAMP '2025-12-31 23:59:59'
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at > TIMESTAMP '2025-12-31 23:59:59')
      AND s.mrr > 0
      AND s.status IN ('active', 'cancelled', 'paused')
),
paid_revenue_dec_2025 AS (
    SELECT SUM(i.amount) AS paid_revenue_dec
    FROM fct_invoices i
    INNER JOIN valid_customers c
        ON i.customer_id = c.customer_id
    WHERE i.status = 'paid'
      AND i.amount > 0
      AND (
        CASE
            WHEN i.processor = 'legacy_braintree' THEN i.paid_at + INTERVAL '5 hours'
            ELSE i.paid_at
        END
      ) >= TIMESTAMP '2025-12-01 00:00:00'
      AND (
        CASE
            WHEN i.processor = 'legacy_braintree' THEN i.paid_at + INTERVAL '5 hours'
            ELSE i.paid_at
        END
      ) < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
),
gross_revenue_churn_dec_2025 AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(dec_start_mrr), 0) AS churned_mrr
    FROM (
        SELECT
            s.customer_id,
            SUM(s.mrr) AS dec_start_mrr
        FROM fct_subscriptions s
        INNER JOIN valid_customers c
            ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
        WHERE s.started_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-12-01 00:00:00'
          AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-12-01 00:00:00')
          AND s.mrr > 0
          AND s.status IN ('active', 'cancelled', 'paused')
        GROUP BY s.customer_id
    ) start_base
    WHERE EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM fct_subscriptions s_end
        WHERE s_end.customer_id = start_base.customer_id
          AND s_end.status = 'cancelled'
          AND s_end.ended_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-12-01 00:00:00'
          AND s_end.ended_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
          AND NOT EXISTS (
              SELECT 1
              FROM fct_subscriptions s_next
              WHERE s_next.customer_id = s_end.customer_id
                AND s_next.status = 'active'
                AND s_next.started_at >= s_end.ended_at - INTERVAL '1 day'
                AND s_next.started_at <= s_end.ended_at + INTERVAL '1 day'
                AND s_next.mrr >= 0
          )
    )
),
net_new_mrr_dec_2025 AS (
    SELECT
        a.total_active_mrr
        - COALESCE(g.churned_mrr, 0) AS implied_net_mrr_after_churn
    FROM active_mrr_as_of_date a
    CROSS JOIN gross_revenue_churn_dec_2025 g
)
SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN (p.paid_revenue_dec - n.implied_net_mrr_after_churn) > 0
        THEN cac.avg_cac / (p.paid_revenue_dec - n.implied_net_mrr_after_churn)
        ELSE NULL
    END AS payback_period_months
FROM new_customer_acquisition_cost cac
CROSS JOIN paid_revenue_dec_2025 p
CROSS JOIN net_new_mrr_dec_2025 n;

WITH valid_customers AS (
    SELECT customer_id, signup_date
    FROM dim_customers
    WHERE COALESCE(is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
),
valid_invoices AS (
    SELECT
        i.customer_id,
        CASE
            WHEN i.processor = 'legacy_braintree' THEN i.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York'
            ELSE i.paid_at
        END AS paid_at_utc,
        i.amount
    FROM fct_invoices i
    INNER JOIN valid_customers c
        ON i.customer_id = c.customer_id
    WHERE i.status = 'paid'
      AND i.paid_at IS NOT NULL
      AND i.paid_at <= TIMESTAMP '2025-12-31 23:59:59'
),
customer_cash_in AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        SUM(amount) AS total_paid_through_2025_12_31
    FROM valid_invoices
    GROUP BY 1
),
subscription_cost_basis AS (
    SELECT
        s.customer_id,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN s.mrr > 0 THEN s.mrr ELSE 0 END), 0) AS acquisition_cost
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    INNER JOIN valid_customers c
        ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
    WHERE s.started_at <= TIMESTAMP '2025-12-31 23:59:59'
    GROUP BY 1
),
customer_payback AS (
    SELECT
        c.customer_id,
        c.signup_date,
        COALESCE(sc.acquisition_cost, 0) AS acquisition_cost,
        COALESCE(ci.total_paid_through_2025_12_31, 0) AS total_paid_through_2025_12_31,
        CASE
            WHEN COALESCE(sc.acquisition_cost, 0) > 0
                 AND COALESCE(ci.total_paid_through_2025_12_31, 0) >= COALESCE(sc.acquisition_cost, 0)
            THEN date_diff('day', c.signup_date, DATE '2025-12-31')
            ELSE NULL
        END AS payback_period_days
    FROM valid_customers c
    LEFT JOIN subscription_cost_basis sc
        ON c.customer_id = sc.customer_id
    LEFT JOIN customer_cash_in ci
        ON c.customer_id = ci.customer_id
)
SELECT AVG(payback_period_days) AS payback_period_days_as_of_2025_12_31
FROM customer_payback;

WITH fy_2025_end AS (
    SELECT TIMESTAMP '2025-12-31 23:59:59' AS as_of_ts
),
valid_customers AS (
    SELECT customer_id, signup_date
    FROM dim_customers
    WHERE COALESCE(is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
),
invoice_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        i.customer_id,
        SUM(
            CASE
                WHEN i.status = 'paid' THEN i.amount
                WHEN i.status = 'refunded' THEN -ABS(i.amount)
                ELSE 0
            END
        ) AS recognized_revenue
    FROM fct_invoices i
    INNER JOIN valid_customers c
        ON i.customer_id = c.customer_id
    CROSS JOIN fy_2025_end f
    WHERE i.status IN ('paid', 'refunded')
      AND (
            CASE
                WHEN i.processor = 'legacy_braintree' THEN i.paid_at + INTERVAL '5 hours'
                ELSE i.paid_at
            END
          ) <= f.as_of_ts
    GROUP BY 1
),
active_mrr_as_of_fy_end AS (
    SELECT
        s.customer_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN s.mrr > 0 THEN s.mrr ELSE 0 END) AS mrr_as_of_fy_end
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    INNER JOIN valid_customers c
        ON s.customer_id = c.customer_id
    CROSS JOIN fy_2025_end f
    WHERE s.started_at <= f.as_of_ts
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at > f.as_of_ts)
      AND s.status IN ('active', 'cancelled')
    GROUP BY 1
),
cohort_metrics AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS customers,
        COALESCE(SUM(ir.recognized_revenue), 0) AS total_revenue,
        COALESCE(SUM(am.mrr_as_of_fy_end), 0) AS total_mrr
    FROM valid_customers c
    LEFT JOIN invoice_revenue ir
        ON c.customer_id = ir.customer_id
    LEFT JOIN active_mrr_as_of_fy_end am
        ON c.customer_id = am.customer_id
    WHERE c.signup_date <= DATE '2025-12-31'
)
SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN total_mrr = 0 OR customers = 0 THEN NULL
        ELSE (total_revenue / customers) / (total_mrr / customers)
    END AS cac_payback_period_months
FROM cohort_metrics;

WITH fy2025_end AS (
    SELECT TIMESTAMP '2025-12-31 23:59:59' AS as_of_ts
),
valid_customers AS (
    SELECT customer_id, signup_date
    FROM dim_customers
    WHERE COALESCE(is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
),
customer_cac AS (
    SELECT
        vc.customer_id,
        vc.signup_date,
        COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN fs.mrr > 0 THEN fs.mrr ELSE 0 END), 0) AS cac
    FROM valid_customers vc
    LEFT JOIN fct_subscriptions fs
        ON fs.customer_id = vc.customer_id
       AND fs.started_at < (SELECT as_of_ts FROM fy2025_end)
    GROUP BY 1, 2
),
invoice_cash AS (
    SELECT
        fi.customer_id,
        CASE
            WHEN fi.processor = 'legacy_braintree'
                THEN fi.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York' AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'
            ELSE fi.paid_at
        END AS paid_at_utc,
        CASE
            WHEN fi.status = 'paid' THEN fi.amount
            WHEN fi.status = 'refunded' THEN -ABS(fi.amount)
            ELSE 0
        END AS net_amount
    FROM fct_invoices fi
    INNER JOIN valid_customers vc
        ON fi.customer_id = vc.customer_id
    WHERE fi.status IN ('paid', 'refunded')
      AND fi.paid_at IS NOT NULL
),
daily_cash AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        CAST(paid_at_utc AS DATE) AS paid_date,
        SUM(net_amount) AS daily_net_revenue
    FROM invoice_cash
    WHERE paid_at_utc <= (SELECT as_of_ts FROM fy2025_end)
    GROUP BY 1, 2
),
cumulative_cash AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        paid_date,
        SUM(daily_net_revenue) OVER (
            PARTITION BY customer_id
            ORDER BY paid_date
            ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
        ) AS cumulative_revenue
    FROM daily_cash
),
customer_payback AS (
    SELECT
        cc.customer_id,
        cc.signup_date,
        cc.cac,
        MIN(cu.paid_date) AS payback_date
    FROM customer_cac cc
    LEFT JOIN cumulative_cash cu
        ON cu.customer_id = cc.customer_id
       AND cc.cac > 0
       AND cu.cumulative_revenue >= cc.cac
    GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
),
cohort_payback AS (
    SELECT
        cp.customer_id,
        DATE_DIFF('month', cp.signup_date, cp.payback_date) AS payback_months
    FROM customer_payback cp
    WHERE cp.cac > 0
      AND cp.payback_date IS NOT NULL
      AND cp.payback_date <= DATE '2025-12-31'
)
SELECT AVG(payback_months) AS cac_payback_period_months_as_of_fy2025_end
FROM cohort_payback;

WITH opp_events AS (
  SELECT
    event_id,
    customer_id,
    user_id,
    CASE
      WHEN timezone = 'America/Los_Angeles' THEN timezone('UTC', timezone('America/Los_Angeles', "timestamp"))
      ELSE "timestamp"
    END AS event_ts_utc,
    event_type,
    COALESCE(
      json_extract_string(properties_jsonb, '$.opp_id'),
      json_extract_string(properties_jsonb, '$.oppId')
    ) AS opp_id,
    TRY_CAST(
      COALESCE(
        json_extract_string(properties_jsonb, '$.deal_value'),
        json_extract_string(properties_jsonb, '$.dealValue')
      ) AS DOUBLE
    ) AS deal_value
  FROM fct_events
  WHERE event_type IN ('opp_created', 'opp_won', 'opp_lost', 'opp_no_decision', 'opp_stage_advanced')
),
fiscal_bounds AS (
  SELECT
    TIMESTAMP '2025-11-01 00:00:00' AS q2_start_utc,
    TIMESTAMP '2026-02-01 00:00:00' AS q3_start_utc
),
open_opps_as_of_q2_start AS (
  SELECT
    oe.opp_id,
    ANY_VALUE(oe.customer_id) AS customer_id,
    MAX(CASE WHEN oe.event_type = 'opp_created' AND oe.event_ts_utc < fb.q2_start_utc THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS was_created_before_q2,
    MAX(CASE WHEN oe.event_type IN ('opp_won', 'opp_lost', 'opp_no_decision') AND oe.event_ts_utc < fb.q2_start_utc THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS was_closed_before_q2,
    MAX(CASE WHEN oe.event_ts_utc < fb.q2_start_utc THEN COALESCE(oe.deal_value, 0) ELSE 0 END) AS pipeline_value
  FROM opp_events oe
  CROSS JOIN fiscal_bounds fb
  WHERE oe.opp_id IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY oe.opp_id
),
qualified_leads_before_q2 AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS qualified_leads
  FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(customer_id, user_id) AS entity_id
    FROM fct_events
    CROSS JOIN fiscal_bounds fb
    WHERE event_type = 'lead_qualified'
      AND COALESCE(customer_id, user_id) IS NOT NULL
      AND (
        CASE
          WHEN timezone = 'America/Los_Angeles' THEN timezone('UTC', timezone('America/Los_Angeles', "timestamp"))
          ELSE "timestamp"
        END
      ) < fb.q2_start_utc
  ) q
)
SELECT
  CAST(COUNT(*) AS DOUBLE) / NULLIF((SELECT qualified_leads FROM qualified_leads_before_q2), 0) AS pipeline_coverage
FROM open_opps_as_of_q2_start
WHERE was_created_before_q2 = 1
  AND was_closed_before_q2 = 0;

WITH opp_events AS (
  SELECT
    event_id,
    customer_id,
    CASE
      WHEN timezone = 'America/Los_Angeles' THEN "timestamp" + INTERVAL 7 HOUR
      ELSE "timestamp"
    END AS event_ts_utc,
    COALESCE(
      json_extract_string(properties_jsonb, '$.opp_id'),

    ) AS opp_id,

      COALESCE(
        json_extract_string(properties_jsonb, '$.deal_value'),

      ) AS DOUBLE
    ) AS deal_value
  FROM fct_events
  WHERE event_type IN ('opp_created', 'opp_won', 'opp_lost', 'opp_no_decision', 'opp_stage_advanced')
),
opp_state_as_of_q2_start AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    opp_id,
    arg_max(event_id, event_ts_utc) AS last_event_id,
    arg_max(deal_value, event_ts_utc) AS latest_deal_value,
    max(event_ts_utc) AS last_event_ts
  FROM opp_events
  WHERE opp_id IS NOT NULL
    AND event_ts_utc < TIMESTAMP '2025-05-01 00:00:00'
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
open_pipeline AS (
  SELECT
    s.customer_id,
    s.opp_id,
    COALESCE(s.latest_deal_value, 0) AS deal_value
  FROM opp_state_as_of_q2_start s
  JOIN fct_events e
    ON e.event_id = s.last_event_id
  WHERE e.event_type NOT IN ('opp_won', 'opp_lost', 'opp_no_decision')
),
qualified_leads AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT
    customer_id
  FROM fct_events
  WHERE event_type = 'lead_qualified'
    AND (
      CASE
        WHEN timezone = 'America/Los_Angeles' THEN "timestamp" + INTERVAL 7 HOUR
        ELSE "timestamp"
      END
    ) < TIMESTAMP '2025-05-01 00:00:00'
    AND customer_id IS NOT NULL
),
pipeline_by_customer AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    SUM(deal_value) AS open_pipeline_value
  FROM open_pipeline
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN q.customer_id IS NOT NULL THEN COALESCE(p.open_pipeline_value, 0) ELSE 0 END) * 1.0
  / NULLIF(SUM(COALESCE(p.open_pipeline_value, 0)), 0) AS pipeline_coverage
FROM pipeline_by_customer p
LEFT JOIN qualified_leads q
  ON p.customer_id = q.customer_id;

WITH opp_events AS (
  SELECT
    event_id,

    event_type,
    CASE
      WHEN timezone = 'America/Los_Angeles' THEN "timestamp" AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles'
      ELSE "timestamp" AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'
    END AS event_ts_utc,

    ) AS opp_id,

      ) AS DOUBLE
    ) AS deal_value

),
fy_bounds AS (

    TIMESTAMPTZ '2025-02-01 00:00:00+00' AS fy2025_start_utc,

),
open_opps_as_of_q1_fy2026 AS (

    MAX_BY(oe.deal_value, oe.event_ts_utc) AS open_pipeline_value
  FROM opp_events oe
  CROSS JOIN fy_bounds b
  WHERE oe.event_ts_utc < b.fy2026_start_utc
    AND oe.event_type = 'opp_created'
    AND oe.opp_id IS NOT NULL
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM opp_events x
      WHERE x.opp_id = oe.opp_id
        AND x.event_ts_utc >= oe.event_ts_utc
        AND x.event_ts_utc < b.fy2026_start_utc
        AND x.event_type IN ('opp_won', 'opp_lost', 'opp_no_decision')
    )
  GROUP BY 1, 2
),
won_in_fy2026_q1 AS (

    oe.customer_id,

  WHERE oe.event_type = 'opp_won'
    AND oe.event_ts_utc >= b.fy2026_start_utc
    AND oe.event_ts_utc < b.fy2026_start_utc + INTERVAL '3 months'
  GROUP BY 1
),
pipeline_by_customer AS (
  SELECT
    customer_id,
    SUM(COALESCE(open_pipeline_value, 0)) AS pipeline_value
  FROM open_opps_as_of_q1_fy2026
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  SUM(p.pipeline_value) / NULLIF(SUM(w.won_value_q1), 0) AS pipeline_coverage
FROM pipeline_by_customer p
JOIN won_in_fy2026_q1 w
  ON p.customer_id = w.customer_id;

WITH opp_events AS (

fy_bounds AS (

),
opp_state_as_of_q1 AS (

open_pipeline AS (

),
won_in_q1 AS (

    AND oe.event_ts_tz >= b.q1_start_utc
    AND oe.event_ts_tz < b.q2_start_utc
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  SUM(op.open_pipeline_value) / NULLIF(SUM(wq.q1_won_value), 0) AS pipeline_coverage
FROM open_pipeline op
JOIN won_in_q1 wq
  ON op.customer_id = wq.customer_id;

WITH fy_bounds AS (

opp_events AS (

  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT

  MAX(CASE WHEN revenue_month = DATE '2026-03-01' THEN revenue END)

  (
    MAX(CASE WHEN revenue_month = DATE '2026-03-01' THEN revenue END)
    - MAX(CASE WHEN revenue_month = DATE '2026-02-01' THEN revenue END)

  FROM fct_subscriptions

SELECT

WITH monthly_revenue AS (
  SELECT
    date_trunc('month', paid_at) AS revenue_month,
    SUM(amount) AS revenue
  FROM fct_invoices
  WHERE status = 'paid'
    AND paid_at >= DATE '2026-02-01'
    AND paid_at < DATE '2026-04-01'
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN revenue_month = DATE '2026-02-01' THEN revenue END), 0) AS february_2026_revenue,
  COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN revenue_month = DATE '2026-03-01' THEN revenue END), 0) AS march_2026_revenue,
  COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN revenue_month = DATE '2026-03-01' THEN revenue END), 0)
    - COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN revenue_month = DATE '2026-02-01' THEN revenue END), 0) AS mom_change,
  CASE
    WHEN COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN revenue_month = DATE '2026-02-01' THEN revenue END), 0) = 0 THEN NULL
    ELSE (
      COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN revenue_month = DATE '2026-03-01' THEN revenue END), 0)
      - COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN revenue_month = DATE '2026-02-01' THEN revenue END), 0)
    ) * 1.0 / COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN revenue_month = DATE '2026-02-01' THEN revenue END), 0)
  END AS mom_change_pct
FROM monthly_revenue;

WITH monthly_revenue AS (
  SELECT

  FROM fct_invoices

    AND paid_at < DATE '2026-04-01'

)
SELECT

  COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN month = DATE '2026-03-01' THEN revenue END), 0)
    - COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN month = DATE '2026-02-01' THEN revenue END), 0) AS revenue_change,
  CASE

WITH revenue AS (
  SELECT i.paid_at, i.amount
  FROM fct_invoices i
  JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = i.customer_id
  WHERE i.paid_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01 00:00:00'
    AND i.paid_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01 00:00:00'
    AND i.status = 'paid'
    AND c.is_test = false
),
period_cogs AS (
  SELECT
    period_month,
    COALESCE(
      MAX(CASE WHEN source = 'cost_of_goods_sold' THEN amount END),
      MAX(CASE WHEN source = 'cost_of_revenue' THEN amount END)
    ) AS dedupped_cogs
  FROM fct_cogs
  WHERE period_month >= DATE '2026-01-01'
    AND period_month < DATE '2026-04-01'
  GROUP BY period_month
),
totals AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(amount) AS revenue_total,
    (SELECT SUM(dedupped_cogs) FROM period_cogs) AS cogs_total
  FROM revenue
)
SELECT
  ((revenue_total - COALESCE(cogs_total, revenue_total * 0.25))
   / NULLIF(revenue_total, 0)) * 100 AS gross_margin_pct
FROM totals;

WITH monthly_revenue AS (
  SELECT
    date_trunc(
      'month',
      CASE
        WHEN i.processor = 'legacy_braintree'
          THEN i.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York' AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles'
        ELSE i.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles'
      END
    ) AS revenue_month,
    SUM(i.amount) AS revenue
  FROM fct_invoices i
  JOIN dim_customers c
    ON c.customer_id = i.customer_id
  WHERE
    (
      CASE
        WHEN i.processor = 'legacy_braintree'
          THEN i.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York' AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles'
        ELSE i.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles'
      END
    ) >= TIMESTAMP '2026-02-01 00:00:00'
    AND (
      CASE
        WHEN i.processor = 'legacy_braintree'
          THEN i.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York' AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles'
        ELSE i.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles'
      END
    ) < TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01 00:00:00'
    AND i.status = 'paid'
    AND c.is_test = false
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  MAX(CASE WHEN revenue_month = DATE '2026-02-01' THEN revenue END) AS revenue_feb_2026,
  MAX(CASE WHEN revenue_month = DATE '2026-03-01' THEN revenue END) AS revenue_mar_2026,
  MAX(CASE WHEN revenue_month = DATE '2026-03-01' THEN revenue END)
    - MAX(CASE WHEN revenue_month = DATE '2026-02-01' THEN revenue END) AS mom_change,
  (
    MAX(CASE WHEN revenue_month = DATE '2026-03-01' THEN revenue END)
    - MAX(CASE WHEN revenue_month = DATE '2026-02-01' THEN revenue END)
  ) / NULLIF(MAX(CASE WHEN revenue_month = DATE '2026-02-01' THEN revenue END), 0) AS mom_change_pct
FROM monthly_revenue;

WITH monthly_revenue AS (
  SELECT
    date_trunc(
      'month',
      CASE
        WHEN i.processor = 'legacy_braintree'

        ELSE i.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles'
      END
    ) AS month_start,
    SUM(i.amount) AS revenue
  FROM fct_invoices i
  JOIN dim_customers c
    ON c.customer_id = i.customer_id
  WHERE
    CASE
      WHEN i.processor = 'legacy_braintree'
        THEN i.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York' AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles'
      ELSE i.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles'

    AND CASE

        THEN i.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York' AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles'
      ELSE i.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC' AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles'
    END < TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01 00:00:00'
    AND i.status = 'paid'
    AND c.is_test = false
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN month_start = DATE '2026-02-01' THEN revenue END), 0) AS february_2026_revenue,

  COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN month_start = DATE '2026-03-01' THEN revenue END), 0)
    - COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN month_start = DATE '2026-02-01' THEN revenue END), 0) AS mom_change,
  CASE
    WHEN COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN month_start = DATE '2026-02-01' THEN revenue END), 0) = 0 THEN NULL

    -- Active subscriptions at start of FY2025 (Jan 1, 2025), excluding test accounts and refund rows
    SELECT
        s.customer_id,

        s.mrr AS starting_mrr
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = s.customer_id
    WHERE COALESCE(c.is_test, FALSE) = FALSE
      AND s.mrr > 0
      AND s.started_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01'
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01')
),
cancellations AS (
    -- Subscriptions from the start cohort that were cancelled during FY2025
    SELECT
        sc.customer_id,
        sc.sub_id,
        sc.starting_mrr,
        s.ended_at
    FROM start_cohort sc
    JOIN fct_subscriptions s ON s.sub_id = sc.sub_id
    WHERE s.status = 'cancelled'
      AND s.ended_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01'
      AND s.ended_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-01-01'
),
downgrade_links AS (
    -- A cancellation is a downgrade (not churn) if the same customer has a NEW
    -- 'active' sub starting within 1 day of the cancelled sub's ended_at, at LOWER MRR.
    SELECT
        ca.sub_id AS cancelled_sub_id,
        ca.customer_id,
        ca.starting_mrr AS old_mrr,
        MAX(ns.mrr) AS new_mrr
    FROM cancellations ca
    JOIN fct_subscriptions ns
      ON ns.customer_id = ca.customer_id
     AND ns.status = 'active'
     AND ns.mrr > 0
     AND ns.started_at >= ca.ended_at
     AND ns.started_at <= ca.ended_at + INTERVAL 1 DAY
     AND ns.mrr < ca.starting_mrr
    GROUP BY ca.sub_id, ca.customer_id, ca.starting_mrr
),
revenue_loss AS (
    SELECT
        ca.sub_id,
        ca.starting_mrr,
        CASE
            WHEN dl.cancelled_sub_id IS NOT NULL
                THEN ca.starting_mrr - dl.new_mrr  -- downgrade: lose only the delta
            ELSE ca.starting_mrr                    -- true churn: lose all
        END AS mrr_lost
    FROM cancellations ca
    LEFT JOIN downgrade_links dl ON dl.cancelled_sub_id = ca.sub_id
)
