    COALESCE((SELECT SUM(mrr_lost) FROM revenue_loss), 0) AS mrr_lost,
    ((SELECT SUM(starting_mrr) FROM start_cohort)
        - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(mrr_lost) FROM revenue_loss), 0))

        COALESCE(s.mrr_at_start, 0) - COALESCE(e.mrr_at_end, 0) AS contraction_amount
    FROM customer_mrr_start s

      AND COALESCE(e.mrr_at_end, 0) < COALESCE(s.mrr_at_start, 0)

WITH customer_mrr AS (

    s.mrr,

    s.ended_at
  FROM fct_subscriptions s

),

  SELECT
    customer_id,
    month_start,
    SUM(mrr) AS total_mrr
  FROM customer_mrr
  WHERE (ended_at IS NULL OR ended_at >= month_start)
    AND started_at < month_start + INTERVAL '1 month'
  GROUP BY customer_id, month_start
),
mrr_changes AS (
  SELECT
    curr.customer_id,
    curr.month_start,
    curr.total_mrr AS current_mrr,
    prev.total_mrr AS previous_mrr,
    curr.total_mrr - COALESCE(prev.total_mrr, 0) AS mrr_change
  FROM monthly_customer_mrr curr
  LEFT JOIN monthly_customer_mrr prev 
    ON curr.customer_id = prev.customer_id 
    AND prev.month_start = curr.month_start - INTERVAL '1 month'
  WHERE curr.month_start >= '2026-01-01' AND curr.month_start < '2026-04-01'
    AND prev.total_mrr IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
  SUM(CASE WHEN mrr_change < 0 THEN mrr_change * 12 ELSE 0 END) AS arr_contraction,
  SUM(CASE WHEN mrr_change > 0 THEN mrr_change * 12 ELSE 0 END) AS arr_expansion,
  SUM(CASE WHEN mrr_change > 0 THEN mrr_change * 12 ELSE 0 END) + 
  SUM(CASE WHEN mrr_change < 0 THEN mrr_change * 12 ELSE 0 END) AS net_arr_change
FROM mrr_changes

             AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM signup_date) = 2025 
        THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as new_customers_q4_fy2025,
    0 as total_sales_marketing_spend_q4_fy2025,
    CASE

WITH q1_2026_start AS (
    SELECT DATE '2026-01-01' AS period_start,
           DATE '2026-04-01' AS period_end
),
q1_2025_start AS (
    SELECT DATE '2025-01-01' AS period_start,
           DATE '2025-04-01' AS period_end
),
mrr_start_of_q1_2026 AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        SUM(mrr) AS mrr_start
    FROM fct_subscriptions
    CROSS JOIN q1_2026_start
    WHERE started_at < period_start
      AND (ended_at IS NULL OR ended_at >= period_start)
      AND status != 'test'
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
mrr_end_of_q1_2026 AS (
    SELECT 
        s.customer_id,
        SUM(s.mrr) AS mrr_end
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    CROSS JOIN q1_2026_start
    WHERE s.started_at < period_end
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= period_end)
      AND s.status != 'test'
      AND s.customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM mrr_start_of_q1_2026)
    GROUP BY s.customer_id
)
SELECT 
    ROUND(
        COALESCE(SUM(e.mrr_end), 0) / NULLIF(SUM(s.mrr_start), 0) * 100,
        2
    ) AS gross_revenue_retention_pct
FROM mrr_start_of_q1_2026 s
LEFT JOIN mrr_end_of_q1_2026 e ON s.customer_id = e.customer_id

WITH q1_2026_start AS (
    SELECT DATE '2026-01-01' AS period_start,
           DATE '2026-04-01' AS period_end
),
q1_2025_start AS (
    SELECT DATE '2025-01-01' AS cohort_start,
           DATE '2025-04-01' AS cohort_end
),
cohort_mrr AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        SUM(mrr) AS starting_mrr
    FROM fct_subscriptions
    CROSS JOIN q1_2025_start
    WHERE started_at < cohort_end
      AND (ended_at IS NULL OR ended_at >= cohort_start)
      AND status != 'test'
    GROUP BY customer_id
),
retained_mrr AS (
    SELECT 
        f.customer_id,
        SUM(f.mrr) AS retained_mrr
    FROM fct_subscriptions f
    CROSS JOIN q1_2026_start
    INNER JOIN cohort_mrr c ON f.customer_id = c.customer_id
    WHERE f.started_at < period_end
      AND (f.ended_at IS NULL OR f.ended_at >= period_start)
      AND f.status != 'test'
    GROUP BY f.customer_id
)
SELECT 
    ROUND(SUM(r.retained_mrr) / NULLIF(SUM(c.starting_mrr), 0) * 100, 2) AS gross_revenue_retention_pct
FROM cohort_mrr c
LEFT JOIN retained_mrr r ON c.customer_id = r.customer_id

WITH fy2025_cohort AS (

WITH q4_start AS (

         DATE '2024-12-31' AS end_date
),
start_mrr AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(s.mrr), 0) AS total_start_mrr
  FROM fct_subscriptions s
  CROSS JOIN q4_start q
  WHERE s.started_at < q.start_date
    AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= q.start_date)
),
retained_mrr AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(s.mrr), 0) AS total_retained_mrr
  FROM fct_subscriptions s
  CROSS JOIN q4_start q
  WHERE s.started_at < q.start_date
    AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at > q.end_date)
)
SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN start_mrr.total_start_mrr = 0 THEN 0
    ELSE retained_mrr.total_retained_mrr / start_mrr.total_start_mrr
  END AS gross_retention
FROM start_mrr, retained_mrr

WITH customer_acquisition AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        COALESCE(signup_date, joined_dt) AS acquisition_date,
        DATE_TRUNC('month', COALESCE(signup_date, joined_dt)) AS cohort_month
    FROM dim_customers
    WHERE COALESCE(signup_date, joined_dt) <= '2026-03-31'
        AND (is_test IS NULL OR is_test = FALSE)
),
customer_revenue AS (
    SELECT 
        ca.customer_id,
        ca.acquisition_date,
        ca.cohort_month,
        SUM(CASE 
            WHEN i.paid_at <= '2026-03-31' 
                AND i.paid_at >= ca.acquisition_date
                AND i.status = 'paid'
            THEN i.amount 
            ELSE 0 
        END) AS cumulative_revenue
    FROM customer_acquisition ca
    LEFT JOIN fct_invoices i ON ca.customer_id = i.customer_id
    GROUP BY ca.customer_id, ca.acquisition_date, ca.cohort_month
),
cohort_metrics AS (
    SELECT 
        cohort_month,
        COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS customers_acquired,
        SUM(cumulative_revenue) AS total_revenue
    FROM customer_revenue
    GROUP BY cohort_month
),
total_cac AS (
    SELECT 
        SUM(total_revenue) AS total_revenue,
        SUM(customers_acquired) AS total_customers
    FROM cohort_metrics
),
monthly_mrr AS (
    SELECT 
        DATE_TRUNC('month', s.started_at) AS month,
        SUM(s.mrr) AS total_mrr
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    JOIN customer_acquisition ca ON s.customer_id = ca.customer_id
    WHERE s.started_at <= '2026-03-31'
        AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at > s.started_at)
        AND s.status IN ('active', 'trialing')
    GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', s.started_at)
)
SELECT 
    ROUND(
        (tc.total_revenue / NULLIF(tc.total_customers, 0)) / 
        NULLIF((SELECT AVG(total_mrr) FROM monthly_mrr WHERE month <= '2026-03-31'), 0),
        2
    ) AS cac_payback_period_months
FROM total_cac tc

WITH customer_acquisition AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        COALESCE(signup_date, joined_dt) AS acquisition_date,
        DATE_TRUNC('month', COALESCE(signup_date, joined_dt)) AS cohort_month
    FROM dim_customers
    WHERE COALESCE(signup_date, joined_dt) <= '2026-03-31'
        AND (is_test IS NULL OR is_test = FALSE)
),
cohort_customers AS (
    SELECT 
        cohort_month,
        COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) AS customers_acquired
    FROM customer_acquisition
    GROUP BY cohort_month
),
cohort_revenue AS (
    SELECT 
        ca.cohort_month,
        DATE_TRUNC('month', i.paid_at) AS revenue_month,
        SUM(i.amount) AS revenue
    FROM customer_acquisition ca
    JOIN fct_invoices i 
        ON ca.customer_id = i.customer_id
    WHERE i.paid_at <= '2026-03-31'
        AND i.status = 'paid'
    GROUP BY ca.cohort_month, DATE_TRUNC('month', i.paid_at)
),
cumulative_revenue AS (
    SELECT 
        cohort_month,
        revenue_month,
        revenue,
        SUM(revenue) OVER (PARTITION BY cohort_month ORDER BY revenue_month) AS cumulative_revenue
    FROM cohort_revenue
),
cac_estimate AS (
    SELECT 
        cohort_month,
        customers_acquired,
        customers_acquired * 1000 AS total_cac
    FROM cohort_customers
),
payback_analysis AS (
    SELECT 
        cr.cohort_month,
        ce.total_cac,
        ce.customers_acquired,
        cr.revenue_month,
        cr.cumulative_revenue,
        DATEDIFF('month', cr.cohort_month, cr.revenue_month) AS months_since_acquisition
    FROM cumulative_revenue cr
    JOIN cac_estimate ce ON cr.cohort_month = ce.cohort_month
    WHERE cr.cumulative_revenue >= ce.total_cac
),
first_payback AS (
    SELECT 
        cohort_month,
        MIN(months_since_acquisition) AS payback_months
    FROM payback_analysis
    GROUP BY cohort_month
)
SELECT 
    AVG(payback_months) AS cac_payback_period_months
FROM first_payback
WHERE cohort_month <= '2026-03-31'

WITH customer_acquisition AS (
    SELECT 
        c.customer_id,
        COALESCE(c.signup_date, c.joined_dt) AS acquisition_date,
        SUM(i.amount) FILTER (WHERE i.paid_at <= '2025-12-31' AND i.status = 'paid') AS total_revenue
    FROM dim_customers c
    LEFT JOIN fct_invoices i ON c.customer_id = i.customer_id
    WHERE COALESCE(c.signup_date, c.joined_dt) <= '2025-12-31'
        AND (c.is_test IS NULL OR c.is_test = FALSE)
    GROUP BY c.customer_id, acquisition_date
),
customer_cac AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        acquisition_date,
        total_revenue,
        CASE 
            WHEN total_revenue >= 1000 THEN 1000
            ELSE NULL
        END AS assumed_cac
    FROM customer_acquisition
),
monthly_revenue AS (
    SELECT 
        c.customer_id,
        c.acquisition_date,
        c.assumed_cac,
        DATE_TRUNC('month', i.paid_at) AS revenue_month,
        SUM(i.amount) AS monthly_amount
    FROM customer_cac c
    JOIN fct_invoices i ON c.customer_id = i.customer_id
    WHERE i.paid_at <= '2025-12-31'
        AND i.status = 'paid'
        AND c.assumed_cac IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.acquisition_date, c.assumed_cac, DATE_TRUNC('month', i.paid_at)
),
cumulative_revenue AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        acquisition_date,
        assumed_cac,
        revenue_month,
        monthly_amount,
        SUM(monthly_amount) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY revenue_month) AS cumulative_amount
    FROM monthly_revenue
),
payback_months AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        MIN(DATEDIFF('month', acquisition_date, revenue_month)) AS months_to_payback
    FROM cumulative_revenue
    WHERE cumulative_amount >= assumed_cac
    GROUP BY customer_id
)
SELECT 
    AVG(months_to_payback) AS payback_period_months
FROM payback_months

WITH customer_acquisition AS (

        c.customer_id,
        COALESCE(c.signup_date, c.joined_dt) AS acquisition_date,
        MIN(i.paid_at) AS first_payment_date
    FROM dim_customers c
    LEFT JOIN fct_invoices i 
        ON c.customer_id = i.customer_id

        s.customer_id,
        SUM(s.mrr) AS mrr_prior
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    INNER JOIN existing_customers ec ON s.customer_id = ec.customer_id
    CROSS JOIN q1_2026_dates d
    WHERE s.started_at <= CAST(d.prior_period_end AS TIMESTAMP)
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at > CAST(d.prior_period_end AS TIMESTAMP))
      AND s.status = 'active'
      AND s.mrr >= 0
    GROUP BY s.customer_id
),
q1_mrr AS (
    SELECT 
        s.customer_id,
        SUM(s.mrr) AS mrr_q1
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    INNER JOIN existing_customers ec ON s.customer_id = ec.customer_id
    CROSS JOIN q1_2026_dates d
    WHERE s.started_at <= CAST(d.q1_end AS TIMESTAMP)
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at > CAST(d.q1_end AS TIMESTAMP))
      AND s.status = 'active'
      AND s.mrr >= 0
    GROUP BY s.customer_id
)
SELECT 
    SUM(GREATEST(0, COALESCE(q.mrr_q1, 0) - COALESCE(p.mrr_prior, 0))) AS arr_expansion
FROM prior_mrr p
FULL OUTER JOIN q1_mrr q ON p.customer_id = q.customer_id

WITH q4_fy2025_dates AS (
    SELECT 
        DATE '2024-10-01' AS q4_start,
        DATE '2024-12-31' AS q4_end
),
existing_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT customer_id
    FROM fct_subscriptions
    WHERE customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM dim_customers WHERE is_test = false)
      AND started_at < (SELECT q4_start FROM q4_fy2025_dates)
),
mrr_start AS (
    SELECT 
        s.customer_id,
        SUM(s.mrr) AS mrr_q4_start
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    CROSS JOIN q4_fy2025_dates d
    WHERE s.customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM existing_customers)
      AND s.started_at < d.q4_start
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at >= d.q4_start)
      AND s.status = 'active'
      AND s.mrr > 0
    GROUP BY s.customer_id
),
mrr_end AS (
    SELECT 
        s.customer_id,
        SUM(s.mrr) AS mrr_q4_end
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    CROSS JOIN q4_fy2025_dates d
    WHERE s.customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM existing_customers)
      AND s.started_at <= d.q4_end
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at > d.q4_end)
      AND s.status = 'active'
      AND s.mrr > 0
    GROUP BY s.customer_id
)
SELECT 
    SUM(COALESCE(e.mrr_q4_end, 0) - COALESCE(s.mrr_q4_start, 0)) AS arr_expansion
FROM existing_customers ec
LEFT JOIN mrr_start s ON ec.customer_id = s.customer_id
LEFT JOIN mrr_end e ON ec.customer_id = e.customer_id
WHERE COALESCE(e.mrr_q4_end, 0) > COALESCE(s.mrr_q4_start, 0)

WITH fy2025_bounds AS (
    SELECT 
        DATE '2025-01-01' AS fy_start,
        DATE '2025-12-31' AS fy_end
),
existing_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT customer_id
    FROM dim_customers
    WHERE is_test = false
      AND signup_date < (SELECT fy_start FROM fy2025_bounds)
),
mrr_snapshots AS (
    SELECT 
        s.customer_id,
        DATE_TRUNC('month', s.started_at) AS month_start,
        SUM(s.mrr) AS total_mrr
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    INNER JOIN existing_customers ec ON s.customer_id = ec.customer_id
    WHERE s.status = 'active'
      AND s.started_at <= (SELECT fy_end FROM fy2025_bounds)
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at > s.started_at)
      AND s.mrr > 0
    GROUP BY s.customer_id, DATE_TRUNC('month', s.started_at)
),
start_mrr AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        total_mrr
    FROM mrr_snapshots
    WHERE month_start = DATE '2025-01-01'
),
end_mrr AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        total_mrr
    FROM mrr_snapshots
    WHERE month_start = DATE '2025-12-01'
)
SELECT 
    SUM(COALESCE(e.total_mrr, 0) - COALESCE(s.total_mrr, 0)) AS arr_expansion
FROM start_mrr s
FULL OUTER JOIN end_mrr e ON s.customer_id = e.customer_id
WHERE COALESCE(e.total_mrr, 0) > COALESCE(s.total_mrr, 0)

WITH fy2025_bounds AS (
    SELECT 
        DATE '2025-01-01' AS fy_start,
        DATE '2025-12-31' AS fy_end
),
existing_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT customer_id
    FROM fct_subscriptions
    CROSS JOIN fy2025_bounds
    WHERE started_at < CAST(fy_start AS TIMESTAMP)
      AND customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM dim_customers WHERE is_test IS DISTINCT FROM true)
),
mrr_snapshots AS (
    SELECT 
        s.customer_id,
        DATE_TRUNC('month', d.dt) AS month_start,
        SUM(s.mrr) AS total_mrr
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    CROSS JOIN fy2025_bounds b
    CROSS JOIN UNNEST(GENERATE_SERIES(b.fy_start, b.fy_end, INTERVAL 1 MONTH)) AS d(dt)
    WHERE s.customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM existing_customers)
      AND s.started_at <= CAST(d.dt AS TIMESTAMP) + INTERVAL 1 MONTH - INTERVAL 1 DAY
      AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at > CAST(d.dt AS TIMESTAMP))
      AND s.mrr >= 0
    GROUP BY s.customer_id, DATE_TRUNC('month', d.dt)
),
customer_expansion AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        MAX(total_mrr) - MIN(total_mrr) AS expansion_mrr
    FROM mrr_snapshots
    GROUP BY customer_id
    HAVING MAX(total_mrr) > MIN(total_mrr)
)
SELECT SUM(expansion_mrr) * 12 AS arr_expansion
FROM customer_expansion

WITH customer_cohorts AS (
    SELECT 
        c.customer_id,
        c.signup_date,
        DATE_TRUNC('month', c.signup_date) AS cohort_month
    FROM dim_customers c
    WHERE c.is_test = false
        AND c.signup_date <= '2026-03-31'
),
first_invoice_per_customer AS (
    SELECT 
        i.customer_id,
        MIN(i.paid_at) AS first_paid_at,
        SUM(i.amount) AS total_acquisition_cost
    FROM fct_invoices i
    WHERE i.status = 'paid'
        AND i.customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM customer_cohorts)
    GROUP BY i.customer_id
),
monthly_mrr AS (
    SELECT 
        s.customer_id,
        DATE_TRUNC('month', s.started_at) AS month,
        SUM(CASE WHEN s.mrr >= 0 THEN s.mrr ELSE 0 END) AS mrr
    FROM fct_subscriptions s
    WHERE s.customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM customer_cohorts)
        AND s.status = 'active'
        AND s.started_at <= '2026-03-31'
        AND (s.ended_at IS NULL OR s.ended_at > s.started_at)
    GROUP BY s.customer_id, DATE_TRUNC('month', s.started_at)
),
cumulative_revenue AS (
    SELECT 
        cc.customer_id,
        cc.signup_date,
        fi.total_acquisition_cost AS cac,
        SUM(m.mrr) AS cumulative_mrr,
        MIN(CASE 
            WHEN SUM(m.mrr) >= fi.total_acquisition_cost 
            THEN m.month 
        END) AS payback_month
    FROM customer_cohorts cc
    INNER JOIN first_invoice_per_customer fi ON cc.customer_id = fi.customer_id
    LEFT JOIN monthly_mrr m ON cc.customer_id = m.customer_id
    GROUP BY cc.customer_id, cc.signup_date, fi.total_acquisition_cost
),
payback_periods AS (
    SELECT 
        customer_id,
        signup_date,

WITH revenue AS (
  SELECT i.paid_at, i.amount
  FROM fct_invoices i
  JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = i.customer_id
  WHERE i.paid_at >= '2026-01-01'
    AND i.paid_at < '2026-04-01'
    AND i.status = 'paid'
    AND c.is_test = false
),
period_cogs AS (
  SELECT period_month,
    COALESCE(
      MAX(CASE WHEN source = 'cost_of_goods_sold' THEN amount END),
      MAX(CASE WHEN source = 'cost_of_revenue'    THEN amount END)
    ) AS dedupped_cogs
  FROM fct_cogs
  WHERE period_month >= '2026-01-01'
    AND period_month < '2026-04-01'
  GROUP BY period_month
),
totals AS (
  SELECT
    SUM(amount) AS revenue_total,
    (SELECT SUM(dedupped_cogs) FROM period_cogs) AS cogs_total
  FROM revenue
)
SELECT
  ((revenue_total - COALESCE(cogs_total, revenue_total * 0.25))
   / NULLIF(revenue_total, 0)) * 100 AS gross_margin_pct
FROM totals

WITH open_opps AS (
  SELECT 
    COALESCE(e.properties_jsonb->>'opp_id', e.properties_jsonb->>'oppId') AS opp_id,

  FROM fct_events e 
  WHERE e.event_type = 'opp_created' 
    AND (e.timestamp AT TIME ZONE e.timezone AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') < TIMESTAMP '2026-04-01 00:00:00 UTC'
    AND NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1

    )
) 
SELECT SUM(deal_value) / 5000000.0 AS coverage_ratio 
FROM open_opps

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT u.user_id) AS qualified_leads
FROM dim_users u
JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = u.customer_id

  AND u.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND c.is_test = false
  AND EXISTS (
    SELECT 1 FROM fct_events e

      AND e.event_type = 'lead_qualified'

          >= u.created_at

JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = i.customer_id
WHERE
  (CASE
    WHEN i.processor = 'legacy_braintree'
      THEN i.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York'
                      AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles'
    ELSE i.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'
                    AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles'
  END) >= '2025-01-01'
  AND (CASE
    WHEN i.processor = 'legacy_braintree'
      THEN i.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York'
                      AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles'
    ELSE i.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'
                    AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles'
  END) < '2026-01-01'
  AND i.status = 'paid'
  AND c.is_test = false

  FROM fct_invoices i
  JOIN dim_customers c ON c.customer_id = i.customer_id
  WHERE
    (CASE
      WHEN i.processor = 'legacy_braintree'
        THEN i.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/New_York'
                        AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles'
      ELSE i.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'

                        AT TIME ZONE 'America/Los_Angeles'
      ELSE i.paid_at AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'

)
SELECT 
  f.revenue AS feb_2026_revenue,
  m.revenue AS mar_2026_revenue,
  m.revenue - f.revenue AS month_over_month_change,
  CASE 
    WHEN f.revenue > 0 THEN ((m.revenue - f.revenue) / f.revenue) * 100
    ELSE NULL 
  END AS percent_change
FROM feb_revenue f, mar_revenue m

WITH opp_outcomes AS (
  SELECT
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN event_type = 'opp_won'
                        THEN COALESCE(properties_jsonb->>'opp_id',
                                      properties_jsonb->>'oppId') END) AS won,
    COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN event_type = 'opp_lost'
                        THEN COALESCE(properties_jsonb->>'opp_id',
                                      properties_jsonb->>'oppId') END) AS lost
  FROM fct_events
  WHERE (timestamp AT TIME ZONE timezone AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') >= '2026-01-01'
    AND (timestamp AT TIME ZONE timezone AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') < '2026-04-01'
    AND event_type IN ('opp_won', 'opp_lost')
)
SELECT
  won::float / NULLIF(won + lost, 0) * 100 AS win_rate_pct
FROM opp_outcomes
